title: 帝国天鹰 Aquila
parts: The Aquila (plural: Aquilae) (also known as Imperial Aquila , great Aquila and Imperial Eagle) normally refers to a two-headed eagle that symbolizes the Pax Imperialis, the oath that binds together all Imperial servants under the banner of the Emperor of Mankind. It is a universal symbol within the Imperium and more than anything else represents the dominion of the Emperor. It is also said that the Eagle and its variations symbolize both the Imperium as such and also loyalty to the Emperor as its master. It also is the heraldic device of the Imperial state and at the same time holy symbol of the Imperial Cult. The double-headed eagle also represents the union of the Mechanicum of Mars and the Emperor or between Mars and Terra.
天鹰（复数：天鹰）（也称为帝国天鹰、大天鹰和帝国鹰）通常是指象征帝国和平的双头鹰，这是在人类帝皇的旗帜下将所有帝国之仆团结在一起的誓言。它是帝国内部的普遍标志，最重要的是代表帝皇的统治。还有人说，鹰及其变体象征着帝国本身，也象征着对作为主人的帝皇的忠诚。它也是帝国的纹章，同时也是帝国教派的神圣象征。双头鹰也代表了火星机械教和帝皇或火星和泰拉之间的联盟。
The Aquila, symbol of the Imperium of Mankind 天鹰，人类帝国的标志
History 历史
Pre-Great Crusade 大远征前

Before the formalisation of the Eagle (also see Raptor Imperialis) as the symbol of the Imperium the Emperor's personal device was the Thunderbolt and lightning emblem which was used during the Unification Wars. But the Imperial Eagle also is a symbol of the Emperor's War of Unification.
在鹰（也见帝国猛禽）正式成为帝国的象征之前，帝皇的个人标志是统一战争期间使用的霹雳和闪电徽章。但帝国鹰也是帝皇统一战争的象征。
Mark 1 Power Armour as used during the wars to unify the Terran system without Aquilae Mark 1动力盔甲，在统一泰拉星系的战争期间使用，没有天鹰
Great Crusade/Pre-Heresy 大远征/叛乱前

When the newly-found Fulgrim was brought to Terra by the Emperor to join his, Fulgrim's, Legion the Primarch addressed his warriors in a speech. Tasking them with bringing the wisdom of the Emperor to all the stars and underlining that they were the children of the Emperor. The Emperor was so impressed by these words that he bestowed a unique honour on Fulgrim's Legion: They would be permitted to display the Imperial Eagle on their armour chestplates - the only Legion permitted to do so. Possibly the Aquila was also already being used more generally on Power Armour during this and later times.
当新发现的福格瑞姆被帝皇带到泰拉加入他的，福格瑞姆的军团时，原体在一次演讲中向他的战士们发表了讲话。让他们把帝皇的智慧带给群星，并强调他们是帝皇之子。这些话给帝皇留下了深刻的印象，他授予了福格瑞姆的军团一项独特的荣誉：他们将被允许在盔甲胸甲上展示帝国鹰，这是唯一被允许这样做的军团。也许天鹰在这个时代和后来的时代也已经被更广泛地用于动力盔甲。
Pre-Heresy Emperor's Children with chestplate Aquila 配天鹰胸甲的叛乱前帝皇之子
Mark 2 Crusade Armour with Aquila Mark 2远征盔甲与天鹰
Mark 3 Armorum Ferrum/Iron Suit or Iron Armour with Aquila Mark 3铁/铁甲或钢铁盔甲与天鹰
Mark 4 Imperial Maximus with Aquila Mark 4帝国马克西姆斯与天鹰
There has been at least a five Aquila coin in use as Imperial currency in the time prior to the Horus Heresy.
在荷鲁斯叛乱之前，至少有一种五天鹰币被用作帝国货币。
Horus Heresy 荷鲁斯叛乱

Towards the end of the Horus Heresy when the final battle for Mars was underway the armour development teams were evacuated from Mars to Terra where they continued their work. The result of their work was the Mark 7 Armorum Impetor or Eagle Armour which takes its common name from the Eagle device it bears. The Eagle Armour started to reach the loyalist Space Marine defenders on Terra and on the Moon when Horus and his forces overcame the last resistance on Mars.
在荷鲁斯叛乱接近尾声时，当火星的最后一场战斗正在进行时，盔甲开发团体从火星撤离到泰拉，在那里继续他们的工作。他们的工作成果是Mark 7英佩特盔甲或鹰甲，其通用名称来自它所携带的鹰标志。当荷鲁斯和他的部队解决了火星上的最后一次抵抗时，鹰甲开始抵达泰拉和月球上的忠诚星际战士防御者。
Mark 5 Heresy Suit with Aquila Mark 5异端盔甲与天鹰
Mark 7 Armorum Impetor or Eagle Armour Mark 7英佩特盔甲或天鹰盔甲
Design and meanings 设计和意义

The Aquila most commonly has two heads looking into different directions, one said blinded to look at the past, one sighted to see to the future or one head gazing into the Materium while the other gazes into the Immaterium. Other sources associate the blind head with the Adeptus Astronomica and the seeing head with the Adeptus Astra Telepathica.
天鹰最常见的是有两个头朝着不同的方向看，一个头说是盲目地看向过去，一个头是看向未来，或者一个头凝视着物质界，而另一个头则凝视着非物质界。其他资料将盲目之首与星炬庭联系在一起，将有可视之首与星语庭联系起来。
The Aquila 天鹰

The left wing (as seen from the viewer's perspective) represents the Adeptus Astra Telepathica while the right wing represents the Adeptus Mechanicus. The Eagle's body stands for the Adeptus Custodes, while the left, straight claw (again as seen from the viewer's perspective) represents the Administratum and the right, crooked claw the Adeptus Arbites.
左翼（从观看者的角度看）代表星语庭，右翼代表机械教。鹰的身体代表着禁军修会，而左伸直的爪子（再次从观看者的角度来看）代表着内务部，右弯曲的爪子代表着法务部。
Usage 用法

The device of the Aquila is generally used throughout the galaxy wherever the Imperium wishes to proclaim its authority. Typical examples include architecture, armour, vehicles (like space ships), weapons, containers etc. and - at least prior to the Horus Heresy - also currency, i.e. on coins:
天鹰标志通常用于整个银河系，无论帝国希望在哪里宣布其权威。典型的例子包括建筑、盔甲、载具（如星舰）、武器、集装箱等，至少在荷鲁斯叛乱之前，还有货币，即硬币：

Aquilae are frequently worn by Imperial servants, for example on clothing, ceremonial dresses, armour or in the form of jewelry (for example as a necklace or as a brooch), tattoos (or as etchings across shoulder blades) or other adornments.
天鹰经常被帝国之仆佩戴，例如在衣服、礼服、盔甲上或以珠宝（例如作为项链或胸针）、纹身（或作为肩胛骨上的蚀刻）或其他装饰品的形式。
The Aquila as an adornment 天鹰作为装饰品
On an Imperial servant 在帝国之仆身上
On Space Marines 在星际战士身上
On a Sister of Battle 在战斗修女身上
On the shoulder guard of an Ogryn 在欧格林肩甲上
The Aquila typically adorns the chestpiece of Space Marine Power Armour.
天鹰通常装饰在星际战士动力盔甲的胸甲前。
It also is ubiquitous on medals like the Astra Militarum Honours and can also be found as the Aquila Token.
它在星界军的荣誉勋章等奖牌上也无处不在，也可以作为天鹰标找到。
Military honours 军事荣誉勋章
The Eagle Ordinary 普通天鹰
The Steel Aquila 钢铁天鹰
The Medusa Star 美杜莎之星
The Order of the Storm 风暴秩序
The Valoris Imperator 帝皇之威
The Aquila Token 天鹰标
It also appears on vehicles as an affirmation of loyalty.
它也出现在载具上，作为对忠诚的肯定。
The Aquila on vehicles and weapons 载具和武器上的天鹰
On the bulldozer blade of a Leman Russ Battle Tank 黎曼鲁斯战斗坦克的推土铲上
On a space ship 在星舰上
On a Storm bolter 在风暴爆矢枪上
On a Bolter 在爆矢枪上
An Aquila as a form of Imperial Currency 天鹰作为帝国货币的一种形式
An "Aquila" as currency “天鹰”作为货币
There has been at least a five Aquila coin in use as Imperial currency in the time prior to the Horus Heresy.
在荷鲁斯叛乱之前，至少有一种五天鹰币被用作帝国货币。
Other objects bearing or taking the form of an Aquila include but are not limited too: A bar on Sameter using the symbol as a advertising neon sign, as a watermark on paper and iron candelabras.
其他带有或采用天鹰形状的物体包括但不限于：萨米特的一个酒吧，将这个符号用作广告霓虹灯标志，作为纸张和铁烛台上的水印。
The Moebian Domain uses Aquilas, also called Moebian Aquilas, as currency in M42. It features an Aquila design and the text "Imperium of Man" stamped into it.
莫比安领域使用天鹰，也称为莫比安天鹰，作为M42的货币。它以天鹰的设计为特色，上面印有“人类帝国”的文字。
Sign of the Aquila 天鹰手势

The Sign of the Aquila (often shortened to simply Aquila) is a sign of devotion to the Imperium also used for example as a sign of defiance against Warp entities. It was used a sign of devotion from early on. It is also known to have been used as a formal greeting between at least Space Marines and as a sign of respect towards fallen brothers.
天鹰手势（通常简称为天鹰礼）是对帝国忠诚的标志，也被用作对抗亚空间实体的手势。从早期开始，它就被用来表示忠诚。它也被用作至少星际战士之间的正式问候，以及对逝去兄弟的尊重。

Descriptions of how to actually do this sign are however a bit unclear: In one instance it is said that hands are placed or pressed to one's chest, palms open, blades of fingers extended and thumbs raised while others say and show the thumbs are interlocked or crossed while yet another source says the "fingers" are "laced" into the shape on an Aquila.
然而，关于如何实际做这个手势的描述有点不清楚：在一个例子中，据说手放在或压在胸前，手掌张开，手指伸出来，竖起拇指，而另一些人则说并显示拇指是互锁的或交叉的，而另一个来源说“手指”是“绑在”天鹰的形状上的。

This gesture is equivalent to the Cult Mechanicus' gesture, the sign of the cog. It is common for Imperial and Adeptus Mechanicus forces working together to make each other's respective religion's gesture in greeting to express mutual honour and respect from both parties. Although, most Imperials tend to have a laboured unfamiliarity when attempting to make the sign of the cog.
这个手势相当于机械教派的手势，齿轮手势。帝国和机械教的部队一起工作，在问候中做出各自宗教的手势，以表达双方的荣誉和相互尊重，这是很常见的。尽管如此，大多数帝国人在试图做齿轮手势时往往会有一种吃力的陌生感。
The Sign of the Aquila 天鹰手势
Other information 其他信息
Soldiers of the Imperial Guard are obliged to salute (amongst others) any image of the Aquila - failure to do so is punished by being branded on the left cheek and a court-martial.
帝国卫队的士兵有义务向（除其他外）天鹰的任何形象致敬 — 否则将被打左脸颊并接受军事法庭的惩罚。

When no proper altar to the Emperor of Mankind is available one can be improvised by Imperial Guard officers to conduct their ceremonies: under certain circumstances and at certain times an Aquila standard is suspended from a wall and a yellow chalk cross on the floor beneath it then marks the sacred spot.
当没有合适的人类帝皇的祭坛时，帝国卫队军官可以临时制作祭坛来举行仪式：在某些情况下，在某些时候，天鹰旗帜悬挂在墙上，下面地板上的黄色粉笔十字标记着圣地。

At least servants of the Ecclesiarchy are expected to make the Sign of the Aquila when facing an Ecclesiarchical shrine or when seeing a sign of the Ruinous Powers. Making the sign to honour altars also is a known practice amongst other Imperial servants.
至少国教的仆人在面对国教圣地或看到毁灭力量的标志时，应该做出天鹰手势。制作荣誉祭坛的标志也是其他帝国之仆的一种众所周知的做法。
Aquila devices have been known to become the focus of tangible manifestations of religious power.
天鹰标志已成为宗教权力有形表现的焦点。
At least prior to the Horus Heresy it was considered a "great crime" to damage the Imperial Eagle on the chestplate of the Emperor's Children.
至少在荷鲁斯叛乱之前，损坏在帝皇之子胸甲上的帝国鹰被认为是一种“大罪”。
Typical variations and examples 典型变体和示例
Aquilae 天鹰
Armoured Vehicle Insignia 装甲载具徽章
Another common design 另一种常见设计
Above the Golden Throne 在黄金王座上
As used by the Inquisition 被审判庭使用
As used by the Officio Assassinorum 被刺客庭使用
On a building 在建筑上
As used on the standard of the 2nd Company of the Ultramarines 被极限战士第二连队的旗帜使用
As used on the standard of the 5th Company of the Ultramarines 被极限战士第五连队的旗帜使用
As used by the second Dreadnought of the 1st Company of the Ultramarines 被极限战士第一连队的第二名无畏使用
Imperial Fief Badge 帝国封地徽章
The Saturn Saturnine Aquila is placed on the breastplates of Saturnine Pattern Terminator Armour 土星的土星天鹰被放在土星型终结者盔甲的胸甲上
Great Crusade-era Aquila which incorporates the lightning bolts of the Raptor Imperialis 大远征时期的天鹰，融合了帝国猛禽的闪电
Trivia 琐事
Aquila simply is the Latin and Romance languages word for eagle.
天鹰是拉丁语和罗马语中鹰的单词。

Double-headed eagles are or have been used in many different contexts throughout history: "In heraldry and vexillology, the double-headed eagle (or double-eagle) is a charge associated with the concept of Empire. Most modern uses of the symbol are directly or indirectly associated with its use by the Byzantine Empire, whose use of it represented the Empire's dominion over the Near East and the West."
双头鹰在历史上的许多不同背景下都有使用：“在纹章学和旗帜学中，双头鹰（或双鹰）是一种与帝国概念相关的标记。该符号的大多数现代用法都与拜占庭帝国的直接或间接使用相关，拜占庭帝国对它的使用代表了帝国对近东和西方的统治。”

Modern day users of the emblem are as diverse as Albania, Serbia, Montenegro and Russia, the Hellenic Army, different Orthodox Christian Churches and also cities such as Toledo (Spain), Velletri (Italy), Rijeka (Croatia) or Konya (Turkey) to name but a few.
该徽章的现代使用者多种多样，包括阿尔巴尼亚、塞尔维亚、黑山和俄罗斯、希腊军队、不同的东正教教堂，以及托莱多（西班牙）、韦勒特里（意大利）、里耶卡（克罗地亚）或科尼亚（土耳其）等城市。
Notes 注释
Note 1 注释1

Since the word Aquila simply means "eagle" special attention should be paid to the exact context and wording of sources. Sometimes Aquila, Eagle or Imperial Eagle might refer to the double-headed symbol, but sometimes it might also denote a normal, one-headed eagle.
由于天鹰一词的意思只是“鹰”，因此应特别注意来源的确切上下文和措辞。有时天鹰、鹰或帝国鹰可能指双头标志，但有时也可能表示正常的单头鹰。
Note 2 注释2

Due to the lack of supplies during the Horus Heresy the different marks of Power Armour including older ones were used throughout the conflict and even thereafter. In addition older marks came to be associated with the history or past deeds and are therefore still used and much sought after up to current times. Since these images are not precisely dated it is impossible to say if the use of the Aquila was a constant or temporary feature or when it started.
由于荷鲁斯叛乱时期缺乏补给，在整个冲突期间甚至之后都使用了不同的动力盔甲标志，包括旧的标志。此外，旧的标志与历史或过去的行为有关，因此直到现在仍被使用和追捧。由于这些图像没有精确的日期，因此无法确定天鹰的使用是持续的还是暂时的，或者是什么时候开始的。
Conflicting sources 来源冲突

The image of the Aquila in Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader relatively clearly shows that the inscription "Adeptus Astra Telepathica" is connected to the left wing and not to the sighted head of the eagle. But The Inquisition (Background Book) unequivocally states that when "depicted in correct detail" the sighted head represents the "Adeptus Astra Telepathica". Therefore it could be assumed that the image in Rogue Trader is incorrect. But on the other hand The Inquisition does not mention the left wing at all.
《战锤40000：行商浪人》中的天鹰图像相对清楚地表明，铭文“星语庭”与鹰的左翼有关，而不是与鹰的可视之首有关。但《审判庭》（背景书）明确指出，当“以正确的细节描绘”时，有可视之首代表“星语庭”。因此，可以假设行商浪人中的图像不正确。但另一方面，《审判庭》根本没有提到左翼。

title: 帝国货币 Imperial Currencies
parts: Imperial Currencies are the various different types of money that are used across the Imperium. While human life itself is the only universal currency in the Imperium, (with contracts for bartered goods second) most monetary currencies only retain their value within their specific locale, such as a select planet or system. What primarily drives goods and services between stars is barter, favours, debts, and obligations.
帝国货币是帝国中使用的各种不同类型的货币。虽然人命本身是帝国中唯一的通用货币（易货合同排在第二位），但大多数货币只在其特定地区（如选定的行星或星系）保留其价值。主要驱动群星之间商品和服务的是易货、支持、债务和职责。
Examples of currency used on Lyubov 柳波夫上使用的货币示例
Overview 概述

Generally, currency consists of whatever objects are a common exchange unit in a given locale - government coins, intangible ledger-data, ammunition, gold nuggets, even shells picked from a beach. The currencies of mankind are as varied as the worlds of the Galaxy.
一般来说，货币由特定地区常见的交换单元组成 — 政府硬币、无形账本数据、弹药、金块，甚至是从海滩上捡来的贝壳。人类的货币就像银河系的世界一样多种多样。

A major trade hub such as Port Wander, situated on the border between the Calixis Sector and Koronus Expanse, might see a hundred different currencies brought in by merchants and Rogue Traders - even some that were issued by said Rogue Traders, for many such men and women of power wish to see their face upon coins and parchment notes. In such a place, even the money-changers of the Administratum may prove corrupt or simply busy, and thus a mix of currencies continues to be used.
位于卡利西斯星区和克罗努斯扩区交界处的漫游港等主要贸易中心可能会看到商人和行商浪人带来一百种不同的货币，甚至有些是由行商浪人发行的，因为许多这样的有权势的男女希望在硬币和纸币上看到他们的脸。在这样一个地方，即使是内务部的货币交换者也可能被证明是腐败的或只是很忙，因此继续使用多种货币。

Human systems isolated from the Imperium may have varied currency within their own worlds. While some like Nadeush are able to maintain paper currency and scrip backed by the wealth of the local Maraj noble families, others like war-torn Zayth has each mobile hive city circulating their own currencies of stamped ingots of precious metals hung upon loops of silver wire, and still other worlds have resorted to barter with both parties being heavily armed.
与帝国隔绝的人类星系可能在自己的世界里有不同的货币。虽然像纳杜什这样的能够用当地马拉吉贵族家族的财富来维持纸币和代券，但像饱受战争蹂躏的扎伊特这样的其他则让每个移动巢都城市流通自己的货币，这些货币是贵金属的冲压锭块被悬挂在银丝制成的环上，还有一些世界则采取了易货的方式，双方都全副武装。

In the void of space, pirates, often the descendants of Imperial outcasts and refugees, may understand the value of more standardized Imperial currency - yet to use these for trade without a display of force or bloodshed is often seen as a weakness. More ruthless pirates and Corsairs might trade in hacksilver, technology, ammunition, even slaves - with even darker rumours abounding of trapped souls and bottled life.
在虚空空域，海盗，通常是帝国弃民和难民的后代，可能会理解更标准化的帝国货币的价值，但在不展示武力或流血的情况下将其用于贸易往往被视为一种软弱。更无情的海盗和私掠者可能会交易碎银、技术、弹药，甚至奴隶 — 甚至还有更黑暗的谣言，说有受困灵魂和瓶装生命。

Despite all this, when the time comes, a more standardized Segmentum-wide currency such as Thrones will be what is used to assess and evaluate the value of goods and materials for the Imperial Tithe in comparison to other Imperial factions.
尽管如此，当时机成熟时，一种更标准化的星域宽度货币，如王座币，将用于评定和评估帝国什一税中商品和物资的价值，并将其与其他帝国派系进行比较。
Listed here are some examples of currencies in the Imperium, both those widely used or those more specific to smaller locations.
这里列出了帝国货币的一些例子，既有广泛使用的货币，也有更特定于较小地区的货币。
List 列表
Aquila Pieces - Coins used during the Great Crusade and Horus Heresy in various denominations, including a Five Aquila Piece, which was about the same size as a Throne.
天鹰硬币 - 在大远征和荷鲁斯叛乱期间使用的各种面额的硬币，包括一种五天鹰硬币，其大小与王座币大致相同。

Aquilas - Currency used in the Moebian Domain in present day M42, also known as Moebian Aquilas. Rectangular pieces of metal stamped with the Aquila iconography and text "Imperium of Man". Akin to a large coin.
天鹰币 - 如今M42在莫比安领域使用的货币，也被称为莫比安天鹰。印有天鹰图像和文字“人类帝国”的矩形金属片。像一枚大硬币。
Moebian Aquila 莫比安天鹰
Bone chips - The inhabitants of Thaur trade with bone chips believed to be the work of venerable carving-masters.
骨片 - 索尔的居民用骨片进行贸易，据信这是德高望重的雕刻大师的作品。
Caligari Credits - Used on the Imperial worlds of the Caligari Sector.
卡利加里信用币 - 用于卡利加里星区的帝国世界。
Credits - Used on Necromunda in M41.
信用币 - 用于M41中的涅克罗蒙达。
Crowns - Used from the Great Crusade to M41 on Karoscura.
王冠币 - 用于从大远征到M41的卡洛斯卡。
Ducats - Golden trade coins issued by Navigator Houses able to be used as currency wherever their ships travelled in M41.
杜卡特 - 导航者家族发行的黄金贸易硬币，无论他们的舰船在M41中行驶到哪里，都可以用作货币。
Estrillian Newmarks - Used on Atraxia. A tarot deck could potentially be bought for as few as 27 Newmarks.
埃斯特瑞安纽马克 - 用于阿特拉西亚。一副塔罗牌的价格可能低至27纽马克。

Gelt - The Blessed Remuneration of Service, or “gelt” as it is commonly called, is the dominant coin used on Juno. Despite being the capital world of the Askellon Sector, it has little value elsewhere in the sector.
盖尔特 - 服役的神圣报酬，或通常所说的“金钱”，是朱诺上使用的主要硬币。尽管它是阿斯克隆星区的首都世界，但在该星区的其他地方几乎没有价值。

Guild Scrip - Guild Scrip, sometimes simply called "scrip", is the standard currency on Desoleum when oath-cog adjustments are insufficient or impractical, or when dealing with offworlders without oath-bindings.
行会代币 - 行会代币，有时简称为“代币”，是德索莱姆上的标准货币，当誓言齿轮调整不足或不切实际时，或者在与没有誓言约束的出价人打交道时。

Scrip - Various forms of scrip might be used to pay labourers in place of a local legal currency. These more limited internal currencies are often only valuable aboard a specific ship, guild or other organisation.
代券 - 各种形式的代券可用于代替当地法定货币支付劳动者的工资。这些更有限的内部货币通常只在特定的舰船、行会或其他组织上有价值。

Slates - Used on Alecto. Slates can be both transacted and stored physical slates or digitally via the use of a personal currency wand (data wand). Although these are as valuable as the currency data stored within and are easily stolen. Most of the population relies on chit books and ration tokens.
板 - 用于阿勒克图。板可以通过使用个人货币棒（数据棒）进行交易和存储 — 物理板或数字管。尽管这些数据与存储在其中的货币数据一样有价值，而且很容易被盗。大多数人依靠条册和配给券。
Solars - Used on Voll, a world within the Macharian Sector. Golden solars are used as Service Identity Tags for Guardsmen regiments from said sector.
太阳币 - 用于马卡里安星区的沃尔世界。黄金太阳币被用作该星区卫兵兵团的服役身份标签。
Solars 太阳币
Sabulorb shekels - Used on Sabulorb.
萨布尔奥布谢克尔 - 用于萨布尔奥布。
Terces - Silver coin, used on Medusa in M41.
特塞斯 - 银币，M41中用于美杜莎。

Thrones - Gelt coins that have been used since Horus Heresy, in the Calixis Sector up to present day M41. In the present day it is one of many currencies accepted throughout Segmentum Obscurus and used to measure value for the Imperial Tithe. Each Throne gelt coin is the same size as a Five Aquila Piece.
王座币 - 自荷鲁斯叛乱以来，卡利西斯星区一直使用的钱币，直到今天的M41。如今，它是朦胧星域接受的众多货币之一，用于衡量帝国什一税的价值。每枚王座钱币的大小与一枚五天鹰币相同。
Profit Factor 利润因子

The great wealth afforded by a Rogue Trader, coupled with the sheer differences in local currencies, makes it impractical for them to make regular use of something so trivial as currency. The counting of currency is thought of as work more befitting scribes and commoners. Rogue traders stand far, far above the tyranny of coin that causes most men to check their purse whether they can afford their next meal. Whether it is acquiring a relic weapon, yet another mercenary company, a thousand lasguns, a set rare gems or a vortex torpedo, Rogue Traders find it more convenient to measure their wealth in terms of Profit Factor, calculated by his or her loyal scribes. Profit Factor can be used to measure the relative power of a Rogue Trader's dynasty, particularly compared to other Imperial factions.

行商浪人提供的巨大财富，加上当地货币的巨大差异，使他们无法经常使用货币这样微不足道的东西。货币计数被认为是更适合文士和平民的工作。行商浪人远远超过了硬币的专制，导致大多数人检查他们的资金，看他们是否能负担得起下一顿饭。无论是获得一件圣物武器、或另一个雇佣兵连队、一千支激光枪、一套稀有宝石还是一枚漩涡鱼雷，行商浪人都发现用他或她忠诚的文士计算的利润因子来衡量他们的财富更方便。利润因子可用于衡量行商浪人的王朝的相对力量，特别是与其他帝国派系相比。
A table with examples/estimates of the average Profit Factor equivalents for various factions and leaders in the Imperium 帝国中不同派系和领导人的平均利润因子等值示例/估计表

title: 帝国真理 Imperial Truth
parts: The Imperial Truth was a doctrine preached by the Imperium of Man during the years of the Great Crusade.
帝国真理是人类帝国在大远征期间宣扬的一种教义。
Overview 概述

The contents of this belief involved the removal of religion, faith, and superstition that plagued numerous human worlds that had been recontacted by Terra. Instead, the Imperial Truth was offered by Iterators that provided the cold clarity of logic and science to the masses. Other key aspects of the Imperial Truth was the manifest destiny of mankind to rule the stars, the exceptionalism of humanity, and the danger posed by all xenos. As part of his campaign to spread the Imperial truth, the Emperor's Thunder Warriors destroyed all churches on Terra, believing it to be necessary to have humanity accept science and reason over superstition and barbarism. In truth, the Emperor sought to wipe out superstition and religion as they were easy doors from which the powers of Chaos entered the minds of men.

这种信念的内容涉及消除宗教、信仰和迷信，这些信仰和迷信困扰着泰拉重新接触的众多人类世界。相反，帝国真理是由宣道者提供的，它为大众提供了冷酷的逻辑和科学清晰度。帝国真理的其他关键方面是人类统治星辰的天命、人类例外主义以及所有异型带来的危险。作为传播帝国真理运动的一部分，帝皇的雷霆战士摧毁了泰拉上的所有教堂，认为有必要让人类接受科学和理性，而不是迷信和野蛮。事实上，帝皇试图消灭迷信和宗教，因为它们是混沌力量进入人们思想的方便之门。

The Imperial Truth began to disintegrate due to the Horus Heresy and encounters with the Dark Powers of the Warp. Many either turned traitor as a result or embraced the growing Lectitio Divinitatus, which proclaimed that the Emperor was a god.
由于荷鲁斯叛乱和与亚空间黑暗势力的遭遇，帝国真理开始瓦解。许多人要么因此成为叛徒，要么接受了日益壮大的“神性论”，宣称帝皇是神。

title: 帝国文化 Imperium Culture
parts: The culture of the Imperium can be said to be cosmopolitan in that no two worlds are exactly alike. Making all these disparate cultures into one that owes fealty to one source — Terra — is in itself difficult. Some general statements may be made, but the scale and variety of the Imperium defies even these.
帝国的文化可以说是世界性的，因为没有两个世界是完全相同的。将所有这些不同的文化整合为一个对一个源头 — 泰拉 — 忠诚的文化本身就很困难。可以做出一些一般性的陈述，但帝国的规模和多样性甚至超越了这些。
Language 语言

Unlike currency, there is a unifying language to the Imperium: High Gothic and Low Gothic. High Gothic (and a technical dialect known as "Tech") is the first language on a large minority of worlds, a well-known second language on still more. In the greater Imperium, High Gothic is largely unknown, and is mainly used formally, as in pious benedictions or between adepts, as High Gothic has remained uniform throughout the Imperium.
与货币不同，帝国有一种统一的语言：高哥特语和低哥特语。高哥特语（以及一种被称为“技术语”的技术方言）是世界上极少数人的第一语言，更是著名的第二语言。在更大的帝国，高哥特语在很大程度上是不出名的，主要是正式场合使用的，如在虔诚的祝祷中或在专家之间使用，因为高哥特语一直在整个帝国保持统一。

Throughout much of the Imperium, Low Gothic is the lingua franca, and it has developed a large number of local dialects, lexicons, and accents throughout the Imperium. All variations of Low Gothic have their roots in the proto-Gothic language used during the early Age of Expansion. The Nalsheen and the Sleepwalkers of Gereon use one such Old Gothic-based dialect. Very few feral and feudal worlds have native High Gothic speakers.
在帝国的大部分地区，低哥特语是通用语，它在整个帝国中发展了大量的当地方言、词汇和口音。低哥特语的所有变体都源于扩张时代早期使用的原始哥特语。纳尔辛和格里昂的梦游者使用了一种基于古哥特语的方言。很少有蛮荒和封建世界有讲高哥特语的人。
The Adeptus Mechanicus, while cognisant of the Gothic languages, will more readily use their own collection of languages known as Cant Mechanicus.
机械神教虽然熟悉哥特语，但更愿意使用他们自己的语言集，即机械之语。
There also exist a number of sign languages, whose origins range from the ritualistic Thoughtmark of the Sisters of Silence to the battlefield-born Battle-Signs of the Astartes.
也存在许多手语，其起源范围从寂静修女的仪式思想印记到阿斯塔特在诞生于战场的战斗手语。
Literature 文学

Many types of literature exist in the Imperium. Treatises, monographs, textbooks and other texts are written about a multitude of subjects such as natural philosophy, planetary histories, law and religion. Less serious reading exists as well in the forms of poetry, fiction and pornography.
帝国中存在许多类型的文学。论文、专著、课本和其他文本都是关于自然哲学、行星历史、法律和宗教等众多学科的。不那么严肃的阅读也存在于诗歌、小说和情色作品中。

While physical books do exist in the Imperium, most people don’t read physical books printed on paper. Fewer than one in thirty thousand people ever read anything that isn’t on a slate or a devotional pamphlet. Still, paper is used and produced on many Imperial worlds although the animal-hide-based vellum is the most commonly used material for record keeping. Vellum is cheaper and more durable than normal paper or other forms of storing information.
虽然帝国中确实存在实体书，但大多数人不会阅读印在纸上的实体书。不到三万分之一的人读过任何不在石板或祈祷手册上的东西。尽管如此，许多帝国世界仍在使用和生产纸张，尽管基于动物皮的羊皮纸是记录保存最常用的材料。羊皮纸比普通纸张或其他形式的存储信息更便宜、更耐用。

The Imperium and its various organisations are known to keep their important records in their own libraries and archives. These repositories of knowledge vary in size, from a municipal or an important individual’s personal library to entire archive-worlds. Bookshops exist as well in the Imperium.
众所周知，帝国及其各个组织将重要记录保存在自己的图书馆和档案馆中。这些知识库的规模各不相同，从地方或重要个人的个人图书馆到整个档案世界。帝国也存在书店。
Two examples of famous Imperial literature are "The Spheres of Longing" written by the Inquisitor Gideon Ravenor and "Reflections and Odes" written by the Remembrancer-poet Ignace Karkasy.
著名的帝国文学有两个例子，一个是审判官吉迪恩·拉文诺写的《渴望之域》，另一个是记述者诗人伊格纳斯·卡尔卡西写的《反思与颂歌》。

Religion 宗教

In the 41st Millennium, the standard religion of the Imperium is the Imperial Cult. The cult venerates the Emperor as a divine being, borne out by a number of miracles and saints in his name. Variations of this cult appear across the galaxy, and the Adeptus Terra investigates some of them to ensure that they do indeed pay fealty to the Immortal Master of Mankind. Note that not all of humanity's defenders worship the Emperor in the same manner: for instance, some of the Adeptus Astartes chapters' beliefs would be heretical for an ordinary citizen to hold.
在41个千年，帝国的标准宗教是帝国教派。该教派将帝皇视为神圣的存在，以他的名义出现的许多奇迹和圣人都证明了这一点。这种崇拜的变体出现在银河系的各个角落，中央政务部对其中一些进行了调查，以确保他们确实向不朽的人类之主效忠。请注意，并非所有人类的守卫者都以同样的方式崇拜帝皇：例如，对于一个普通平民来说，的某些阿斯塔特战团的信仰是异端。

Unfortunately for humankind, there are other gods that demand worship. Warp entities require tribute in order to remain in the physical realm, while still others venerate aliens. These deviant cults are the maggot-ridden underbelly of human culture, and it is the role of humankind's best investigators to root them out and burn them before they infest the rest of the species.
不幸的是，对人类来说，还有其他需要崇拜的神。亚空间实体需要祭品才能留在物质领域，而还有一些则敬仰异型。这些异常教派是人类文化中蛆虫横行的软肋，人类最好的调查者的作用是在它们感染其他物种之前将其根除并烧毁。
Media 媒体
Mass media, rigidly controlled by the Ecclesiarchy and the state, is usually political or religious in nature, forcing many to find other sources of entertainment.
由国教和国家严格控制的大众媒体通常具有政治或宗教性质，迫使许多人寻找其他娱乐来源。
There exist holodramas, presumably audiovisual narratives that can be watched thanks to some form of Hololithic Projector. Examples include:
存在全息戏剧，可能是由于某种形式的全息投影仪而可以观看的视听叙事。示例包括：

Entertainment 娱乐

Most recreation is achieved through religious festivals, music, and drinking. Many, particularly those who can not find fulfillment outside of worship to the Emperor, resort to drug use to escape the reality of their lives. There are parks and shows for the nobility, but these are too expensive for a commoner to enjoy. Circuses and traveling fairs exist in the Imperium as well. On particular regressive worlds, gladiatorial combat may be used for entertainment.
大多数娱乐活动都是通过宗教节日、音乐和饮酒来实现的。许多人，尤其是那些在崇拜帝皇之外找不到满足感的人，为了逃避现实生活而吸毒。有对贵族的运动场和表演，但这些对平民来说太贵了。帝国也有马戏团和移动集市。在特定的退化世界中，角斗士格斗可能被用于娱乐。

Post-Akkadian Gothic - A style of architecture. Lauded examples include the Cardophian Repository, established in late M36.

Currency 货币

Many types of currency in the Imperium exist, such as Credits, Crowns, Aquilas, Thrones, Scrip and ecclesiarchy-certified tithe beads. Often goods, resources, and manpower are substituted as currency on a planetary level.
帝国中存在许多类型的货币，如信誉币、王冠币、天鹰币、王座币、代币和教会认证的什一税念珠。通常，商品、资源和人力在全球范围内被替代为货币。
Technology 技术

Since the end of the epoch known as the Dark Age of Technology, mankind's technological level has regressed. The Imperium is largely reliant on maintaining technologies from the Dark Age - such as the warp drive — which are vital to its continued operation, but which are little understood and cannot be replicated.
自黑暗技术时代结束以来，人类的技术水平已经倒退。帝国在很大程度上依赖于维护黑暗时代的技术，如亚空间驱动，这对其持续运作至关重要，但人们对其知之甚少，也无法复制。
Transmission systems 传输系统

Electricity is the single most important means of transporting energy from one place to another in the 41st millennium.. However, some of the technologies within the Imperium rely upon Photon Lines (a refined development of fibre optic cable), Phased Crystals (to transport information), hydroplastics (which generate power through pressure), Sucrosol (an abbreviation of Sucrose based solution, a synthetic 'blood' that allows bio-engineered parts to be maintained, it is usually white) or radio signals (utilising radio bandwidths previously unavailable).
在第41个千年里，电力是将能源从一个地方输送到另一个地方的唯一最重要的手段。然而，帝国内部的一些技术依赖于光子线（光纤电缆的改进发展）、相位晶体（传输信息）、水塑塑料（通过压力产生电力）、蔗糖醇（蔗糖基溶液的缩写，一种允许维持生物工程部件的合成“血液”，通常是白色的）或无线电信号（利用以前不可用的无线电带宽）。
Generation systems 发电系统
Crystal Batteries — Based on engineered crystals whose structure changes as they absorb energy, slowly releasing it as they progressively recover their original form.
晶体电池 — 基于合成晶体，其结构在吸收能量时会发生变化，并在逐渐恢复原始形态时缓慢释放。
Plasma-generators — Ionized matter contained in a magnetic field. Potentially volatile.
等离子发生器 — 磁场中包含的电离物质。可能不稳定。
Conventional — Wind, tides, sun, steam, friction, animal and so on.
常规 — 风、潮汐、太阳、蒸汽、摩擦、动物等等。
Bionics 仿生

Bionics are used throughout the Imperium, though with no real standard to make or quality. They are commonly used to repair severely wounded soldiers, although there are many other applications. High-ranking officials of the Imperium such as Adepts and members of the Inquisition are most likely to have high-quality bionics. Generally, they represent a special acquisition and would not conceivably be available to the poor or even moderately well-off.
整个帝国都在使用仿生，尽管没有真正的标准或质量。它们通常用于修补重伤的士兵，尽管还有许多其他应用。帝国的高级官员，如专家和审判庭的成员，最有可能拥有高质量的仿生。一般来说，它们代表了一种特殊的购置，穷人甚至中等富裕的人都无法获得。

Generally speaking, bionics are available to soldiers of the Imperium, including guardsmen (such as Domor from the Tanith First regiment), and Space Marines. They are also available to other servants of the Emperor of rank, and to the rich (such as Captain Maxilla of the Essene).
一般来说，仿生可供帝国的士兵使用，包括卫兵（如塔尼斯第一兵团的多莫尔）和星际战士。它们也可供帝皇的其他仆人和富人（如艾赛尼的马克西拉船长）使用。
Standard Template Constructs 标准模板结构

A Standard Template Construct (STC) is a system created in the Dark Age of Technology to assist colonists in creating and maintaining technologies vital to survival on new planets. In the current era of the Imperium, very few exist. The Adeptus Mechanicus is constantly searching for any rumour of an STC as part of their "Quest for Knowledge."
标准模板构造（STC）是在黑暗技术时代创建的一个系统，旨在帮助殖民者创建和维护对在新行星上生存至关重要的技术。在当今帝国时代很少存在。作为他们“寻求知识”的一部分，机械神教一直在寻找任何关于STC的谣言

Medical Science 医学

Public health is overseen by the Officio Medicae, a division of the Adeptus Administratum, and various agencies have their own corps of chiurgeons. While the wealthy and powerful have access to Juvenat treatments to prolong their life expectancy, ordinary citizens must do with levels of medical science ranging from leeches and herbs to treatment in fully equipped hospitals depending on their world's technological level and personal status.
公共医疗由内务部下属的医疗部监督，各机构都有自己的外科医生团队。虽然富人和有权势的人可以获得回春疗法来延长他们的预期寿命，但普通平民必须接受从水蛭和草药到设备齐全的医院的医疗科学水平，这取决于他们的世界技术水平和个人状况。
Medication 药物
Acetazolamide 乙酰唑胺
Aeldramol 艾尔德拉莫尔
Ataraxics 镇静剂
Calming Balsam 舒缓香膏
Mascetamine 马斯科塔胺
Morpholox 莫弗洛克斯
Morphomycin 莫弗霉素
Pain suppressants 止痛药
Panimune 帕尼莫
Rainbow 彩虹
Solipsus 索利普索斯
Somna 索姆纳
Vulgate oxybarbital 通行氧巴比妥
Zendocaine 曾多卡因
Industry 工业
Industrial Equipment 工业设备
Aqua-Harvesting Rig 水收割钻机
Colossus-class Melta ship 巨像级熔融舰
Delving-Spike 钻刺
Filter Rig 过滤钻机
Gas-Extractor Tower 气体提取塔
Gun Rig 喷射钻机
Loggernaut 伐木机
Macro-trawler 大型拖网渔船
Mega-harvester 巨型收割机
Sonic Drill 声波钻机
Spindlerig 长杆钻机
Tectonic Fragdrill 构造破片钻

Bauxanium 铝土
Dacite 英安岩
Diamonite 金刚石
Diorite 闪长岩
Fascium 法西厄姆
Trans-Sulphur 反式硫
Trivia 琐事

High Gothic is represented in most editions of 40k as a "latinised" form of English, which enrages Latin scholar fans of the game still, some still complaining that the book Deus Encarmine should instead have been called Deux Encarmine (See Black Library forum).
在40k的大多数版本中，高哥特语被表示为一种“拉丁化”的英语形式，这仍然激怒了该游戏的拉丁语学者粉丝，一些人仍然抱怨《Deus Encarmine》一书应该被称为《Deux Encarmine（见黑色图书馆论坛）》。

The prestige of bionics has wavered through the editions of Warhammer 40,000. In the 1st edition, bionics were a fairly broad selection of gear and equipment, including such devices as tendril sensors and bionic limbs. By third and fourth edition, with the focus coming much more as a large-scale warfare game, the role of bionics has diminished to giving only minimal advantages.
仿生的重要性在战锤40000的版本中动摇了。在第一版中，仿生是一种相当广泛的装备和设备，包括卷须传感器和仿生肢体等装置。到了第三版和第四版，随着重点更多地放在大型战争游戏上，仿生的作用已经减弱，只提供了最小的优势。

title: 帝国律法 Lex Imperialis
parts: The Lex Imperialis, also called the Dictates Imperialis, is the legal code of the Imperium. Claimed to be the word of the Emperor himself, it is a vast body of laws and codes compiled over ten thousand years that Judges of the Adeptus Arbites spend their entire lives studying and compiling in the Book of Judgement. Though each world of the Imperium has its own unique set of rules, the Lex Imperialis is the definitive and absolute word, ruling above all others. The Lex Imperialis is ruthlessly enforced by the Adeptus Arbites.
帝国律法，也称为帝国法令，是帝国的法典。声称是帝皇本人的话语，这是一万多年来编纂的大量法律和法规，是法务部中的法官们毕生研究和编纂的。尽管帝国的每个世界都有自己独特的规则，但帝国律法是权威和绝对的言语，凌驾于一切之上。帝国律法是由法务部无情地执行的。

While the Dicatates Imperialis are extensive, the huge volume of prior cases and sometimes contradictory rulings can make it difficult to determine the correct decision. In especially complex cases, it may take centuries to reach an outcome. A Judge may spend his entire life deliberating, scrutinizing, and trying to fathom out the issues, only to pass his work on, unfinished, for others to continue. Millennia later, though the accused are long dead, a ruling is finally made and justice must be meted out upon the distant descendants and those obscurely associated with the original transgressor.
虽然帝国法令的范围很广，但大量的先前案件，有时甚至是相互矛盾的裁决，可能会使确定正确的决定变得困难。在特别复杂的情况下，可能需要几个世纪才能得出结果。法官可能一生都在深思熟虑、仔细审查和试图解决问题，结果却是把他未完成的工作交给其他人继续。数千年后，尽管被告早已去世，但最终做出了裁决，必须对远亲后裔和那些与原初罪犯有模糊联系的人伸张正义。

It is required by Imperial Law that all psykers must undergo the Adeptus Astra Telepathica's testing and sanctioning process. Those that do not submit themselves to be collected by authorities and retrieved by the League of Black Ships, or otherwise evade this process, are labelled rogue psykers and considered fugitives.
帝国律法要求所有灵能者必须接受星语庭的测试和制裁过程。那些不接受当局收集和黑船联盟追回的人，或以其他方式逃避这一过程的人，会被贴上非法灵能者的标签，并被视为逃犯。

title: 帝国什一税 Imperial Tithe
parts: The Imperial Tithe, also called the Grand Harvesting, Great Tithe, or Terra's Due, refers to the amount of materials an Imperial world must supply to the Administratum.
帝国什一税，也称为大收割、大什一税或泰拉应得，是指帝国世界必须向内务部供应的材料数量。
Overview 概述

Two types of tithes are demanded of Imperial worlds. The first is a military tithe requiring 1/10th of a planet's PDF being gathered as new recruits for the Imperial Guard. The second, known as Exacta, includes all other types of resources or wealth. Collection of the first type of tithe is overseen by the Departmento Munitorum while collection of the second is overseen by the Departmento Exacta. Tithes are physically collected by Administratum authorities, successors of the Crusade-era Eaxectors, which periodically arrive on the subject world. The frequency of visits varies world to world, but in at least one case the Departmento Munitorum visited a planet nine times in a year, demanding new Imperial Guard conscripts each time.
帝国世界需要两种类型的什一税。第一个是军事什一税，要求收集一颗行星PDF的十分之一作为帝国卫队的新兵。第二种被称为强征税，包括所有其他类型的资源或财富。第一类什一税的征收由军务部监督，而第二类什一税的征收由计校部监督。什一税由远征时代强征者的继任者内务部实际收集，他们定期抵达目标世界。访问的频率因世界而异，但至少有一次，军务部在一年内访问了一个行星九次，每次都要求新的帝国卫队应征入伍。

The size of the tithe depends on the type of world to which it is applied. A tithe can be any form of material: food, weapons, minerals, people, etc. Despite the number of agencies tracking tithes, the sheer size of the Imperium and the difficulty of Warp travel makes the time-consuming process of tithe collection excessively confusing and inefficient.
什一税的大小取决于它所适用的世界类型。什一税可以是任何形式的物质：食物、武器、矿产、人口等。尽管有许多机构追踪什一税，但帝国的庞大规模和亚空间航行的困难使得耗时的什一税收集过程过于混乱和低效。

It is the duty of Planetary Governors to ensure the tithe of their world is paid, and any world that fails to pay its tithe meets with vicious reprisal from the Adeptus Terra. At the slightest breach of protocol, Imperial officials will often order the Adeptus Arbites to immediately execute the Governor. However, as long as the planetary ruler dutifully pays his world's tithe, he may rule the planet in almost any way he sees fit.
行星总督有责任确保他们世界的什一税得到支付，任何不支付什一税的世界都会遭到中央政务部的残酷报复。只要有丝毫违反协议的行为，帝国官员通常会命令法务部立即处决总督。然而，只要行星统治者尽职尽责地支付世界的什一税，他几乎可以以任何他认为合适的方式统治行星。
Tithe exemptions 什一税豁免

Space Marine homeworlds, planets belonging to the Ecclesiarchy, Knight Worlds and Forge Worlds of the Adeptus Mechanicus are not usually subject to Imperial tithes, and are given the tithe grade Aptus Non, though Space Marines must provide a separate tithe in Gene-Seed to the Administratum. Certain worlds which supply large amounts of psykers to the Black Ships of the Adeptus Astra Telepathica are also known to be exempt from the standard tithe.
星际战士的家园世界、属于国教的行星、骑士世界和机械神教的铸造世界通常不受帝国什一税的约束，并被授予特级免税的什一税等级，尽管星际战士必须向内务部提供单独的基因种子什一税。某些向星语庭的黑船提供大量灵能者的世界也被认为不受标准什一税的约束。

However, even worlds exempt from the Imperial tithe are not always exempt from scrutiny or collections. The Sisters of Silence are known to gather blanks from worlds normally immune to the demands of the tithe.
然而，即使是免于帝国什一税的世界，也并不总是免于审查或征收。众所周知，寂静修女从通常不受什一税要求影响的世界中收集空白者。
Tithe grades 什一税等级

The Tithe Grade below are generally applied to worlds depending on their World's Classification. However, the Tithe Grade assigned to a world by the Adeptus Administratum can vary depending on a variety of other factors, such as whether a world aided the Imperium during the Horus Heresy.
下面的什一税等级通常适用于世界，具体取决于它们的世界分类。然而，内务部为一个世界分配的什一税等级可能因各种其他因素而异，例如一个世界是否在荷鲁斯叛乱期间帮助了帝国。
Orbis Cassi - Used after a world is of no further use to the Imperium
空球级 - 在一个世界对帝国没有进一步用途后使用
Aptus Non (also Adeptus Non) - Lowest
特级免税 - 最低
Solutio Tertius 第三级初等
Solutio Prima 第三级上等
Solutio Extremis 第三级高等
Decuma Particular 第二级特等
Exactis Tertius 第一级初等
Exactis Prima 第一级上等
Exactis Particular 第一级特等
Exactis Extremis 第一级高等
Experima - Highest
实验级 - 最高

title: 帝国历法 Imperial Calendar
parts: The original Imperial Calendar was created by the Emperor of Mankind sometime before the end of the Great Crusade. By the 42nd millenium at least five "non-heretical" variations of the original calendar existed. The Imperial Calendar bases its years on the Anno Domini system, beginning at 1AD/CE. A typical year, as Imperial scholars write it, would look something like 456.M41. When an Imperial date is written using only year, it is acceptable to write the year with a backslash, for example; 456/M41. These specify the year on Terra. Only the year is used by Imperial Citizens at large, with most systems using their own calanders for local events, for example the Vigilus Template.
最初的帝国历法是由人类帝皇在大远征结束前的某个时候创建的。到了42个千年，原初历法至少有五种“非异端”变体。帝国历法以公元/公元后1年开始的公元系统为基础。正如帝国学者所写，一个典型的年份像456.M41。当帝国日期仅使用年书写时，可以使用反斜杠书写年份，例如；456/M41。这些指定了泰拉上的年份。一般来说，帝国公民只使用年，大多数星系都使用自己的历法来处理当地事件，例如警戒星样板。
Calculating an Imperial Date 计算帝国日期
When dates are used for Imperial Administrative purposes, the date is further expanded into four parts; the Check Number (or Source Class), the Year Fraction, the Year, and the Millenium.
当日期用于帝国行政目的时，日期会被进一步扩展为四个部分：校验数（或来源类别）、千分年、年和千年。
Thus a full Imperial Date would be written 0.123.456.M41 or 0123456.M41. To calculate an Imperial date the following method is used:
因此，完整的帝国日期应写为0.123.456.M41或0123456.M41。要推测帝国日期，请使用以下方法：
Check Number 校验数

The check number refers to the accuracy in the date as compared to time on Terra, with 0 being the most accurate and 9 being the least. These numbers are based on the Class of the source of the information. Check numbers are vital based on the temporal distortions the warp can cause on real space.
校验数是指与泰拉上的时间相比，日期的准确性，0表示最准确，9表示最不准确。这些数字基于信息来源的类别。基于亚空间可能对现实空间造成的时间扭曲，校验数至关重要。
0 - Earth Standard Date - The event took place on Terra.
0 - 地球标准日期 - 事件发生在泰拉上。
1 - Earth Standard Date - The event took place within the Sol System.
1 - 地球标准日期 - 事件发生在太阳系内。
2 - Direct - The source was in direct psychic contact with Terra or the Sol system.
2 - 直接 - 源头与泰拉或太阳系有直接的灵能联系。
3 - Indirect - The source was in direct psychic contact with a Class 2 source, but not Terra.
3 - 间接 - 来源与2级来源有直接的灵能联系，但与泰拉没有。
4 - Corroborated - The source was in direct psychic contact with a Class 3 source.
4 - 证实 - 消息来源与3级消息来源有直接的灵能联系。
5 - Sub-corroborated - The source was in direct psychic contact with a Class 4 source.
5 - 次证实 - 消息来源与4级消息来源有直接的灵能联系。

6 - Non-referenced - 1 Year - The source was not in psychic contact with a Class 0-5 source. However it can be linked to a sequence of dates, where one was made in contact with a Class 1-5 source. The maximum period of time seperating this date and the Class 1-5 date is no greater than 1 Year.
6 - 无参考-1年 - 消息来源与0-5级消息来源没有灵能联系。然而，它可以与一系列日期相关联，其中一个日期是与1-5级来源联系的。此日期与1-5级日期之间的最长时间间隔不超过1年。

7 - Non-referenced - 10 Years - The source was not in psychic contact with a Class 0-5 source. However it can be linked to a sequence of dates, where one was made in contact with a Class 1-5 source. The maximum period of time seperating this date and the Class 1-5 date is no greater than 10 Years.
7 - 无参考-10年 - 消息来源与0-5级消息来源没有灵能联系。然而，它可以与一系列日期相关联，其中一个日期是与1-5级来源联系的。此日期与1-5级日期之间的最长时间间隔不超过10年。

8 - Non-referenced - Greater than 10 Years - The source was not in psychic contact with a Class 0-5 source. However it can be linked to a sequence of dates, where one was made in contact with a Class 1-5 source. The period of time seperating this date and the Class 1-5 date is greater than 10 Years.
8 - 无参考-超过10年 - 消息来源与0-5级消息来源没有灵能联系。然而，它可以与一系列日期相关联，其中一个日期是与1-5级来源联系的。该日期与1-5级日期之间的时间间隔大于10年。

9 - Approximated - Class 9 differs from classes 0-8. It is used when reporting from a source that doesn't use the Imperial Dating System, or when using a historical date approximated from a non-Imperial source.
9 - 近似值 - 9级不同于0-8级。它用于从不使用帝国日期系统的来源进行报告，或者使用非帝国来源的近似历史日期。
Year Fraction 千分年
For record-keeping, each year is divided into 1000 equal parts, numbered 000-999. Assuming Julian years (365.25 days each), this makes each part 8 hours, 45 minutes, 57.6 seconds long.
为了记录保存，每年被分为1000个相等的部分，编号为000-999。假设儒略年（每个365.25天），这使得每个部分长8小时45分钟57.6秒。
Year 年
This is the year within the millennium. Years in the millenium start at 001 and run through to 000 or from 000 to 999.
这是千年内的年。千年内的年份从001开始一直到000，或从000到999。
Millennium 千年

This is the millennium in which the event occurred. These begin at the first millenium AD/CE. They are written down with the letter M, followed by the millenial number. For example the years between 2001 and 3000 would become M3.
这是事件发生的千年。这些始于公元/公元后第一个千年。它们以字母M开头，后跟千年数字。例如，2001年至3000年之间的年份将为M3。
Example 示例
Thus an event taking place on Terra at 12:00am January 1st 1998 would be written as 0.000.998.M2. Alternatively the year 1987 could be written simply as 987/M2.
因此，1998年1月1日凌晨12:00在泰拉上发生的事件将被写成0.000.998.M2。或者，1987年可以简单地写成987/M2。
The Chronostrife 时间冲突

Between the end of the Great Crusade and the formation of the Great Rift in the ending stages of the 41st Millennium, a conflict had arisen within the Ordo Chronos on the what the correct date was, with the main five competing factional interpretations ranging in date by around a thousand years and some lesser, more heretical tendencies going further. Roboute Guilliman upon learning of this begun to formulate ideas on how to remedy this.
在大远征结束和第41个千年末期大裂隙形成之间，时间修会内部就正确的日期发生了冲突，主要的五种相互竞争的派系说明的日期相差约一千年，一些较小的、更异端的极端派系则更进一步。罗伯特·基里曼在得知这一点后，开始就如何补救这一点提出想法。
Trivia 琐事

The Anno Domini system used as a base for the Imperial Calendar is never specified. It could be either the Julian or Gregorian calanders. The source refers to "our year 1998" and the "calander we are familiar with", so it is probable that it is referring to the Gregorian calander.
从未指定用作帝国历法的基础的公元系统。它可能是儒略历或公历。该来源提到了“我们1998年”和“我们熟悉的历法”，因此很可能是指公历。

An exact method for breaking the year fraction into 1000 equal parts is not given by in-universe sources, however there are some methods avaliable. All give a year fraction as lasting approximately 8.5 Terran hours.
宇宙中的资料没有给出将年分解为1000个相等部分的确切方法，但有一些方法是可用的。所有这些都给出了千分年，大约持续8.5个泰拉时。
DakkaDakka forum user Makr stated in 2009 that the year fraction could be worked out as follows :
DakkaDakka论坛用户Makr在2009年表示，千分年可以计算如下：
Figure out what day of the year an event is. (For Example 200)
找出一个事件是一年中的哪一天。（例如200）
Multiple that by 24. (For Example 200 x 24 = 4800)
Add the number of hours an event is to that number. (For Example if the event was at 4pm. 4800 + 16 = 4816)
将事件的小时数加到该数字上。（例如，如果事件发生在下午4点。4800+16=4816）
Multiple this by the constant 0.11407955263862231501532129004257 (Giving us 549.407 from our example above)
Round this to the closest full number (549). Thus giving you the year fraction.
四舍五入到最接近的整数（549）。从而提供千分年。

Additional to this Lexicanum user User:307th Artemian noted on 17 February 2015 that Makr's calculation added 24 hours to the number, and thus that you should use the date from 1 day before, then add the hour in the current day.
除此之外，Lexicanum用户User:307th Artemian在2015年2月17日指出，Makr的计算将24小时添加到了这个数字上，因此你应该使用前一天的日期，然后在当天添加小时。

Another Lexicanum user noted on 25 January 2025 that the Constant used by Makr does not account for leap years when converting from the Gregorian calander. 0.11376786 should be used as the constant instead if the year is a leap year.
另一位Lexicanum用户在2025年1月25日指出，Makr使用的常量在从公历转换时不考虑闰年。如果年份是闰年，则应使用0.11376786作为常数。
Conflicting Sources 来源冲突

The Warhammer 40,000 5th Edition Rulebook disagrees with all other sources on whether the years in a millenium run from 000 to 999 or from 001 to 000. All state that they are based upon the Anno Domini system which runs 001-000.
《战锤40k第五版规则书》与所有其他来源不一致，千年中的年是从000到999还是从001到000。所有这些都表示它们基于运行001-000的公元系统。

title: 帝国饮食 Imperium Food
parts: The Imperium is a massive empire spanning the galaxy and as such its numerous subjects make use of all manner of fauna and flora for foodstuffs. As well as food, Imperial worlds produce a variety of drinks.
帝国是一个横跨银河系的庞大帝国，因此其众多臣民利用各种动植物作为食物。除了食物，帝国世界还生产各种饮料。
Food 食物

Within the Imperium, entire worlds are devoted to agriculture and food, providing the necessary sustenance for populations elsewhere in the galaxy. These agri worlds can grow a variety of food in a variety of ways, from the ill-tempered grox that provide meat to simple wheat for bread, with entire continents being given over to the growth of foodstuffs. The most standard type of food grown on Agri-Worlds and subsequently distributed to feed the innumerable masses is processed corn.
在帝国内部，整个世界都致力于农业和粮食，为银河系其他地方的人口提供必要的食物。这些农业世界可以以各种方式种植各种食物，从提供肉类的脾气暴躁的格洛克斯到谷物到面包用小麦，整个大陆都被用于种植食物。在农业世界种植并随后分发给无数平民的最标准的食物类型是加工玉米。

This variety can produce confusion when Imperial cultures mix; in one recorded instance, Tona Criid, a native of Vervunhive on Verghast, mistook camouflage paint for a type of food-paste supplied to the off-world Tanith First regiment.
当帝国文化混合时，这种多样性会产生混乱；在一个有记录的例子中，维尔加斯特上维尔文巢都的当地人托娜·克里德将迷彩漆误认为是供应给世界之外的塔尼斯第一兵团的一种食物膏。
Space Marines have been known to subsist on triglyceride gel and amino-porridge, as well as local wildlife hunted during their firing exercises.
众所周知，星际战士以甘油三酯凝胶和氨基粥为生，也以在射击练习中猎杀的当地野生动物为生。
The Dark Angels are known to consume nutrigruel, carboloafs and vitamead.
众所周知，黑暗天使会食用营养粥、碳块和维生素 。

Mango 芒果

骨髓凝乳 — 蛋白质替代品

Nafar Biscuit - Ration eaten by the Astra Militarum.
那法尔饼干 - 星界军吃的口粮。
Nutrient Gruel - Food rations eaten by many human military forces and impoverished forced labourers of hive cities.
营养粥 — 许多人类军队和巢都城市贫困的强迫劳动者所吃的口粮。
Nutrient Paste - Eaten by Skitarii
营养膏 - 由护教军食用

The Tanith drink a now field-brewed drink known as Sacra, a particularly strong brew. Doomberry Juice has tranquilising effects, but causes nightmares.

木星丝绸干邑 — 极其昂贵的酒。一杯比一个穷人的全部财产更有价值。
Klogfisz — Spirit native to Banjax and brewed from vegetable roots.
克劳格菲兹 — 班贾克斯特有的烈酒，由蔬菜根酿造而成。
Madjack — An ale drank by Space Wolves.
疯杰克 — 太空野狼喝的麦芽酒。
Masteuse — A thick green liqueur.
玛斯图斯 — 一种浓稠的绿色利口酒。
Mama Juana — A mix of rum, red wine and honey combined with the soaked bark of the Eurycoma tree.
胡安娜妈妈 — 朗姆酒、红酒和蜂蜜的混合，再加上浸泡过的东革阿里树树皮。
Mjød — Commonly consumed by Space Wolves.
