塔纳茶 - 来自瓦尔哈拉的一种非常浓的茶，被描述为一种已获得的味道。
Tea - Presumably the analog of the standard tea.
茶 - 大概是标准茶的类似物。
Olicet tea 奥利塞特茶
Solian tea 索利安茶
Tisane 草药茶
Non-Imperial Foodstuffs 非帝国食品

It is known that some non-Imperial foods are edible by humans, or at least Astartes. Eldar food is known to have been consumed by the Marines of the Emperor's Children Space Marine Legion. This may indicate compatibility of the human body with Eldar food, just Astartes physiology (being enhanced as it is), or that the Eldar simply knew what humans found palatable as food.
众所周知，一些非帝国食物可以供人类食用，或者至少是阿斯塔特。众所周知，灵族食物曾被帝皇之子星际战士军团的战士食用。这可能表明人体与灵族食物的相容性，只是阿斯塔特生理（尽管它是增强的），或者灵族只是知道人类认为什么是美味的食物。
Xenos-cultured wheat is also not unknown, though illegal.
异型种植的小麦也并不陌生，尽管是非法的。
The Tau have been known to use nim ko’nai as rations.
众所周知，钛人使用尼姆·科'奈作为口粮。
Orks are known to eat other Orkoid Fungus-based lifeforms such as Squigs but they also drink fungus-beer and other liquors made by ork Brewboyz.
众所周知，欧克会吃其他以欧克真菌为基础的生命形式，如史古格，但它们也会喝真菌啤酒和其他由欧克酿酒小子酿造的酒。

title: 无束阿斯塔特统治 The Reign of the Astartes Unfettered
parts: The Reign of the Astartes Unfettered was an era the Imperium would have entered, if Warmaster Horus had been victorious in the Siege of Terra.
如果战帅荷鲁斯在泰拉围城中获胜，帝国将进入一个无束阿斯塔特统治时代。
Description 描述

According to the Iron Warrior Ortag Theokon, the era would see the Imperium reconstructed, so that it was free of the Emperor's influence. Thus allowing the Imperium to be maintained without lies or compromsies. However, the Reign of the Astartes Unfettered did not come to pass, after Warmaster Horus was killed and the Emperor emerged victorious in the Siege of Terra.
根据钢铁勇士奥尔塔格·西奥康的说法，这个时代将看到帝国的重建，使其不受帝皇的影响。因此，帝国得以在没有谎言或妥协的情况下得以维持。然而，在战帅荷鲁斯被杀，帝皇在泰拉围城中获胜后，无束阿斯塔特统治没有实现。

title: 麻醉药物 Narcotics
parts: Narcotics are addictive, illegal substances used for their pleasurable side-effects, as opposed to combat drugs and stimms which are used to strengthen the body and mind for battle. Narcotics can be ingested in a variety of forms, most notably inhaled by smoking or injected directly into the bloodstream. Some narcotics share both methods, or  take on other forms of use entirely. Smokable forms are commonly kept in paper cylinders, much like a common cigarette, and are ingested using an igniter and a form of filter. Injected versions are held in injector vials or other forms of containment. Narcotics are known to take the form of rocks, glass, plants, gases, and liquids.

麻醉药物是一种令人上瘾的非法物质，因其令人愉快的副作用而被使用，与之相对的是用于增强身心战斗力的战斗药物和兴奋剂。麻醉药物可以以多种形式摄入，最明显的是通过吸入或直接注射到血液中。一些麻醉药物共享这两种方法，或者完全采用其他形式的使用。可吸入的形式通常保存在纸筒中，就像普通的香烟一样，使用点火器和某种形式的过滤器摄入。注射版本保存在注射器小瓶或其他形式的容器中。众所周知，麻醉药物的形式有块、晶、植物、气体和液体。
History 历史

Since the dawn of time, humanity has used narcotics to alter their physical or psychological state; a truth that has persisted into the 41st Millennium. The most common mind-altering substance is lho-leaf. Easy to obtain, the stick version (which is lit and inhaled via filters) is popular among the Imperium citizenry and military (in the case of the Imperial Guard and the various PDFs). Obscura is another widely used narcotic, illegal, and commonly used by the middle and upper-class citizens of hives in obscura dens. The enforcement of drug control falls upon planetary authorities, though Inquisition can become involved if it becomes a widespread problem.
自古以来，人类就使用麻醉药物来改变自己的身体或心理状态；这一真相一直延续到第41个千年。最常见的改变思维的物质是罗叶。易于获得的棒状版本（通过过滤器点燃和吸入）在帝国平民和军队中很受欢迎（就帝国卫队和各种PDF而言）。朦胧是另一种广泛使用的麻醉药物，是非法的，通常由朦胧窝点中巢都的中上层平民使用。毒品管制的执行落在了行星当局的肩上，尽管如果成为一个普遍的问题，审判庭可能会介入其中。
Known Narcotics 已知麻醉药物
Admylladox - Pain-killing and mind clearing drug.
阿德米拉多克斯 - 止痛和思维清晰药物。
Black Lethe - A highly addictive drug used throughout the Imperium.
黑勒忒 - 一种在整个帝国中使用的高度上瘾的药物。
Chlorintone - Sedative drug. Used to slow down an enemy's metabolism, subduing them completely.
氯宁 - 镇静药物。用来减缓敌人的新陈代谢，完全制服他们。

Clear - A gum made from a plant native to Monrass in the Drusus Marches, clear allows the user to ingest large amounts of alcohol or poison with little to no effect. It is harshly bitter and causes a powerful migraine upon wearing off.
透明 - 一种由德鲁苏斯边区蒙拉斯原生植物制成的口香糖，透明可以让使用者摄入大量酒精或药物，几乎没有效果。它非常苦，一用完就会引起剧烈的偏头痛。
Cotin - Mild recreational narcotic.
科廷 - 轻度娱乐性麻醉药物。
Crash - Illegal drug. Highly addictive, lethal cocktail of 'slaaght and spur, filled with various impurities, that enhances physical and mental endurance for short periods.
碰撞 - 非法毒品。高度上瘾的致命鸡尾酒，含有各种杂质，能在短时间内增强身心耐力。
Crystal Ersatz - A drug known to cause the development of advanced mathematical abilities and good memory to the growing child if used during pregnancy.
仿制晶体 - 一种已知的药物，如果在怀孕期间使用，可以促进发育中的孩子的高级数学能力和良好记忆力。
De-Tox - A legal drug used to negate the effects of other drugs, toxins, and gases. De-Tox is administered via injector, and has painful and debilitating side-effects.
解毒剂 - 一种合法药物，用于抵消其他药物、毒素和瓦斯的影响。解毒剂通过注射器给药，具有疼痛和衰弱的副作用。
Doomberry - A narcotic with tranquilizing effects usually prepared as juice.
末日莓 - 一种具有镇静作用的麻醉药物，通常制成果汁。

Dreamjuice - A clear, bitter liquid that with psychotropic effects which is a popular recreational drug upon Archaos in the Drusus Marches. Dreamjuice is used by psykers of the Ordo Malleus to dulls the users' resistance to interrogation.
梦幻果汁 - 一种清澈、苦涩的液体，具有精神作用，是德鲁苏斯边区中阿契厄斯的一种流行娱乐药物。圣锤修会的灵能者使用梦幻果汁来减弱使用者对审讯的抵抗力。
Dreamstimm - A narcotic used upon Imperial Navy vessels.
梦幻兴奋剂 - 帝国海军舰艇上使用的麻醉药物。
Eazielle - A powerful inhibition reducer used by hive nobles of the Drusus Marches, the effects of Eazielle or 'Eaze' are amplified upon repeated use. It is rumoured to be alien in origin.
伊泽尔 - 一种强大的抑制剂，由德鲁苏斯边区的巢都贵族使用，反复使用后，伊泽尔或“埃泽”的效果会增强。据传它起源于异型。

Fervor - A drug used by a small group of Redemption Cults in the Calixis Sector to induct new members. It allows the user to move with unnatural grace and flexibility for a short time. Fervor is administered directly into the bloodstream via autoinjector.
狂热 - 卡利西斯星区一小群救赎教派用来吸纳新成员的药物。它允许使用者在短时间内以不自然的优雅和灵活性移动。狂热通过自动注射器直接注入血液。

Flects - Small shards of dirty glass wrapped in red paper; staring into them gives a glimpse of a reflection which grants a euphoric high. Flects are chaos-tainted, highly addictive and illegal on most Imperial worlds.
弯曲 — 用红纸包裹的脏晶碎片；凝视着它们，可以瞥见一种反射，给人一种狂喜的快感。在大多数帝国世界，弯曲都是混沌污染的、高度上瘾的和非法的。

Ghast - A highly profitable narcotic deprived from corpse starch which can awaken the psychic potential of the user. Used on Necromunda by House Delaque to create its psyker agents. Ghast may or may not be another name for Spook.
恶魂 - 一种从尸体淀粉中提取的高利润麻醉药物，可以唤醒使用者的灵能潜力。德拉克家族在涅克罗蒙达上使用它来制造灵能者特工。恶魂可能是也可能不是幽灵的另一个名字。
Gladstones - Small, smooth, psychically reactive stones which elicit a feeling of euphoria and well-being lasting multiple days. Used by placing under the tongue.
欢欣石 - 小而光滑的、具有灵能反应的石头，能引发持续数天的兴奋感和幸福感。放在舌头下面使用。
Golconda - A mild narcotic sometimes taken with Firewine.
戈尔康达 - 一种温和的麻醉药物，有时与火酒一起服用。
Grinweed - A cheap, illegal narcotic made of a plant of unknown origin. Can be smoked, ingested, or rendered into a bitter tea.
研磨杂草 - 一种由来源不明的植物制成的廉价非法麻醉药物。可以熏制、摄入或制成苦茶。
Holdfast - An illegal, bluish liquid drug originating from Elros, which when injected causes the user to be extremely stubborn. Referred to as 'Puremind' on the hives of Samson IV.
坚守 - 一种源自埃尔洛斯的非法蓝色液体药物，注射后会导致使用者非常固执。在萨姆森四号的巢都上被称为“纯洁思维”。
Idea - A low-grade drug used by poor citizens of planet Persana which elicits a euphoric high often accompanied by impulsive acts of violence. Idea can be taken in liquid form or by inhaler.
想法 - 一种低级药物，由佩尔萨纳行星上的贫困平民使用，可引发狂喜的快感，通常伴随着冲动的暴力行为。想法可以以液体形式或通过吸入器服用。
Kalma - A group of euphoric sedative drugs produced in the Underhives of Necromunda which lowers the user's state of consciousness.
卡尔玛 - 一组在涅克罗蒙达下巢中生产的令人狂喜的止痛药物，可以降低使用者的意识状态。
Klaava - A weak narcotic, similar to caffeine but with the inverse effect; a weak depressant.
克拉瓦 - 一种弱麻醉药物，类似于咖啡因，但具有相反的效果；弱镇静剂。
Klay - A military stimulant used by Astra Militarum to sharpen senses and improve recall.
克莱 - 星界军使用的一种军用兴奋剂，用于增强感官和提高记忆力。
Kyxa - An expensive, mild narcotic and aphrodisiac extracted from plants in the Ultima Segmentum. Kyxa is smoked.
凯克萨 - 一种从极限星域植物中提取的昂贵、温和的麻醉药物和壮阳药。凯克萨是吸入的。

Lacrymata - An expensive narcotic, perfume and aphrodisiac distilled from a rare flower grown underground upon Salome Nigra, the essential oil of which is also a deadly poison. Lacrymata is also referred to as moonskin.
泪滴 - 一种昂贵的麻醉药物、香水和壮阳药，从莎乐美·尼格拉地下生长的一种稀有花朵中蒸馏而成，其精油也是一种致命的毒药。泪滴也被称为月肤。

Lho Stick - A popular Imperial narcotic, much like a cigarette, made of a rolled paper tube containing a scented plant-derived substance. The tube is lit and the resultant smoke inhaled through it, causing a mildly narcotic sensation. Lho-sticks are addictive and are common amongst the Imperial Guard and menial workers.
罗叶棒 - 一种流行的帝国麻醉药物，很像香烟，由一个含有芳香植物来源物质的纸卷制而成。管子被点燃，产生的烟雾通过它吸入，引起轻微的麻醉感。罗叶棒容易上瘾，在帝国卫队和卑微的工人中很常见。
Morphia - A medical drug, phials of morphia are included in Guardmen-issue med-packs.
吗啡 - 一种药物，吗啡的小瓶包含在发放给的卫兵的医疗包中。
Obscura - An illegal, highly addictive narcotic used widely throughout the Imperium. Obscura can be smoked or directly injected into the bloodstream to produce a pleasant, dreamlike high.
朦胧 - 一种非法的、高度上瘾的麻醉药物，在整个帝国广泛使用。朦胧可以吸入或直接注射到血液中，以产生愉快、梦幻般的快感。
Opiatix 奥匹阿提克斯
Penshel Seeds - A very mild stimulant that have fallen into near-disuse. They are an old favourite in the artists' quarter of Dorsay. The seeds are dried, rolled, and smoked in pipes.
彭舍尔种子 - 一种非常温和的兴奋剂，几乎已经废弃。它们是多赛艺术家群体的老宠儿。种子在管里晒干、卷起和吸入。
Qash - A toxic and potent drug used during the early period of the Imperium.
卡什 - 帝国早期使用的一种有毒强效药物。
Redux - A powerful psychoactive drug which causes user to repeat their last action until the effects wear off.
瑞达克斯 - 一种强效的精神活性药物，可以让使用者重复他们的最后一个动作，直到效果消失。
Sisk Ash - An illegal drug made from the ash of a bushplant on Sisk which produces a relaxed and calm state when mixed with lho and smoked. It has a distinctive sweet and cloying scent.
西斯克灰 - 一种非法药物，由西斯克上的一种灌木植物的灰烬制成，与罗叶混合并吸入时会产生放松和平静的状态。它有一种独特的甜腻气味。
Sleeper - A narcotic used in the hives of Alecto.
沉睡者 - 一种用于阿勒克图巢都的麻醉药物。

Sniff-Musk - Another little understood psycho-active drug. It is inhaled through the nose as a inhalant gas. It is usually concentrated and may be able to be utilized in an injection style ingestion. There are various purities ranging from cheap, dangerous concentrations to expensive, "pure" doses. The effect is has is relatively unknown, except that it alters the users mind-state and is deemed illegal by the Imperium. It is generally understood that sniff-musk is frequented among wealthy aristocrats, much like obscura.
嗅麝香 — 另一种鲜为人知的精神活性药物。它作为吸入气体通过鼻子吸入。它通常是浓缩的，可以用于注射式摄入。有各种纯度，从廉价、危险的浓度到昂贵的“纯粹”剂量。其效果相对未知，只是它改变了使用者的精神状态，并被帝国视为非法。人们普遍认为，嗅麝香在富裕的贵族中很常见，就像朦胧一样。

Somna - A potent drug which induces a coma-like state in the user, causing them to appear deceased. Created from the pollen extract of the Nephyis Orchix on Iocanthos. May or may not be another name for Tyche's Kiss.
索姆纳 - 一种强效药物，可诱导使用者出现类似昏迷的状态，使他们看起来已经死亡。由伊欧坎索斯上的尼菲斯·奥奇克斯花粉提取物制成。可能是也可能不是堤喀之吻的另一个名字。

Spook - An addictive and highly illegal psychic drug manufactured in Necromunda. The drug is created from decayed synthdiet found beneath the hive cities. Spook may or may not be another name for Ghast.
幽灵 - 一种在涅克罗蒙达制造的令人上瘾且高度非法的精神药物。这种药物是由下巢发现的腐烂的合成饮食制成的。幽灵可能是也可能不是恶魂的另一个名字。
Tabac - Smoked in the form of a stick.
塔巴克 - 以棒的形式吸食。
Topaz - A narcotic-stimulant used in the hives of Alecto.
托帕 - 一种麻醉兴奋剂，用于阿勒克图巢都。
Torpor - A chemical cocktail used to inhibit psychic powers and render the subject docile, used aboard the Black Ships and by some Inquisitors.
麻痹 - 一种化学鸡尾酒，用于抑制灵能力量，使受试者变得温顺，在黑船上和一些审判官使用。
Tox-Jack - A drug used in the toxic ammunition loaded into needle pistols in the Calixis Sector, derived from industrial coolant.
毒杰克 - 一种从工业冷却剂中提取的药物，用于卡利西斯星区装入针刺手枪的有毒弹药。

Tyche's Kiss - A poison which paralyzes the user; causing them to appear deceased. Tyche's Kiss is created by grinding the seed pods of a particular species of blood-red orchid. May or may not be another name for Somna.
堤喀之吻 - 一种使使用者瘫痪的毒药；导致他们看起来已经死亡。堤喀之吻是通过研磨一种特定血红兰花的种子荚而制成的。可能是也可能不是索姆纳的另一个名字。
Weirdroot - A narcotic which is smoked to elicit potent hallucinations.
怪异根 - 一种麻醉药物，吸食后会引起强烈的幻觉。
Wildfire - A black crystal which combusts and triggers a surge of fury, strength and speed when chewed. Used by the Scorching Creed chaos cult on Redemption.
野火 - 一种黑色晶体，咀嚼时会燃烧并引发愤怒、力量和速度的激增。救赎星中的灼热信条混沌教派使用。
Yellodes - Slang name for a prohibited stimm, a mood enhancer. Usually found in the form of small, yellow pills.
耶洛德斯 - 禁止刺激的俚语，一种情绪增强剂。通常以黄色小药丸的形式出现。

title: 硅基知灵 Silica Animus
parts: A Silica Animus, more commonly known as Abominable Intelligence or A.I., is a piece of technology forbidden within the Imperium that involves the creation of an artifical mind.
硅基知灵，通常被称为憎恶智能或A.I.，是帝国内部禁止的一项技术，涉及创造人工思维。
Overview 概述

During the Dark Age of Technology, these intelligences rebelled against their human masters, leading to bloody wars. Since that time, and by a personal decree of the Emperor himself, it has been forbidden to fabricate or service those machines that are able to think and act independently. Due to their materialist logic, Silica Animus are especially vulnerable to Chaos corruption, seeing in Daemons only a powerful resource to be exploited and not noticing the taint that consequently inevitably overtakes the machine's mind.
在黑暗技术时代，这些智能反抗他们的人类主人，导致了血腥的战争。从那时起，根据帝皇本人的个人法令，禁止制造或维修那些能够独立思考和行动的机器。由于他们的唯物主义逻辑，硅基知灵特别容易受到混沌腐化的影响，在恶魔身上只看到一种可以利用的强大资源，而没有注意到不可避免地占据机器思维的污染。
The Silica Animus is not to be mistaken for the machine spirit that has parallels but basal differences - namely, no ability to enhance itself.
硅基知灵不应被误认为是机魂，它们有相似之处，但有基本差异，即没有自我提升的能力。
Views of the Adeptus Mechanicus 机械神教的观点

The Adeptus Mechanicus abhor Abominable Intelligence and believe it to be tech-heresy. A device without a machine spirit is but a shell, however, if it contains an animating intelligent force, it is no longer technology that can be trusted and relied upon. As such, it is no longer part of the Omnissiah's great plan and is damnation made manifest. Regardless, there are those within the Adeptus Mechanicus, Dark Mechanicum, or other hereteks that still meddle in its creation.
机械神教憎恨憎恶智能，认为这是技术异端。没有机魂的设备只是一个空壳，然而，如果它包含一种有生命的的智能力量，它就不再是可以信任和依赖的技术。因此，它不再是万机神伟大计划的一部分，而是诅咒的体现。不管怎样，机械神教、黑暗机械教或其他异端内部仍有人干涉其创造。

According to the traditions of the Adeptus Mechanicus, such creations are unholy constructs that are inherently evil and perverted abominations in the eyes of the Omnissiah. Furthermore, the Cult Mechanicus states that such constructs possess a Machine Spirit that is a twisted mockery of a Man's soul as well as being both treacherous and insane. There exist apocryphal stories within the ancient texts that are shrouded in metaphor which speak of the murderous and powerful Silica Animus creations that existed during the Dark Age of Technology. At that black moment in Mankind's history known as the Age of Strife, there existed legions of "iron children" which served the artificial minds of the Silica Animus, who are blamed in part for the many horrific wars that existed in that lost time. It is said that towards the end of the M23, Mankind was almost destroyed by its own technological innovations.

根据机械神教的传统，这样的创造是邪恶的构造，在万机神眼中，它们本质上是邪恶和堕落的可憎之物。此外，机械教派指出，这种构造支配了一个机魂，是对人类灵魂的扭曲嘲弄，既危险又疯狂。古代文献中存在着被隐喻笼罩的杜撰故事，这些故事讲述了黑暗技术时代存在的凶残而强大的硅基知灵造物。在人类历史上被称为“纷争时代”的那个黑暗时刻，有大批“铁嗣”为硅基知灵的人工思维服务，他们在一定程度上被指责为在那个失落的时间里发生的许多可怕的战争的罪魁祸首。据说，在M23接近尾声时，人类几乎被自己的技术创造所摧毁。

In the aftermath of the Age of Strife the Mechanicus passed the Crimson Accords of Mars which forbade the development of advanced A.I. and put a death sentence on any remaining Silica Animus constructs as well as any who developed them.
在纷争时代之后，机械教通过了《火星深红协议》，该协议禁止开发先进的A.I.，并对任何剩余的硅基知灵构造体以及开发它们的人判处死刑。
The secrets for the creation of such artificial intelligences is one of the many pieces of technology that is being sought by the Logicians cult.
创造这种人工智能的秘密是逻辑学家教派所寻求的众多技术之一。

title: 标准模板构造 Standard Template Construct
parts: The Standard Template Construct (STC) systems were artificial intelligences created during the Dark Age of Technology (M21 - M23). They are said to have contained the entirety of human technological knowledge up to that point. Following the Dark Age of Technology, the systems became increasingly rare, until becoming lost entirely. In the current Age of the Imperium, the ancient technological knowledge survives only because it was preserved in STC hard copies.
标准模板构造（STC）系统是在黑暗技术时代（M21-M23）创建的人工智能。据说，到那时为止，它们已经包含了人类所有的技术知识。在黑暗技术时代之后，这些系统变得越来越罕见，直到完全消失。在当前的帝国时代，古代技术知识之所以幸存下来，只是因为它被保存在STC的硬拷贝中。
The STC core at the heart of House Van Saar's stronghold in Necromunda's Hive Primus STC核心位于凡·萨尔家族在涅克罗蒙达的一号巢都的据点的中心
Description 描绘

An intact STC system is described as a "machine, a vast device made of brilliant white ceramics, silver piping, chromium chambers". The Constructor is controlled by a panel beside it, with amber lights to show its activation. When activated, cowlings near the floor vent steam. When a new creation is finished, a hatch on its side opens up to allow the creation to be retrieved.
一个完整的STC系统被描述为“机器，一个由明亮的白色陶瓷、银色管道、铬室组成的巨大装置”。构造器由其旁边的面板控制，琥珀色灯显示其激活状态。激活后，地板附近的整流罩会排出蒸汽。当新创建完成时，其侧面会打开，以允许检索创建。

STCs come in all shapes and sizes, with many not even being machines at all but rather simple blueprints or pieces of fragmented digital data. Others are huge mechanical constructs that can hold an array of construction templates while directly producing working operational prototypes. STCs seem to have some degree of artificial intelligence, as the construct on Necromunda orchestrated a series of industrial sabotage actions against House Hera after they unwittingly launched a hacking attack against it.
STC有各种形状和大小，其中许多甚至根本不是机器，而是简单的蓝图或零碎的数字数据。其他一些是巨大的机械结构，可以容纳一系列结构模板，同时直接生产可工作的操作原型。STC似乎具有一定程度的人工智能，因为涅克罗蒙达上的构造在赫拉家族无意中对其发动黑客攻击后，策划了一系列针对赫拉家族的工业破坏行动。
History 历史

The Dark Age of Technology saw the original development of the technology the Imperium is now reliant on, which was encapsulated into the STC systems. Along with the creation of Warp Drive technology and the human mutants known as Navigators, the STC systems were one of the major factors in mankind's expansion outside the solar system and his conquest of the stars. The STC system allowed disparate mankind to maintain a standard level of technology. A complete, functioning STC system was an evolved computer designed to provide construction details for human colonists, enabling them to build efficient shelters, generators and transports without any prior knowledge and using almost any locally available materials. For example, a user could simply ask how to build a house or a tractor and the computer would supply all the necessary plans.

黑暗技术时代见证了帝国现在所依赖的技术的最初发展，该技术被封装在STC系统中。随着亚空间驱动技术和被称为导航者的人类变种人的发明，STC系统是人类在太阳系外扩张和征服群星的主要因素之一。STC系统允许不同的人类保持标准的技术水平。一个完整、功能齐全的STC系统是一种进化的计算机，旨在为人类殖民者提供构造细节，使他们能够在没有任何先验知识的情况下，使用几乎任何当地可用的材料，建造高效的庇护所、发电机和运输工具。例如，使用者只需询问如何建造房屋或牵引车，计算机就会提供所有必要的计划。
The Age of Strife 纷争时代

During the Age of Strife, the STC systems lapsed into disuse and decayed, becoming increasingly unreliable and quirky. On some worlds they were maintained, but most suffered damage by enthusiastic software specialists or subsequent jury-rigging. Hard copies of the information they contained survived much longer, and were frequently copied and passed down from generation to generation.
在纷争时代，STC系统逐渐被废弃和衰弱，变得越来越不可靠和古怪。在一些世界上，它们得到了维护，但大多数都受到了热忱的软件专家或随后的临时拼凑的破坏。它们所包含的信息的硬拷贝保存的时间要长得多，并且经常被复制并代代相传。

Some Imperial historians have theorised that scientists during the Age of Technology foresaw the coming of the Age of Strife, and created the STCs to ensure that their knowledge would not be lost to future generations.
一些帝国历史学家提出理论，认为科技时代的科学家预见到了纷争时代的到来，并创建了STC，以确保他们的知识不会被后代遗失。
The Age of the Imperium 帝国时代

In the Age of the Imperium, working STC systems are practically unknown. The recovery of fragments of an STC or the templates used in one is the primary focus of the Adeptus Mechanicus's quest for knowledge. Part of this quest is also to find, collate and utilise STC print-outs. A functioning STC system is their equivalent to a font of all knowledge (which is exactly what it was intended to be). Ancient recovered print-outs from STC systems are regarded as sacred texts. The Mechanicus strives to recover as much information as possible from them, hoping to find new knowledge, weapons and technologies.
在帝国时代，工作的STC系统几乎是未知的。恢复STC的片段或其中使用的模板是机械神教寻求知识的主要重点。这项任务的一部分也是查找、整理和利用STC打印输出。一个正常运作的STC系统相当于所有知识的字模（这正是它的本意）。从STC系统中恢复的古代印刷被视为神圣的文本。机械教努力从他们那里恢复尽可能多的信息，希望找到新的知识、武器和技术。

Probably the most significant find of an STC fragment was by Magos Arkhan Land in M31. This fragment contained the templates for the construction of the now famous Land Raider Main Battle Tank, and the Land Speeder, all named in honour of their discoverer. An intact, functional STC is so rare in the galaxy as to be regarded as almost mythical. Nevertheless, even a rumour that such a system has been found is enough to prompt a Mechanicus expedition to locate it.
STC碎片最重要的发现可能是M31的贤者阿坎·兰德。这个碎片包含了建造现在著名的兰德掠袭者战斗坦克和兰德速攻艇的模板，所有这些都是为了纪念它们的发现者而命名的。完整、功能齐全的STC在银河系中非常罕见，几乎被视为神话。然而，即使有传言说已经发现了这样一个系统，也足以促使机械教探索队找到它。
According to Mars' archives, Archmagos Dominus Cawl has recovered more STC patterns than any other Magos in history.
根据火星的档案，神圣大贤者考尔比历史上任何其他贤者都恢复了更多的STC模版。
Leagues of Votann 沃坦联盟

The Leagues of Votann share a common Human ancestry with the Imperium, and as a result their original mining fleets dispatched to the Galactic Core during the Long March possessed a large number of sophisticated STCs. The Votann are able to utilize these STCs to produce a variety of war engines and other types of equipment. Unlike the Imperials, the Votann will improve upon STC designs and use multiple STCs to craft new systems, such as the Sagitaur ATV.
沃坦联盟与帝国有着共同的人类祖先，因此，他们在长征期间派往银河系核心的原初采矿舰队拥有大量复杂的STC。沃坦能够利用这些STC生产各种战争引擎和其他类型的设备。与帝国不同，沃坦将改进STC设计，并使用多个STC来制造新系统，如人马座ATV。
Ork 欧克

It is speculated by Imperial scholars that at a point in the ancient past, the then-dominant Brain Boyz developed their own "Ork Standard Construction Templates" to which much of Ork technology owes its origin. However, these legendary speculative STCs, if they existed, have been lost to time.
帝国学者推测，在古代的某个时刻，当时占主导地位的聪明小子开发了自己的“欧克标准构建模板”，欧克技术的大部分都起源于此。然而，这些传说中的猜测STC（如果存在的话）已经随着时间的推移而消失了。
Significant STC discoveries 标志性的STC发现

In M30, the STC designs for the Baal Predator were discovered on the planet of Atium III within the ruins of Arch-Heretek Lord de Ladt’s fortress by the Blood Angels Space Marine Legion. The Blood Angels refused to hand this STC over to the Adeptus Mechancius and it is currently still stored on the Blood Angel's homeworld of Baal.
在M30，巴尔掠食者的STC设计是由圣血天使星际战士军团在阿特姆三号行星上的大技术异端领主的拉特堡垒的废墟中发现的。圣血天使拒绝将这个STC交给机械神教，目前它仍存储在圣血天使的家园世界巴尔。

Sometime in M31, the Magos Arkhan Land discovered within the Librarius Omnis the STCs for Land's Raider-Pattern Main Battle Tank, Land's Crawler multi-purpose heavy utility vehicle, the Mars Universal Land Engine (the basis of the Onager Dunecrawler), and the information on rare anti-gravitic plates used in Land's Speeder, all of which are named after him.
在M31的某个时候，贤者阿坎·兰德在全知智库内发现了用于兰德掠袭者型主战坦克、兰德爬行者多目标重型多用途载具、火星通用兰德引擎（野驴沙丘爬行者的基础）的STC，以及兰德速攻艇中使用的罕见反重力板的信息，所有这些都是以他的名字命名的。

During the Great Crusade, the STC for the Leman Russ Battle Tank was discovered by the Space Wolves after they had destroyed the Noman xenos. They named the fruits of the STC in honour of their Primarch.
在大远征期间，黎曼·鲁斯战斗坦克的STC被太空野狼在摧毁了诺曼异型后发现。他们为STC的果实命名，以纪念他们的原体。
After the Battle of Sixty-Three Nineteen, 3 new STCs were recovered from the planet Sixty-Three Nineteen by the Luna Wolves Astartes Legion.
在63-19之战之后，影月苍狼阿斯塔特圣典军团从63-19行星上回收了3个新的STC。

Two STC fragments were captured from the Auretian Technocracy by the Warmaster Horus Lupercal prior to his rebellion against the Imperium. One for a new pattern of power armour, the other for lightweight solar generators capable of "supplying the power needs of an Epsilon 5 pattern forge complex".This technology was gifted to the Fabricator-General of Mars at the time, Kelbor-Hal, to secure his loyalty for the rebellion. The Technocracy had fully functional STC machines, although they were destroyed to prevent the Sons of Horus from capturing them.
在反抗帝国之前，战帅荷鲁斯·卢佩卡尔从奥瑞提安技术联盟手中缴获了两个STC碎片。一种用于新型动力盔甲，另一种用于能够“满足艾普西隆5型铸造厂能量需求”的轻型太阳能发电机。这项技术被赠送给当时的火星铸造将军凯尔博·哈尔，以确保他对叛乱的忠诚。技术联盟拥有功能齐全的STC机械，尽管它们被摧毁以防止荷鲁斯之子夺取它们。
During the period known as "The Forging" in M32, a valuable STC database was rediscovered in the Cana System.
在M32中被称为“大锻造”的时期，在卡纳星系中重新发现了一个有价值的STC数据库。

In the end of the Icaria Crusade in M35, an ancient factory complex with databanks from the Dark Age of Technology was located on Fornost by the Frateris Templars. The church bartered the knowledge of the location of these databanks in exchange for exclusive rights to any technologies stored within them. While the databanks only had half-formed STCs for a flame thrower equipped tank, these STCs were combined with the STC for the Rhino to create the Immolator subpattern.
在M35的伊卡利亚远征结束时，圣堂兄弟会在佛诺斯特建立了一个拥有黑暗技术时代数据库的古老工厂建筑群。教会交换了这些数据库的位置信息，以换取存储在其中的任何技术的专有权。虽然数据库中只有配备火焰喷射器的坦克的半成型STC，但这些STC与犀牛的STC相结合，创建了献祭者子型号。
During the War of Recovery in 104.M36, several first generation copies of STC databases concerning certain individual technologies were recovered on the planets of the Mortuam Chain.
在104.M36的恢复战争期间，在亡者星链的行星上恢复了几个关于某些个人技术的STC数据库的第一代副本。
In M36, the STCs for weapon suits known as the XV Bellam Ravager and Thermae Missile Suit were discovered by the Adeptus Mechanicus, but proved too difficult to reproduce.
在M36，被称为XV贝拉姆掠夺者和浴场导弹机甲的STC被机械神教发现，但事实证明很难复制。
In M36, the STC for a larger chassis of Land Speeder was discovered; this would be used to create the Land Speeder Vengeance and Darkshroud variants.
在M36，发现了兰德速攻艇更大底盘的STC；这将被用于创建兰德速攻艇复仇和黑暗寿衣变体。
Following the Age of Apostasy the Centurion STC was discovered.
叛教时代之后，百夫长STC被发现。
Between 322.M39 - 384.M39, STC database fragments, known as the "Aegis Data Fragments", were discovered in the Calixis Sector during the Angevin Crusade.
在322.M39-384.M39之间，在安茹远征期间，在卡利西斯星区发现了STC数据库碎片，称为“宙斯盾数据碎片”。
Sometime prior to 189887.M39, Archmagos Plosk recovered five first-generation STC printouts.
在189887.M39之前的某个时候，大贤者普洛斯克恢复了五个一代STC打印输出。

In 189887.M39, a complete STC database was discovered within the pre-Imperium void ship Spirit of Eternity. Despite resistance from the STC's A.I., Archmagos Plosk was able to download a significant fraction of the STC database before the ship managed to escape. This was an uncorrupted A.I., but it was insane with grief over the death of its captain.
189887.M39年，在帝国前的虚空舰永恒之魂号中发现了一个完整的STC数据库。尽管STC的A.I.存在反抗，大贤者普洛斯克还是能够在舰船设法逃脱之前下载STC数据库的很大一部分。这是一个没有腐化的人工智能，但它对船长的去世感到非常悲痛。
In M39, the STC template for the Omega Pattern Plasma Blastgun was discovered by Explorator Magos Valistle Hum'nal.
在M39，探索贤者瓦利斯尔·胡姆'纳尔发现了欧米伽型等离子爆破枪的STC模板。

Sometime in M40, the STC for improved jet engines was discovered by the Dark Angels, and named the "Lionheart" engine. These were used to create the Nephilim Jetfighter. The Dark Angels refuse to hand this STC over to the Adeptus Mechanicus.
在M40的某个时候，黑暗天使发现了改进喷气发动机的STC，并将其命名为“狮心”引擎。这些被用来制造拿非利喷气式战斗机。黑暗天使拒绝将这个STC交给机械神教。

Prior to 775.M41, an STC for a combat knife was discovered by two Imperial Guard Scouts that was "sharper and lighter and tougher." They were hailed as heroes for this discovery, and received a planet each. The knife was adopted by 30 chapters of the Adeptus Astartes.
在775.M41之前，两名帝国卫队侦察兵发现了一把战斗刀的STC，它“更锋利、更轻便、更坚固”。他们被誉为这一发现的英雄，并各自获得了一颗行星。这把刀被阿斯塔特修会的30个战团所采用。

Between 775.M41 - 778.M41, a Standard Template Constructor, designed to produce the legendary Men of Iron, was discovered on the planet Menazoid Epsilon, during the Sabbat Worlds Crusade by Colonel-Commissar Ibram Gaunt. However, the Constructor had been corrupted by the long-time occupation of the planet by the forces of Chaos, and so Gaunt ordered it destroyed, inadvertently thwarting the plans of Lord Militant Hechtor Dravere and Radical Inquisitor Golesh Heldane to use the Men of Iron for their own advancement.
在775.M41-778.M41之间，在安息日世界远征期间，伊布拉姆·冈特团长政委在梅纳佐德艾普西隆行星上发现了一个标准模板构造，旨在制造传说中的铁人。然而，构造器已经被混沌势力长期占领行星所腐化，因此冈特下令将其摧毁，无意中挫败了军务领主赫克托·德拉维尔和激进派审判官戈莱什·赫尔德恩利用铁人来为自己的发展的计划。
In 992.M41, the STCs for most of the Astraeus Super-heavy Tank were recovered by the Minotaurs chapter Astartes during the Perun Cross Incident.
992M41年，在佩伦十字事件期间，米诺陶战团的阿斯塔特回收了阿斯特赖俄斯超重型坦克的STC的大部分。
In 992.M41 began the Scouring of Johan's Eden, resulting in the recovery of three STCs.
992.M41，开始了对约翰伊甸园的清洗，导致三个STC被追回。

In 999.M41, an original STC Titan, a "Castigor-class autonomous bipedal weapons platform, created for fire support and siege operations", was discovered on the planet Chaeroneia. It was quite larger than an Imperator Titan and of superior technology. The Titan, and its STC A.I., were destroyed by a force of Grey Knights, although some data fragments remains were collected by the Adeptus Mechanicus.
999.M41，在喀罗尼亚行星上发现了一个原始的STC泰坦，一个“为火力支援和攻城行动而创建的惩罚者级自主双足武器平台”。它比帝皇级泰坦大得多，技术也很先进。泰坦及其STC的A.I.被灰骑士部队摧毁，尽管机械神教收集了一些数据碎片。

While connected to the Machine Spirit of the Ark Mechanicus ship Speranza, Archmagos Lexell Kotov discovered that the ship contained a complete and still updating STC database containing all the knowledge of the Men of Gold and their ancestors. He theorised that all Ark Mechanicus ships contained such a database, but that the priesthood have been unable to access the files. This information was wiped from his mind upon disconnecting from the ship's Machine Spirit.
在连接到机械方舟舰希望号的机魂时，大贤者列克谢尔·科托夫发现该舰包含一个完整且仍在更新的STC数据库，其中包含了金人及其祖先的所有知识。他推测，所有机械方舟都包含这样一个数据库，但祭司无法访问这些文件。在与船上的机魂断开连接后，这条信息从他脑海中消失了。
An unknown time before the Kotov Crusade, Magos Ozimandian unlocked the STC engine fragment of Beta Umojas. This lead to a 5% paradigm shift.
在科托夫远征之前的一个未知时间，贤者奥兹曼迪安解锁了贝塔乌莫贾斯的STC引擎碎片。这导致了5%的范式转移。

Less than half a millennia prior to the Kotov Crusade, Magos Phlogiston discovered a near complete STC for a certain design of Titan-class plasma reactor kick-starter. The kick-starter was designed to bring the reactor up to full power in the shortest time possible. Among the missing data-fragments were components needed to prevent the kick-starter from driving the reactor into uncontrolled critical mass. Due to this, the designs were archived, instead of being put into production.
在科托夫远征前不到半个千年，贤者弗洛吉斯顿发现了一个近乎完整的STC，用于泰坦级等离子反应堆启动装置的某种设计。启动装置的设计目的是在最短的时间内使反应堆达到满功率。在缺失的数据片段中，有一些是防止启动装置将反应堆推向失控临界质量所需的组件。因此，这些设计被存档，而不是投入生产。

An STC called Panacea, a medical miracle that could save billions of human lives from poison and disease, was found on the Imperial Forge World Verdigris IX. It was stolen by the Dark Eldar Malys and her Kabal in the Panacea Wars.
在帝国铸造世界铜绿九号上发现了一个名为万灵药的STC，这是一种可以拯救数十亿人免受毒药和疾病侵害的医学奇迹。它在万灵药战争中被黑暗灵族马里斯和她的阴谋团偷走了。

An STC library is located on the planet Hito. This planet escaped the Warp and was reclaimed by the Imperium. The library was hidden by the local Order of Heavenly Virtues who managed to deceive Imperial agents. This was achieved by the display of library of hard copies of STC print outs, leading the Imperium to believe that was the reputed STC library, when in actuality an actual STC was hidden far beneath the displayed library and only accessible via teleportarium.
一个STC图书馆位于喜多行星上。这颗行星逃脱了亚空间，被帝国夺回。图书馆被当地的天德修会隐藏起来，他们设法欺骗了帝国特工。这是通过展示STC打印件的硬拷贝的图书馆实现的，这使得帝国相信这是著名的STC图书馆，而实际上，一个真正的STC隐藏在所展示的图书馆下面很远的地方，只能通过传送室访问。

The STCs for the Lion Pattern boltgun and "Inferno" pattern Avenger ground attack craft were discovered in the space hulk Olethros by a Dark Angels Terminator squad. The bolter's STC was found in the fused wreckage of a pre-heresy Dark Angels ship, Caliban's Will. Lesser STC fragments were also recovered, such as those for a industrial plasma cooler, bunker, and military cot. STC fragments for Mk.IV power armour and an Arc Rifle were also recovered throughout the Space Hulk.
莱昂型爆矢枪和炼狱型复仇者对地攻击机的STC是由一个黑暗天使终结者小队在太空废船毁灭号中发现的。在叛乱前的黑暗天使号舰船卡利班之愿号的熔融残骸中发现了爆矢枪的STC。还回收了较小的STC碎片，如工业等离子冷却器、地堡和行军床。用于Mk.IV动力盔甲和电弧步枪的STC碎片也在整个太空废船中回收。

The STC schematics for a Geller Device aka an Empyeral Bomb was developed on the Forgeworld Velchanos Magna and deployed in an attempt to clear a nearby warpstorm. Unfortunately the device caused the warpstorm to envelop the planet and it was declared lost for centuries. The STC was rediscovered by Magos-Explorator Omnid Torquora in the wreckage of the Stella-Xenithica. In reality, the STC had been planted in the derelict as a trap by the Iron Warriors, in a ploy to capture both forgeworlds. Omnid destroyed all copies of the STC due to it causing the destruction of two entire forgeworlds and countless Mechanicus forces.

盖勒装置（又名至高天炸弹）的STC示意图是在铸造世界大维尔查诺斯上开发的，并部署在附近的一场亚空间风暴中。不幸的是，该装置导致了亚空间风暴笼罩了行星，并被宣布失落了几个世纪。STC被探索贤者奥尼迪·托夸拉在泽尼西卡群星的残骸中重新发现。事实上，STC被钢铁勇士作为陷阱埋在了这片废弃的土地上，目的是占领这两个铸造世界。奥尼迪销毁了STC的所有副本，因为它导致了两个完整的铸造世界和无数机械教部队的毁灭。

The STC for a type of paint, provisionally known as Substance 145XX22, was rediscovered by a combined force of Skitarii and Imperial Guard. The paint bared a unique chemical composition and allowed for the painting of wargear to be completed in a much shorter time. While the Skitarii suffered heavy causalities in recovering the STC, it was secured for the Imperium by Commissar Trast. The discovery of this STC caused rebellion on several Hive Worlds responsible for painting vehicles and forced the Imperium to enact a full compliance action upon the citizens of the pigment-wells of Agrax. Due to this, the STC was suspected of being somehow corrupted by Chaos. The STC took several hundred years to be declared uncorrupted and fully sanctioned by the Senatorum Imperialis. For securing the STC, Commissar Trast was rewarded with a governorship over a low-level agri-world and naming rights of Substance 145XX22. Unfortunately, as it took several hundred years for the STC to be fully sanctioned, it is unlikely that Commissar Trast survived long enough to receive the reward.

一种涂料的STC，暂时被称为物质145XX22，被护教军和帝国卫队的联合部队重新发现。这种涂料具有独特的化学成分，可以在更短的时间内完成战争装备的涂装。虽然护教军在夺回STC的过程中遭受了重大伤亡，但特拉斯特政委为帝国确保了STC的安全。STC的发现引发了几个负责载具涂装的巢都世界的叛乱，并迫使帝国对阿格拉克斯的颜料井的公民采取全面的平定行动。因此，STC被怀疑以某种方式被混沌所腐化。STC花了几百年的时间才被宣布没有腐化，并得到了帝国参议院的充分认可。为了确保STC的安全，特拉斯特政委获得了低级别农业世界的总督职位和145XX22物质的命名权。不幸的是，由于STC需要几百年才能完全获得批准，特拉斯特政委不太可能存活足够长的时间来获得奖励。
After the creation of the Great Rift the Tech Priest Galleus Malthirion discovered an STC and considered it a blessing of the Machine God.
大裂隙形成后，技术神甫加莱乌斯·马尔西里昂发现了一个STC，并认为这是万机神的祝福。

title: 远征 Crusade
parts: A Crusade is the Imperial term given for a very large-scale military campaign undertaken by Imperial forces in order to conquer several worlds in one offensive. Crusades are usually broad enough in scope to involve several worlds and many smaller-scale campaigns. They also often involve more than one branch of the Imperial military, in which case they are led by a Warmaster or an officer of sufficient rank to command multiple arms of the Imperial military.
远征是帝国对帝国部队为在一次进攻中征服多个世界而进行的大规模军事行动的称呼。远征的范围通常足够广泛，可以涉及多个世界和许多较小规模的战役。他们还经常涉及帝国军队的多个分支，在这种情况下，他们由一名战帅或一名级别足以指挥帝国军队多个兵种的军官领导。
Overview 概述

Only the High Lords of Terra were able to declare a Crusade that could be any campaign from being a long, large-scale war involving many Space Marine Chapters or could be a short conflict that is resolved in a single battle with only a handful of troops. Crusades is one means of drawing contingents from several Space Marine Chapters and binding them together to fight an enemy. This serves as a way of not committing entire Chapters or involving the ponderous resources of the Imperial Guard. They can be declared against heretic Lords or even rebellious planetary governments that had turned against the Imperium due to their own selfish reasons. Crusades are also able to be launched against alien planets or newly discovered worlds that lay beyond the Emperor's light.
只有泰拉的高领主能够宣布远征，这可能是一场涉及许多星际战士战团的长期、大规模的战争，也可能是一次只有少数军队在一场战斗中解决的短期冲突。远征是从几个星际战士战团中抽调特遣队并将他们团结在一起与敌人作战的一种手段。这是一种不占用整个战团或涉及帝国卫队庞大资源的方式。他们可以被宣布对抗异端领主，甚至是出于自私原因而反抗帝国的反叛行星政府。远征也可以针对异型行星或帝皇之光之外的新发现世界发动。

To Chapters of the Adeptus Astartes, the contribution of Space Marine forces is a matter of honour and can see a squad or two of troops deployed when they are called upon to take part in a Crusade. Once won, the Chapter will add the battle honour to their standards as a mark of achievement and loyalty. Entire Space Marine Chapters can take part in a Crusade as an act of penance for failure or due to incurring the displeasure of the Emperor. Such acts are very extreme but are nonetheless willingly taken as completion means the Chapter earns the forgiveness of the Emperor thus allowing the Space Marines to return to their homeworld and be absolved of heresy.
对于阿斯塔特修会的战团来说，星际战士的贡献是一种荣誉，当他们被要求参加远征时，可以看到一两个小队的部队被部署。一旦获胜，该战团将把战斗荣誉作为成就和忠诚的标志添加到他们的旗帜中。整个星际战士战团都可以参加远征，作为对失败或引起帝皇不满的赎罪行为。这种行为非常极端，但仍然愿意被视为完成意味着该战团获得了皇帝的宽恕，从而允许星际战士返回家园世界并被免除异端之罪。
Black Templars' Crusades 黑色圣堂的远征

The Black Templars chapter has been embarked on a single, neverending crusade since their founding, and their chapter is scattered across the galaxy in myriad smaller undertakings known as "crusades". A Crusade is the nominal unit of division among the Templars, instead of the more traditional Company in a Codex chapter.
黑色圣堂自建立以来一直在进行一场无休止的远征，他们的战团分散在银河系的无数较小的人物中，被称为“远征军”。远征军是黑色圣堂之间名义上的分级单位，而不是圣典战团中更传统的连队。
History 历史
The first Crusade is considered to be the Emperor's Great Crusade which created the Imperium. The Chaos counterpart to an Imperial Crusade is known as a Black Crusade.
第一次远征被认为是建立帝国的帝皇的大远征。与帝国远征相对应的混沌对应被称为黑色远征。
After the Badab War, the Executioners and Lamenters were dispatched on a hundred year Crusade in order to atone for their part in the rebellion.
巴达布战争后，处刑者和恸哭者被派遣进行百年远征，以弥补他们在叛乱中的责任。
Named Crusades 著名远征
Chaos 混沌
Black Crusades 黑色远征
1st Black Crusade 第一次黑色远征
2nd Black Crusade 第二次黑色远征
3rd Black Crusade 第三次黑色远征

title: 远征舰队 Expeditionary Fleet
parts: An Expedition or Expeditionary Fleet was the standard Imperial exploratory spacefaring force during the Great Crusade.
远征队或远征舰队是大远征期间标准的帝国探索航天部队。
Overview 概述

Originating from Terra, the Imperial Expeditionary Fleets dispersed all over the galaxy, carrying out the Emperor's vision of uniting known space under the banner of Humanity. Expedition Fleets had a wide remit. Their primary mission was to find lost human colony worlds and bring them into the bosom of the Imperium. Secondary missions involved the exploration of space, the cataloging of everything found, the claiming of resources in the name of the Emperor and the elimination of any alien threats.
帝国远征舰队起源于泰拉，分散在整个银河系，在人类的旗帜下实现了帝皇统一已知空域的愿景。远征舰队的职权范围很广。他们的主要任务是找到失落的人类殖民地世界，并将其带入帝国的怀抱。次要任务涉及太空探索、对发现的一切进行编目、以帝皇的名义索取资源以及歼灭任何异型威胁。

Each of the great Expeditionary Fleets was composed of hundreds of thousands of spaceships, ranging from singular examples of recovered technology wonders to mass-produced classes of various ranges and sizes, including warp runners, freighters, galleasses, piquet frigates, cruisers, battleships and even star forts.
每一支大远征舰队都由数十万艘宇宙飞船组成，从回收技术奇迹的单一例子到各种范围和尺寸的大规模生产，包括亚空间穿梭机、货船、加莱赛战船、哨兵护卫舰、巡洋舰、战列舰，甚至星堡。

The unification of human worlds did not always proceed without incident, as not all lost worlds showed immediate interest in making themselves subservient to the Imperium. In these cases, compliance with Imperial directives was enacted with the use of military force. These situations, as well as the ever-present alien threat, resulted in Expedition Fleets having a strong armed contingent, and were usually under the command of a military officer of the Imperial Army, a Lord Commander. In addition to a Lord Commander, each Expedition had a Master of the Fleet who was in charge of the Imperial Navy ships in the Expedition. Each of the Primarchs was able to, and often did, command an Expeditionary Fleet, attaching to it the majority of their Legion.

人类世界的统一并非总是一帆风顺，因为并非所有失落的世界都表现出立即屈从于帝国的兴趣。在这些情况下，通过使用武力来遵守帝国指令。这些情况，以及始终存在的异型威胁，导致远征舰队拥有强大的武装分遣队，通常由帝国军队的一名军官，即领主指挥官指挥。除了一位领主指挥官外，每一个远征队都有一位舰队司令，负责远征队中的帝国海军舰船。每一位原体都能够，而且经常这样做，指挥一支远征舰队，并将其大部分军团附属于该舰队。
The Imperium still makes use of Expedition Fleets in its recent history.
帝国在其近期历史上仍然使用远征舰队。
Known Expeditionary Fleets 已知远征舰队

4287个远征队积极进行探索

372个远征舰队进行改装和修理
60,000 (approx.) detached compliance groups involved in occupation and colonization.
约60000个独立的合规团体参与了占领和殖民化。

title: 信仰战争 War of Faith
parts: A War of Faith is a religiously inspired conflict launched by the Imperium at the order of the Adeptus Ministorum.
信仰战争是帝国根据国教教会的命令发起的一场宗教冲突。
Overview 概述

Often confused with a Crusade, a War of Faith is different in that a Crusade is ordered by the authority of the High Lords of Terra and generally involves the different military organizations of the Imperium including the Imperial Guard, the Imperial Navy, the Space Marines, and administrative staff from the Adeptus Terra and Ecclesiarchy. A War of Faith however is by the command of the Ecclesiarch alone and primarily concerns only members of the Adeptus Ministorum such as the Adepta Sororitas and Frateris Militia. Aside from this general distinction, the two overlap considerably and both seek the conquest of new territory, purging of heretics of the Imperial Cult, and the eradication of Xenos and Mutants. Wars of Faith can sometimes even be conducted against radical or heretical factions within the Ecclesiarchy itself.
信仰战争经常与远征相混淆，但它的不同之处在于，远征是由泰拉的高领主下令的，通常涉及帝国的不同军事组织，包括帝国卫队、帝国海军、星际战士以及中央政务部和国教的行政人员。然而，信仰战争仅由教宗指挥，主要只涉及国教教会的成员，如修女会和兄弟会民兵。除了这种普遍的区别之外，两者有很大的重叠，都寻求征服新的领土，清除帝国教派的异端，根除异型和变种人。信仰战争有时甚至可以针对教会内部的激进或异端派别进行。

Sometimes, a War of Faith may even be part of a greater Crusade and sometimes are assisted by other Imperial forces such as the Imperial Guard. Though when they are not, they are funded and conducted solely by the resources of the Ecclesiarchy. However though it is financed and ordered by the Ecclesiarch, he does not have total control over a War of Faith and it must be approved by the High Lords of Terra.
有时，信仰战争甚至可能是更大的远征的一部分，有时也会得到帝国卫队等其他帝国军队的协助。虽然他们没有，但他们完全由国教的资源资助和引导。然而，尽管它是由国教资助和命令的，但它并不能完全控制信仰战争，它必须得到泰拉高领主的批准。

The first War of Faith in the Imperium's history was in M32 against the rival faction to the Adeptus Ministorum, the Confederation of Light. Wars of Faith reached their peak during the Age of Redemption in M37-M38.
帝国历史上的第一次信仰战争发生在M32，对抗国教教会的敌对派系光明同盟。信仰战争在M37-M38的救赎时代达到了顶峰。
Known Wars of Faith 著名信仰战争
War of the Beast 野兽战争
Benedictine War 本笃战争
War of the Confessor 告解者战争
Cataclysm of Souls 灵魂巨变
Orpheus Revolt 俄耳甫斯起义
Promethean War 普罗米修斯战争
War for Piety 虔诚之战
The Defence of Dimmamar 迪马玛尔防御战
Second Tyrannic War 第二次泰伦战争
The Defence of San Leor 圣莱奥尔防御战
The War of Faith of Dalomat de Montbard 达洛马·德·蒙巴德的信仰战争
The Daemenor Crusade 戴梅诺远征
The Defence of Sangua Terra during the Nachmund Rift War
纳克蒙德裂隙战争中的赤地星防御战

title: 原体计划 Primarch Project
parts: The Primarch Project was part of the Emperor's plan to create an army of 20 Legions of super-human warriors, each led by a genetic sire known as a Primarch.
原体计划是帝皇计划创建一支由20个超人战士军团组成的军队的一部分，每个军团由一个被称为原体的遗传父系领导。
Overview 概述

The Emperor had already been fighting on Terra with genetically modified warriors, but in the end they proved hyper-violent and short-lived. This project would be his greatest attempt to create generals to lead these warriors, second only to himself in skill, ability, and sheer power. It was begun in M29 with the aim to create 20 cloned 'children' of the Emperor. The facility to create these Primarchs was constructed on Terra and the Emperor alongside the Perpetual Erda and Biotechnical Division Director Amar Astarte oversaw the project, having them grown in accelerated gene culturing chambers. His scientists watched over the growing fetuses in their chambers, afraid of what would happen if anything went wrong.

帝皇已经在泰拉上与基因战士一同作战，但最终他们被证明是极端暴力和短命的。这个项目将是他创造将军来领导这些战士的最大尝试，在技能、能力和绝对力量方面仅次于他自己。它始于M29，目的是20个帝皇的克隆“孩子”。创建这些原体的设施是在泰拉上建造的。帝皇与永生者尔达和生物技术部门总监阿马尔·阿斯塔特一起监督了该项目，让它们在加速的基因培养室中生长。他的科学家们在他们的房间里观察着正在生长的胎儿，担心如果出了什么问题会发生什么。

According to Ingethel the Ascended, the Primarchs were created by the Emperor with the aid of forbidden sciences and arcane lore derived from the Warp. Eldrad Ulthran also states that the Emperor utilized dark powers to construct the Primarchs. It is speculated the Primarchs were imbued with energies and knowledge that the Emperor gained in a Warp Portal on Molech. The Perpetual Erda was used as the "mother" of the Primarchs, combining her genetic material with that of the Emperor's. However, the Gods of Chaos somehow managed to spirit them away just prior to their maturation with a great Warp vortex, and it is speculated that they also managed to tamper with the infant Primarchs. The scattering of the Primarchs may have been the result of a Causal Loop created when Argel Tal and his men were sent back in time inside the Eye of Terror to the Emperor's laboratory, as they were convinced by Ingethel the Ascended to destroy the Gellar Fields protecting the infants from the touch of the Chaos Gods. Almost immediately after the Gellar Field generators were disabled, the Primarchs were sucked into a Warp vortex. According to Erda, she was responsible for opening the vortex that scattered the Primarchs in order to save her children from the fate the Emperor intended. Several Primarchs, including Konrad Curze, Roboute Guilliman, and even Sanguinius, came to believe that the scattering of the Primarchs and their upbringing on distant worlds had been engineered by the Emperor.

根据升天者英格泰尔的说法，原体是由帝皇在来自亚空间的禁忌科学和奥术知识的帮助下创造的。埃尔德拉德·乌索然还指出，帝皇利用黑暗力量创造了原体。据推测，原体们充满了帝皇在摩洛的亚空间传送门中获得的能量和知识。永生者尔达被用作原体的“母亲”，将她的遗传物质与帝皇的遗传物质结合在一起。然而，混沌诸神在他们成熟之前用一个巨大的亚空间漩涡设法将他们分散，据推测，他们还设法篡改了婴儿的原体。原体的分散可能是安格尔·塔尔和他的部下被及时送回恐惧之眼时帝皇实验室产生的因果循环的结果，因为他们被升天者英格泰尔说服摧毁了保护婴儿免受混沌诸神触碰的盖勒立场。在盖勒立场发生器被禁用后，原体几乎立即被吸入亚空间漩涡。根据尔达的说法，她负责打开分散原体的漩涡，以拯救她的孩子免受帝皇的命运。包括康拉德·科兹、罗伯特·基里曼甚至圣吉列斯在内的几位原体开始相信，原体们在遥远世界的分散和成长是由帝皇策划的。

Scattered across the galaxy, beyond the Emperor's reach, they all landed on different worlds vastly separated from their Father. The Emperor could sense that the infant Primarchs were alive, but was unable to reach them. Therefore, he used their previously collected DNA samples to create the Space Marines. The genetic material of each one of the Primarchs was used to found a single Space Marine Legion, twenty in total. The new homeworlds of the infant Primarchs and subsequent experiences on those worlds would influence and mold them to a large extent. There they quickly grew to adulthood and often rose to power, ruling, leading, and helping the inhabitants. As the Emperor found them, he was generally pleased by their actions, and quickly gave them leadership of their respective legions.

他们分散在银河系中，超出了帝皇的范围，都降落在与父亲相距甚远的不同世界。帝皇能感觉到婴儿的原体还活着，但无法接触到他们。因此，他利用他们之前收集的DNA样本创建了星际战士。每一个原体的遗传物质被用来建立一个星际战士军团，总共二十个。婴儿原体的新家园世界以及随后在这些世界上的经历将在很大程度上影响和塑造他们。在那里，他们迅速成长为成年人，并经常掌权、统治、领导和帮助居民。当帝皇发现他们时，他对他们的行为普遍感到满意，并迅速将各自军团的领导权交给了他们。

Amar Astarte came to believe that the Primarch Project and indeed the whole of the Legiones Astartes was doomed. The Primarchs were the key anchor to maintaining the genetic stability of the Space Marines, and upon their scattering she saw the entire enterprise as a failure. This eventually led her to try to destroy the genetic knowledge behind their creation in the Palace Coup.
阿马尔·阿斯塔特开始相信，原体计划乃至整个阿斯塔特军团都注定要失败。原体是维持星际战士遗传稳定性的关键锚，在他们分散后，她认为整个事业都是失败的。这最终导致她试图在皇宫政变中摧毁创造他们背后的基因知识。

title: 网道计划 Webway Project
parts: The Webway Project, also known as the Imperial Webway and the Emperor's Great Work, was a highly secretive project by the Emperor of Mankind during the Great Crusade and likely long before. The project was to be the culmination of the Emperor's ambition and its completion was His greatest concern above all other.
网道计划，也称为帝国网道和帝皇的伟大工程，是人类帝皇在大远征期间以及可能很久以前的一个高度保密的项目。这个项目是帝皇野心的顶峰，它的完成是他最关心的事情。
History 历史

The Webway Project was a revolutionary concept seeking to replace the primary means of interstellar transportation for humanity. In short, the project sought to replace Warp travel with access to the Webway. The Webway was a far more efficient means of travel, and most importantly bypassed the depredations of Chaos within the Warp. The ultimate objective of the Webway Project was for the Emperor to completely sever humanity from the Warp in its entirety, depriving Chaos of its power. This would come as the Emperor guided the species in its evolution into a fully psychic race, assuring its ascendancy on the galactic stage.
网道计划是一个革命性的概念，旨在取代人类星际航行的主要方式。简而言之，该项目试图用网道的访问权限取代亚空间航行。网道是一种更有效的航行方式，最重要的是绕过了亚空间中混沌的掠夺。网道计划的最终目标是让帝皇完全切断人类与亚空间的联系，剥夺混沌的力量。这将是因为帝皇引导物种进化成一个完全灵能的种族，确保其在银河系舞台上的优势。

It is uncertain as to where the technology came from. In a psychic musing with Custodian Diocletian Coros, the Emperor explained that He either improved on technology from the Dark Age of Technology or possibly came up with the idea on His own, but He refused to give a definite answer. Using a Psyker of great power (likely originally intended to be Magnus the Red), a portal into the Webway could be created from the Golden Throne. The Emperor was able to create such a portal deep within the Imperial Palace on Terra, and it was here that He began His work to expand human access in the Webway. The Emperor created a new caste of Mechanicum Tech-Priest known as the Unifiers to construct new Webway tunnels for human use. However, unlike the original Webway tunnels, these were not made of psychically resistant material. Instead, the psychic will of the Emperor via the Golden Throne protected the tunnels from Daemonic intrusion.

目前尚不清楚这项技术是从哪里来的。在与禁军戴克里先·科罗斯的心灵沉思中，帝皇解释说，他要么从黑暗技术时代改进了技术，要么可能是自己想出了这个主意，但他拒绝给出明确的答案。使用强大的灵能者（可能最初是赤红之马格努斯），可以从黄金王座创建一个通往网道的门户。帝皇能够在泰拉上的皇宫深处创建这样一个门户，正是在这里，他开始了在网道中扩大人类通道的工作。帝皇创建了一个新的机械神教技术神甫种类，称为统合士，为人类建造新的网道隧道。然而，与最初的网道隧道不同，这些隧道不是由抗灵能的材料制成的。相反，帝皇通过黄金王座的灵能意志保护了隧道免受恶魔的入侵。

After the Ullanor Crusade, the Emperor named Horus as Warmaster and returned to Terra in order to work on the Webway Project. The project was mired in the greatest secrecy. Not even the Primarchs knew why the Emperor returned to Terra and this created a degree of resentment among many, especially Horus. The Emperor's secrecy may have been motivated in part over fears of how the Navis Nobilite would respond if they felt their monopoly on interstellar travel was being threatened. Indeed, the Paternova of the Navigators dispatched an agent to destroy a prototype that would link with the Golden Throne, Dark Glass.
在乌兰诺远征之后，帝皇任命荷鲁斯为战帅，并返回泰拉进行网道计划。这个计划陷入了极度保密的境地。即使是原体也不知道帝皇为什么回到泰拉，这在许多人中引起了一定程度的怨恨，尤其是荷鲁斯。帝皇之所以保密，部分原因可能是担心如果导航者家族觉得他们对星际航行的垄断受到威胁，他们会如何回应。事实上，导航者的长老派遣了一名特工摧毁了一个与黄金王座有关的原型 — 黑暗琉璃。
Upon first entering the Webway, the previous masters of the Webway, the Eldar, began sealing portals to their own Craftworlds to prevent possible Imperial invasion.
在第一次进入网道时，网道的前任主人领主开始密封通往他们自己的方舟世界的门户，以防止可能的帝国入侵。

Ultimately, the Emperor's grand vision of human dominion over the Webway was doomed by Magnus the Red. Attempting to warn of the treachery of Horus and Erebus on Davin, Magnus used a forbidden psychic ritual to contact the Emperor personally deep within the Imperial Palace. The ritual created a massive psychic backlash, forming a chain reaction on the Emperor's carefully constructed wards across the Imperial Palace. The catastrophic event created multiple Warp Rifts known as Magnus' Folly within the Webway itself, through which countless Daemons poured. The Emperor was forced to try and contain the breach by permanently residing on the Golden Throne for much of the subsequent Horus Heresy while the Custodian Guard and Sisters of Silence battled hordes of Daemons to prevent them from entering the Imperial Palace and overrunning Terra itself.

最终，帝皇关于人类统治网道的宏伟愿景被赤红之马格努斯摧毁了。为了警告荷鲁斯和艾瑞巴斯在戴文的背叛，马格努斯使用了一种被禁止的灵能仪式，亲自联系了在皇宫深处的帝皇。这一仪式引发了巨大的灵能抵抗，在帝皇精心构建的、遍布帝国皇宫的防护屏障上引发了连锁反应。这场灾难性的事件在网道内部产生了多个亚空间裂隙，被称为马格努斯的愚行，无数的恶魔通过这些裂隙倾泻而下。在随后的荷鲁斯叛乱中，帝皇被迫永久居住在黄金王座上，试图遏制这一缺口，而禁军和寂静修女则与成群的恶魔作战，阻止他们进入皇宫并占领泰拉本身。

In the end, the Emperor was forced to seal the Webway portal within the Imperial Palace to prevent Terra from destruction, effectively dooming the Webway Project. However, as long as the Daemonic hordes threatened to force themselves through the breach and reach Terra, the Golden Throne would be the Emperor's prison. The Emperor could use temporary solutions to leave the Throne for periods of time, such as sacrificing massive amounts of Psykers or a substitute of great power such as Malcador.
最后，帝皇被迫封锁了皇宫内的网道门户，以防止泰拉被破坏，从而有效地毁掉了网道计划。然而，只要恶魔部落威胁要强行穿过缺口到达泰拉，黄金王座就会成为帝皇的监狱。帝皇可以使用临时解决方案在一段时间内离开王座，例如牺牲大量的灵能者或像马卡多一样有着强大力量的替代品。

When the Emperor decided to confront Horus aboard the Vengeful Spirit, Malcador was left to maintain the Golden Throne and keep the portal closed in his place. After the injured body of the Emperor was brought back to the Golden Throne, the immense effort exerted by Malcador nearly killed him. As the Emperor was placed back onto the Golden Throne, Malcador gave his life for The Emperor, reducing himself to dust, and letting The Emperor speak his final instructions. The Emperor has allowed the portal to remain closed for the last 10,000 years. Should the Emperor die, the Imperial Palace would be breached and Terra itself would be overrun by Daemons.
当帝皇决定跳帮复仇之魂号与荷鲁斯对峙时，马卡多被留下来维护黄金王座，并保持门户关闭。在帝皇受伤的尸体被带回黄金王座后，马卡多的巨大努力几乎杀死了他。当帝皇被放回黄金王座时，马卡多为帝皇献出了生命，自己化为尘土，让帝皇说出最后的指示。在过去的一万年里，帝皇一直维持门户关闭。如果帝皇死了，皇宫将被攻破，泰拉本身将被恶魔占领。

title: 尼凯亚会议 Council of Nikaea
parts: The Council of Nikaea was a great convocation called by the Emperor of Mankind in 001.M31 to discuss the use of psychic powers in the Imperium, particularly within the Legiones Astartes. It took place in the waning years of the Great Crusade, and would be one of the last notable gatherings of historically important personages before the outbreak of the Horus Heresy. While termed a 'council', the methodology of the debate and the persecution they felt they suffered because of it led the Thousand Sons Space Marine Legion to refer to the event as the Trial of the Thousand Sons or the Trial of Magnus the Red. To some later Imperial scholars, the Council was also known as the Hearing of the Thousands.
尼凯亚会议是人类帝皇于001.M31召开的一次大型会议，讨论在帝国，特别是在阿斯塔特军团内部使用灵能力量的问题。它发生在大远征的最后几年，将是荷鲁斯叛乱爆发前历史上重要人物的最后一次著名聚会之一。虽然被称为“会议”，但辩论的方法和他们所感受到的迫害导致千子星际战士将这一事件称为“千子审判”或“赤红之马格努斯审判”。对于后来的一些帝国学者来说，该会议也被称为千子审讯。
History 历史
The Librarian Crisis 智库危机

The young Imperium was wary of the development of psychic potential among the population; the means to reasonably successfully monitor and control such mutant developments did not yet exist, and there was deep distrust and bias amongst the various factions that saw, or did not see, a benefit to allowing those with psychic powers to remain unchained...or even alive. Many individuals with psychic powers were put to use by the Imperium, the most important being the Navigators who made safe space-travel possible, but even these psykers were barely tolerated by some. Any grouping of psykers was bound to draw comment, and so it proved with the Thousand Sons Legiones Astartes.
年轻的帝国对人口中灵能潜力的发展持谨慎态度；目前还不存在合理成功地监测和控制这种突变发展的手段，各派系之间存在着深刻的不信任和偏见，他们看到或没有看到允许那些拥有灵能力量的人保持不受约束的好处...甚至活着。帝国使用了许多具有灵能能力的人，其中最重要的是使安全太空航行成为可能的导航者，但即使是这些灵能者也几乎无法被一些人容忍。任何一种灵能者都必然会引起评论，千子军团阿斯塔特也证明了这一点。

The Thousand Sons drew regular criticism simply for existing throughout much of the early part of their career, seen as potentially dangerous due to the psychic talents of their Legionaries. Anti-psykers decried them as an example of the problem writ large, an imminent threat to the Imperium. Cries for their disbandment were loud; the discovery of their primarch, Magnus, quietened these calls for a time.
千子经常受到批评，仅仅是因为他们在服役生涯早期的大部分时间里都存在，由于他们的军团成员的灵能天赋，他们被视为潜在的危险。反灵能者谴责他们是问题的一个例子，对帝国构成迫在眉睫的威胁。要求解散他们的呼声很高；他们的原体马格努斯的发现，暂时平息了这些呼声。

Magnus and two other primarchs - Sanguinius of the Blood Angels, and Jaghatai Khan of the White Scars - proposed that Librarius Departments should be formed in the Legions to harness the latent psychic powers that were beginning to manifest in the Astartes of some Legions. Initially, the Emperor sanctioned the experiments and then allowed the deliberate recruitment of psychic candidates into Legions that did not already posses such mutants; however, as he withdrew from the fighting of the crusade, many called for him to pass judgment on whether the experiment should continue.
马格努斯和另外两位原体—圣血天使的圣吉列斯和白色伤疤的察合台可汗—提议在军团中成立智库部门，以利用一些军团的阿斯塔特中开始显现的潜在灵能力量。最初，帝皇批准了这些实验，然后允许有意招募灵能候选人加入尚未拥有这种突变的军团；然而，当他退出大远征的战斗时，许多人呼吁他对是否应该继续进行实验做出判断。

The reasoning for this was twofold. Firstly, as the Great Crusade reached further from the light of Terra, stranger and stranger foes were faced. Many times the Legiones Astartes or the Imperial Army would discover a new world, only to be met by hostile action from beings who wielded mysterious, sorcerous-seeming powers; powers that resembled those employed by the Thousand Sons and the legion Librarians.
这样做的理由是双重的。首先，随着大远征离泰拉之光越来越远，面临着越来越多的陌生敌人。很多时候，军团或帝国军队会发现一个新世界，却遭到了拥有神秘、看似魔法的力量的生物的敌对行动；这些力量类似于千子和军团智库所使用的力量。

The second was that the Thousand Sons were seen to be potentially dangerously unstable by none other than Leman Russ, primarch of the Space Wolves and long a distruster of the Thousand Sons' martial doctrines and battle-philosophy. On the world of Shrike, the Russ witnessed a Thousand Son fall victim to a malady called the flesh-change; uncontrolled physical degeneration and grand mal mutation apparently brought on by the loss of psychic control. Announcing that he had turned a blind eye to Magnus' "obvious" dabbling in black arts up to this point, the Wolf King declared that he was done ignoring his brother's tainted ways and claimed that the entire Thousand Sons legion was corrupted. He further promised a reckoning.
第二个原因是，千子被认为是潜在的不稳定危险，正是太空野狼的原体黎曼·鲁斯，长期以来一直不信任千子的军事学说和战斗哲学。在伯劳世界里，鲁斯目睹了一个千子成为一种叫做血肉转变的受害者；失控的身体退化和大量突变显然是由灵能控制的丧失引起的。狼王宣布，到目前为止，他无法对马格努斯“明显”涉足黑魔法的行为视而不见，并宣布他已经无法无视他兄弟的肮脏行径，并声称整个千子军团都被腐蚀了。他进一步承诺会进行清算。

Leman Russ' voice joined that of Mortarion's, long a critic of the Thousand Sons and psykers in general and who now openly accused Magnus of sorcery, and that of Corax and Rogal Dorn, who both refused to field their Legions alongside the Thousand Sons and even other legions that deployed Librarians upon occasion. Their outcry now so insistent that it soon became a major point of contention across the entire Imperium, with the primarchs split over the issue. Eventually, on the brink of leaving the Great Crusade after the ascension of Horus Lupercal to the position of Warmaster, the Emperor was forced to call a conclave of the War Council of the Great Crusade to resolve the issue of psykers amidst the Legiones Astartes, with himself acting as arbiter. The world chosen for the great Council was called Nikaea.

莫塔里安加入了黎曼·鲁斯的发声，莫塔里安长期以来一直是千子和灵能者的批评者，现在公开指责马格努斯是巫术，还有科拉克斯和罗格·多恩的发声，他们都拒绝与千子军团并肩作战，甚至偶尔部署智库的其他军团。他们的强烈抗议现在如此强烈，以至于很快成为整个帝国争论的焦点，原体们在这个问题上意见分歧。最终，在荷鲁斯·卢佩卡尔升任战帅后，在离开大远征之际，帝皇被迫召集大远征战争议会召开秘密会议，以解决阿斯塔特军团中的灵能者问题，并由他自己担任仲裁者。被选为召开大会议的世界被称为尼凯亚。
Nikaea 尼凯亚

Nikaea was a world that, during the time of the Great Crusade, was in its geological infancy. Clouds completely obscured the surface while tectonic movement created constant pyroclastic eruptions and storms across the planet. Its very fabric in flux, clods of ejected matter were caught in orbit or drifted across the system, with gravitational waves and electromagnetic discharges swamping local space. Navigating through all this to a point on the surface would've been impossible if not for a psychic beacon generated by the Emperor. The planet was said to be galactically remote. The surface of the still-forming world was littered with curious extrusions of rock and magma that had taken on various largely geometric shapes; Magnus claimed that this oddity was likely a reason the Emperor had selected the planet, as it echoed the origins of Magnus' belief in the ordered nature of the universe.

在大远征时期，尼凯亚是一个地质上还处于起步阶段的世界。云层完全遮蔽了地表，而构造运动在全球范围内造成了持续的火山碎屑爆发和风暴。它的结构在不断变化，喷出的物质块被困在轨道上或在系统中漂移，引力波和电磁波覆盖了局部空间。如果没有帝皇生成的灵能信标，要想在这一切中导航到表面上的某个点是不可能的。据说这颗行星在银河系中很遥远。这个仍在形成的世界的表面到处都是奇怪的岩石和岩浆喷出物，它们呈现出各种几何形状；马格努斯声称，这一奇怪现象可能是帝皇选择这颗行星的原因，因为它与马格努斯对宇宙有序的信仰起源相呼应。

Perturabo both designed and built the council chambers. Although originally designed as an arena for competitive events, The Emperor would later repurpose it for his own use. The council chambers were created on Nikaea within a hollowed out stratovolcano, a massive amphitheatre having been carved out of its heart. The beacon projected by the Emperor was visible to those with mindsight as a beam of light shooting straight up out of the volcano, wreathed in golden lighting. Magnus saw this as a magnificent sign of the wonders of psychic powers and a validation of his stance before the Council even began. His Chief Librarian, Ahzek Ahriman, on the other hand, was dismayed by the sheer power on display, realising it was tied to a prophetic vision he had previously experienced that promised disaster. Casual use of psychic powers at the Council was difficult; Ahriman put this down to the presence of the Emperor.

佩图拉博设计并建造了会议厅。虽然最初设计为竞技活动的竞技场，但帝皇后来将其改为自用。会议厅是在尼凯亚一座挖空的层状火山内建造的，一座巨大的圆形剧场从其中心雕刻出来。帝皇投射的信标对那些有灵能的人来说是可见的，就像一束光从火山中直射出来，被金色的灯光环绕着。马格努斯认为这是灵能力量奇迹的一个宏伟标志，也是他在会议开始之前立场的验证。另一方面，他的首席智库阿扎克·阿里曼对所展示的纯粹力量感到沮丧，意识到这与他以前经历过的预言景象有关，这预示着灾难。在会议中随意使用灵能力量是困难的；阿里曼将此归因于帝皇的存在。

Security within the Council was a privilege taken by the Adeptus Custodes, as was their right and duty when the Emperor himself was present; though a three-Great Company-strong force of Space Wolves were present to act - according to them - as a no-quarter safety measure in case Magnus made the 'wrong decision' in reaction to events. They were accompanied by a detachment of the Sisters of Silence, which made their presence (and that of their primarch, Leman Russ) psychically undetectable. Arrivals to the Council site had to submit control of their vessels to Custodes remote pilots, who berthed the ships at secured landing zones. Private quarters for attendees ringed the amphitheatre, which itself could seat thousands upon the tiered black stone seating. The amphitheatre was open to the elements, but workings of the Mechanicum kept the storm at bay. Massive environmental control machinery allowed the juvenile world to prematurely support life. The command and control position for the entire installation was staffed by several hundred operatives of the Imperial Fleet, the Hegemonic Corps, the Space Wolves, the Sisters of Silence and the Adeptus Custodes. The Emperor and his immediate retinue sat upon a pyramidal dais at one side of the amphitheatre (the side opposite on which Magnus' quarters were located).

会议的安全是禁军的特权，帝皇亲自在场时，他们的权利和义务也是如此；尽管据他们说，三个大连强大的太空野狼部队在场，作为一项无条件的安全措施，以防马格努斯对事件做出“错误决定”。他们由寂静修女的一支分队陪同，这使得他们的存在（以及他们的原体黎曼·鲁斯的存在）在灵能上无法被察觉。抵达会议现场的人员必须将其船只的控制权交给禁军远程飞行员，他们将船只停泊在安全的着陆区。与会者的私人宿舍环绕着圆形竞技场，圆形竞技场本身可以在分层的黑石座位上容纳数千人。圆形竞技场向外界开放，机械教的运作使风暴得以控制。大规模的环境控制机制使青年世界过早地支持生命。整个设施的指挥和控制位置由帝国舰队、霸权军、太空野狼、寂静修女和禁军的数百名特工组成。帝皇和他的随从坐在圆形竞技场一侧的金字塔台上（马格努斯的住处所在的对面）。
The Council Convenes 会议召开

The Council was presided over by Malcador the Sigillite, Regent Lord of Terra and personal confidant of the Emperor. He carried the Emperor's golden scepter as a sign that he held authority over the assembled. The Thousand Sons delegation was the last to arrive, uninformed of the true nature of the Council. Immediately after their arrival, Magnus and Ahriman were taken into the crowded public amphitheatre to be sworn in; it was at this moment that they realised, wearily and with shocked dismay respectively, the true nature of the 'council' they had been summoned to attend, at least for them.
会议由掌印者马卡多主持，他是泰拉的摄政王，也是帝皇的私人密友。他拿着帝皇的金杖，作为他对会议拥有权威的标志。千子代表团是最后一个到达的，他们不知道会议的真实性质。他们抵达后，马格努斯和阿里曼立即被带到拥挤的公共露天竞技场宣誓就职；就在这一刻，他们分别疲惫地和震惊地意识到，他们被召集参加的“会议”的真实性质，至少对他们来说是这样。

The primary objective of the Council of Nikaea was to determine what to do about the Librarian Crisis that described the division between the Legions over the continued use of Librarians on the battlefield and for Magnus to face the charges of sorcery. Many interpreted the Council as in actuality the Trial of Magnus the Red; he was accused of sorcery and of corrupting the Space Marine Legions through the introduction of Librarians into them and their training by seconded warrior-scholars of the Thousand Sons.
尼凯亚会议的主要目标是确定如何应对智库危机，该危机描述了军团之间在战场上继续使用智库的分歧，以及马格努斯面临巫术指控。许多人将会议解释为实际上是对赤红之马格努斯的审判；他被指控使用巫术，并通过向引入智库以及千子军团借调的战士学者对他们进行培训，腐蚀了星际战士军团。

Malcador announced that those gathered had been summoned to freely debate the issue - causing some consternation in the crowd - and whether the use of Librarians was outright sorcery that caused a threat to human galactic domination, or if such claims were fearful, ignorant mewlings. He closed this opening address with an invite for anyone to make the first speech. The first to stand was a Rune Priest of the Space Wolves known as Othere Wyrdmake.
马卡多宣布，与会者被召集起来自由辩论这个问题，这在人群中引起了一些恐慌，以及使用智库是否是对人类银河统治构成威胁的彻头彻尾的巫术，或者这些说法是否是可怕的、无知的喵喵叫。他在开幕词的最后邀请大家做第一次演讲。第一个站起来的是太空野狼的符文牧师，被称为奥瑟瑞·命造。
The Accusations 指控

Wyrdmake, as a psyker himself and as someone considered a respected colleague by Ahriman, may have been thought to have spoken out in defence of Librarians. Quite the opposite occurred - claiming knowledge of the Thousand Sons due to fighting alongside them on Shrike and Aghoru, he denounced each and every one of them as warlocks, deceivers and sorcerers, swearing the truth of the matter upon his oath of loyalty to Leman Russ. Malcador commented that this was a serious accusation, and asked if anyone would support it; Mortarion, primarch of the Death Guard legion stepped forth.
命造本人是一名灵能者，也是被阿里曼认为受人尊敬的同事，他可能被认为为智库辩护。恰恰相反，他声称由于在伯劳和阿格鲁与千子并肩作战而了解千子，并谴责他们每个人都是术士、骗子和巫师，在宣誓效忠黎曼·鲁斯时发誓事情的真相。马卡多评说这是一个严历的指控，并问是否有人会支持它；死亡守卫军团的原体莫塔里安走了出来。

Mortarion repeated his charge that Magnus was a practitioner of sorcery. He illuminated his side of the debate by reminding the listeners of his personal experiences, and the worlds he had seen ruined by individuals who peered too long into dark places. He further reminded them all that Old Night was caused by psykers, their actions almost destroying the species. He pointed to the existence of the Sisters of Silence, an Imperial body specifically created to do the apparently essential job of not only guarding against the danger of psykers, but hunting them down. He dwelled upon horrific imagery he had seen, memories of sorcerous powers and the horrors they can conjure, and the power of such arcane barbarians to hold off or defeat Imperial purity. He closed by stating that he did not believe that Magnus was such a monstrous person as he had described and dealt with in his younger days...but that he was walking on the same path. Acknowledging his long-held anti-Librarian beliefs, he pressed that he was condemning Magnus not out of hate, but out of brotherly love and concern, so that Magnus may stop before it was too late.

莫塔里安再次指控马格努斯是一名巫师。他通过提醒听众他的个人经历，以及他所看到的被那些长时间凝视黑暗之地的人摧毁的世界，来阐明他在辩论中的立场。他进一步提醒他们，旧夜是由灵能者造成的，他们的行为几乎摧毁了这个物种。他指出了寂静修女的存在，这是一个专门为做显然重要的工作而创建的帝国机构，不仅要防范灵能者的危险，还要追捕他们。他详细讲述了他所看到的可怕画面，对魔法力量及其所能唤起的恐怖的记忆，以及这些神秘蛮人抵抗或击败帝国纯洁性的力量。他最后说，他不相信马格努斯是一个像他年轻时描述和处理的那样可怕的人...但他走的是同一条路。他承认自己长期以来的反智库信仰，并强调他谴责马格努斯不是出于仇恨，而是出于兄弟般的爱和关心，这样马格努斯就可以在为时已晚之前停下来。

Mortarion and Wyrdmake then invited chosen other speakers to the podium, where they made the case against Librarians for some three hours. After this, an interval took place before Magnus was scheduled to answer the accusations made against him.
莫塔里安和命造随后邀请了其他选定的演讲者到台上，在那里他们对智库进行了大约三个小时的辩论。在此之后，在马格努斯计划回答对他的指控之前，经过了一段时间。
The Testimony of the Crimson King 深红之王的见证

Magnus recounted many great deeds of Librarians, and pointed out that psykers were essential to the running of the Imperium, gesturing at the assembled astropaths to illustrate his point. He essayed that being fearful of the unknown was the mark of the ignorant and uneducated, ridiculous superstition, and that those without the courage to face new ideas sought to swamp them with scare-mongering. He pointed out that to people of previous historical periods, everything about a single individual at the Council would be regarded as magic, and that such long-ago people had beliefs that were proven wrong; the Sun does not orbit Terra after all, for example. He made an aside to Mortarion's testimony, claiming that the deepest desire leads to hate and lies, not love and concern.

马格努斯讲述了智库的许多伟大事迹，并指出灵能者对帝国的运作至关重要，他指着组装好的星炬来说明他的观点。他试图指出，对未知的恐惧是无知、未受过教育、荒谬的迷信的标志，那些没有勇气面对新思想的人试图用散布恐惧来淹没它们。他指出，对于以前历史时期的人来说，会议中关于一个人的一切都会被视为魔法，而很久以前人们的信仰被证明是错误的；例如，太阳毕竟不围绕泰拉运行。他对莫塔里安的证词置若罔闻，声称最深切的欲望会导致仇恨和谎言，而不是爱和关心。

He then spoke of he future; telling of what great deeds psykers can achieve and how much of a travesty the Council of Nikaea would be seen as by future Imperial citizens, as a barbarous event orchestrated by the ignorant. He refuted the claims against his legion, pointing out that the Thousand Sons fight at the forefront of the Great Crusade, taking the light of the Imperium to places others fear to tread and widening Imperial knowledge with their hunt for information. He then told a parable of men sitting around a fire in the dark of an underground cavern; one of their number discovers the light of outside, but his fellows are unwilling to believe him, content with the light from their fire. Wishing to illuminate his fellows, the explorer works hard, digging a great tunnel into the ceiling of the cavern and bringing the light to all his colleagues. That man knew he had to show his friends the truth, and strove to do so, despite their rejection and disbelief. Magnus claimed that in this case, the light is knowledge of the empyrean that he simply wanted to make available to everyone.

然后他谈到了他的未来；讲述了灵能者可以取得的伟大成就，以及未来的帝国公民将如何看待尼凯亚会议，将其视为无知者策划的野蛮事件。他驳斥了针对其军团的指控，指出千子在大远征的最前线作战，将帝国之光带到了其他人害怕践踏的地方，并通过寻找信息扩大了帝国的知识。然后，他讲了一个寓言，讲的是在地下洞穴的黑暗中，人们围坐在火堆旁；他们中的一个人发现了外面的光，但他的同伴们不愿意相信他，满足于火中的光。为了照亮他的同伴，探险家努力工作，在洞穴的天花板上挖了一条巨大的隧道，把光带给所有的同事。那个人知道他必须向朋友们展示真相，尽管他们拒绝和怀疑，他还是努力做到了。马格努斯声称，在这种情况下，他只是想让每个人都能获得关于至高天的知识。
"If I am guilty of anything it is the simple pursuit of knowledge."
“如果说我有罪的话，那就是对知识的简单追求。”
- Magnus the Red, at Nikaea
- 赤红之马格努斯，在尼凯亚

Magnus had spoken passionately with great power and the Council became even more divided. While effective, the Witch Hunters could not match Magnus' persuasiveness. The Council was once again adjourned. After the break, Magnus, who had felt that he had swayed many of those present with his testimony, was dismayed to pick up on a wide cloud of negative judgement now emanating from the Council, for reasons unknown to him, but perhaps having something to do with the events surrounding a servant of the Space Wolves...
马格努斯以极大力量的热情发表了讲话，会议变得更加分裂。虽然有效，猎巫人无法与马格努斯的说服力相媲美。会议再次休会。休息后，马格努斯觉得自己的证词动摇了在场的许多人，但他沮丧地发现，由于他不知道的原因，会议现在发出了一片广泛的负面评价，但也许与围绕太空野狼仆人的事件有关...
Hidden Events 隐藏事件

Present amidst the concealed Space Wolves contingent - much to the consternation of Constantin Valdor - was Kasper Hawser, Skjald of Tra, or Third Company. The reason Valdor was perturbed by his presence was that Leman Russ had earlier made it clear to the Chief Custodian that the Space Wolves suspected that Hawser was a Hidden One of the Thousand Sons; a deep-cover intelligence agent who unaware of their own status as a scouting conduit. His presence in the command centre constituted a serious security risk, even with the psi-blocking skills of the Sisters of Silence and the inert materials used in the construction of the Nikaea complex. However, these factors were the very reasons that the Russ decided to explore the possibility that Hawser was a Hidden One. After his debrief, Hawser was committed to the supervision of a senior Custode, Amon Tauromachian, and allowed to watch the Council deliberate. It was during this time that the Thousand Sons made an apparent attempt to remove their apparently-compromised spy, as Amon , Master of the Hidden Ones and Equerry to Magnus the Red made a sorcerous attack on Amon Tauromachian and attempted to eliminate Hawser. Amon was driven off by the intervention of Bjorn of the Space Wolves, and the incident reported immediately; the Space Wolves fully under the impression that news of it would influence the judgement of the Emperor.

在隐蔽的太空野狼特遣队中，有卡斯帕·豪瑟尔、特拉的吟游诗人和第三连，这让康斯坦丁·瓦尔多大为震惊。瓦尔多对他的出现感到不安的原因是，黎曼·鲁斯早些时候向首席禁军明确表示，太空野狼怀疑豪瑟尔是千子的一个隐藏者；一个不知道自己作为侦察渠道的身份的卧底情报人员。他在指挥中心的存在构成了严重的安全风险，即使有寂静修女的灵能阻断技能和建造尼凯亚时使用的复杂灵能惰性材料。然而，这些因素正是鲁斯决定探索豪瑟尔是一个隐藏者的可能性的原因。在听取汇报后，豪瑟尔被委托给高级禁军阿蒙·塔罗马奇监督，并被允许观看会议的审议。正是在这段时间里，千子显然试图清除他们明显受到威胁的间谍，因为隐者之主兼赤红之马格努斯的侍从官阿蒙对阿蒙·塔罗马奇进行了巫术攻击，并试图消灭豪瑟尔。阿蒙在太空野狼的比约恩的干预下被赶走，事件立即报告；太空野狼完全相信这一消息会影响帝皇的判断。

Tragically for everyone concerned, it would later be revealed that the 'Amon' that attacked Tauromachian and Hawser was not in fact Amon of the Thousand Sons, but an aspect of the Primordial Annihilator masquerading as the Master of the Hidden Ones as part of a convoluted scheme to remove the threat presented by both the Space Wolves and the Thousand Sons to the grand chaotic plan that would result in the Horus Heresy. The real Amon - and all the Thousand Sons present, including Magnus - had no idea of what had transpired in their names.
可悲的是，对所有相关人员来说，后来发现袭击塔罗马奇和豪瑟尔的“阿蒙”实际上不是千子的阿蒙，而是伪装成隐者之主的原初毁灭者的一个方面，这是一个复杂计划的一部分，该计划旨在消除太空野狼和千子对导致荷鲁斯叛乱的大混乱计划的威胁。真正的阿蒙和所有在场的千子，包括马格努斯，都不知道他们的名字里发生了什么。
The Librarians Speak 智库发言
As the end of the Council approached, Malcador arose, and asked if there were any remaining who would like to speak, before final judgement was made.
随着会议接近尾声，马卡多尔站了起来，问在做出最终判决之前，是否还有人想发言。

The tension could easily have been cut with a knife when a group of Space Marine Librarians stood and approached the dais. Malcador the Sigillite acknowledged them with a nod, and all fell silent. Among the group were some of the greatest Librarians of the Space Marine Legions. One of their number, a junior White Scars marine called Targutai Yesugei, spoke up, saying that there was nothing inherently evil about a Librarian. An Astartes psyker was akin to an athelete, a gifted individual who must be trained for the greatest results, or a bolter or Land Raider, a weapon that must be treated with respect and not loosed indiscriminately. They proclaimed that the best way forward would be to firm up the training of human psykers across the galaxy, and that this be made an Imperial priority, not their eradication; for with such a group of trained specialists loyal to the Emperor, the galaxy could be taken with ease. They also stated that any study of sorcery must of course be forbidden, effectively presenting a 'third way' to the Council. Some versions of the story of the Council claim that the Emperor immediately agreed to this proposal, as if waiting for it. However, other events, more believable in the light of what would transpire, are also presented.

当一群星际战士智库站起来走近讲台时，气氛紧张得简直能用刀子切断。掌印者马卡多点了点头，然后大家都沉默了。其中包括星际战士的一些最伟大的智库。他们中的一位，一位名叫塔里忽台·也速该的白色伤疤星际战士，大声说，智库本身并没有什么邪恶。阿斯塔特灵能者类似于运动员，一个有天赋的人，必须经过训练才能取得最大的成绩，或者一个爆矢枪或兰德掠袭者者，一种必须受到重视而不能随意松开的武器。他们宣称，最好的前进方向是在整个银河系加强人类灵能者的训练，并将其作为帝国的优先事项，而不是根除；因为有了这样一群忠于帝皇的训练有素的专家，银河系可以很容易地被占领。他们还表示，当然必须禁止对巫术的任何研究，这实际上向会议提出了“第三条路”。会议故事的一些版本声称，帝皇立即同意了这一提议，仿佛在等待。然而，根据将要发生的事情，其他更可信的事件也被呈现出来。

According to the Grimoire Hereticus, a number of Librarians attempted to storm out of the hall after they were horrified of the reactionary as well as the misguided direction the debate was taking place.
根据《异端魔籍》的说法，许多智库在对辩论的反动和误导方向感到震惊后，试图冲出大厅。
The Emperor's Decision 帝皇的决定

Ultimately, in a speech to the gathered Astartes (which seemed to Ahzek Ahriman to be directly intended for Magnus himself), the Emperor issued what would become known as the Edict of Nikaea, decreeing that the Legiones Astartes, beyond the use of Navigators and Astropaths, would no longer employ psykers. They were to disband their Librarius departments, the Librarians re-deployed to the battle companies and the primarchs themselves were to refrain from using any psychic powers they possessed. This of course applied to Magnus, whose use of sorcery was declared not proven. The Emperor also gave one final warning:
最终，在对聚集在一起的阿斯塔特的演讲中（在阿扎克·阿里曼看来，这似乎是直接针对马格努斯本人的），帝皇颁布了后来被称为《尼凯亚法令》的法令，规定阿斯塔特军团除了使用导航者和星语者外，将不再使用灵能者。他们将解散他们的智库部门，智库将重新部署到战斗连队，而原体本人将避免使用他们拥有的任何灵能力量。这当然适用于马格努斯，他使用巫术的行为被宣布为未经证实。帝皇还发出了最后的警告：

'"Woe betide he who ignores my warning or breaks faith with me. He shall be my enemy, and I will visit such destruction upon him and all his followers that, until the end of all things, he shall rue the day he turned from my light."
“谁不听我的警告，谁违背对我的信仰，谁就有祸了。他将成为我的敌人，我将毁灭他和他的所有追随者，直到一切结束，他都会后悔自己偏离我的光芒的那一天。”
- The Emperor, at Nikaea
- 帝皇，在尼凯亚

The Emperor was much enraged with Magnus personally. While he chose to refrain from outright announcing to the Council that Magnus was a sorcerer, the Emperor believed that Magnus had at least dabbled with the black arts. Seeing this as a personal betrayal - for the Emperor had, many years earlier, chosen to reveal secrets of the Warp to Magnus and Magnus alone - he issued his wayward son with a personal warning:
帝皇对马格努斯本人非常愤怒。虽然他选择不直接向会议宣布马格努斯是一名巫师，但帝皇认为马格努斯至少涉猎过黑魔法。他认为这是一种个人背叛—因为多年前，帝皇选择向马格努斯和马格努斯单独透露亚空间的秘密—他向任性的儿子发出了个人警告：
'"If you treat with the Warp, Magnus, I shall visit destruction upon you. And your Legion's name will be struck from the Imperial records for all time"
“如果你接触亚空间，马格努斯，我将毁灭你。你的军团之名将永远从帝国的记录中清除”
- The Emperor, at Nikaea
- 帝皇，在尼凯亚

It is said that Magnus' face appeared as if made from brittle stone at hearing this proclamation, stone upon the edge of cracking. Nevertheless, he bowed his knee to his father and pledged to obey. It was a pledge he would not keep.
据说，马格努斯听到这个宣告后，脸就好像是用易碎的石头做的，石头在开裂的边缘。尽管如此，他还是向父亲鞠了一躬，发誓服从。这是他不会遵守的承诺。
Attendees 与会者

A listing of notable attendees other than the Emperor of Mankind. It should be noted that there were several individuals in attendance whose identity remains hidden. This is due to the use of "falsehoods" that hid the identities of the person, or persons concealed behind them. The Emperor ordered that falsehoods be used so that no individuals' testimony would "be corrupted by fear of those who's eyes are upon him." It is implied by Ahzek Ahriman of the Thousand Sons that the individuals behind the falsehoods were in fact Primarchs from other Legions.
除人类帝皇之外的著名与会者名单。应该指出的是，有几个人出席了会议，但他们的身份仍然不为人知。这是由于使用了“谎言”来掩盖个人或隐藏在他们背后的人的身份。帝皇下令使用谎言，这样任何人的证词都不会“被那些盯着他的人的恐惧所破坏”。千子的阿扎克·阿里曼暗示，谎言背后的人实际上是其他军团的原体。
