title: 星际战士军团 Space Marine Legion
parts: The twenty Space Marine Legions, also known as the Legiones Astartes, were created by the Emperor to take part in the Great Crusade in what was later known as the First Founding. All the Space Marines of a Legion ("battle-brothers" amongst themselves) were modified with help of the DNA samples of a single Primarch. As a Primarch was found, he would receive the command of his respective Legion.
二十个星际战士军团，也被称为阿斯塔特军团，是由帝皇在后来被称为初次建军时创建以参加大远征。一个军团的所有星际战士（他们之间的“战斗兄弟”）都在一个原体的DNA样本的帮助下进行了改造。当一位原体回归时，他将接过各自军团的指挥权。
Legiones Astartes 阿斯塔特军团
Parent Agency: Imperium of Man
隶属：人类帝国
Leader: Emperor of Mankind, Warmaster Horus
领导者：人类帝皇，战帅荷鲁斯
Armed Forces: 20 Legions
武装力量：20个军团
Established: Late Unification Wars
建立：统一战争后
Dissolved: Post-Horus Heresy (Loyalist Legions) Some Traitor Legions still active
解散：荷鲁斯叛乱后（忠诚军团）一些叛徒军团仍然活跃
History 历史
Great Crusade and Horus Heresy 大远征与荷鲁斯叛乱

The Legiones Astartes were originally created by the Emperor and his gene-wrights in the closing days of the Unification Wars and the extinction of their predecessors, the Thunder Warriors. The new Astartes had superior lifespans and discipline to the Thunder Warriors, and were intended by the Emperor to spearhead his coming Great Crusade. Each of the twenty Legions were created from gene-seed derived from a single Primarch, which were themselves maturing deep under the Himalayan Mountains before they were stolen away from the Forces of Chaos. However while the Gene-Seed was created by the Emperor, it was perfected and mass-produced by the Gene-Cults of Luna after they were pacified by the early Astartes. The combat debut of the Legiones Astartes occurred towards the end of the Unification Wars when they fought rebellious Thunder Warriors in the Palace Coup.

阿斯塔特军团最初是由帝皇创造的，他的基因在统一战争的最后几天以及他们的前辈雷霆战士的灭绝中发挥了作用。新的阿斯塔特的寿命和纪律都优于雷霆战士，帝皇打算将他们作为即将到来的大远征的先锋。二十个军团中的每一个都是由一个原体的基因种子创建的，这些原体本身在喜马拉雅山脉深处成熟，然后被混沌力量偷走。然而，虽然基因种子是由帝皇创造的，但在早期阿斯塔特平息了月球的基因教派后，它们才被完善并大规模生产。军团的首次战斗是在统一战争接近尾声时，他们在皇宫政变中与反叛的雷霆战士作战。
The Luna Wolves during the Great Crusade 大远征期间的影月苍狼

During the subsequent Great Crusade, the twenty Legiones Astartes were the tip of the Emperor's spear in his conquest of much of the galaxy. Gradually, the twenty lost Primarchs were reunified with their respective Legion and led them to further glories, where they would begin to establish unique identities for themselves. However some point during the Great Crusade, two of the legions were erased from all records for unknown reasons.
在随后的大远征中，二十个阿斯塔特军团是帝皇征服银河系大部分地区的矛头。渐渐地，二十位失踪的原体与他们各自的军团重新团聚，并带领他们走向更辉煌的未来，在那里他们将开始为自己树立独特的身份。然而，在大远征的某个时刻，由于未知的原因，其中两个军团被从所有记录中抹去。

During the Horus Heresy, nine of the eighteen remaining Legions sided with Warmaster Horus against the Emperor. After the Battle of Terra, these fled into the Eye of Terror where many fragmented into disparate warbands that continue to plague the Imperium to this day. The remaining loyalist Legions were broken up by Roboute Guilliman as per the new Codex Astartes. The Space Marine Legions effectively ceased to exist after this act, succeeded by hundreds of new Chapters.
在荷鲁斯叛乱期间，剩下的18个军团中有9个站在战帅荷鲁斯一边反对帝皇。泰拉之战后，这些人逃到了恐惧之眼，在那里，许多人分裂成不同的战帮，这些战帮一直困扰着帝国直到今天。根据新的阿斯塔特圣典，剩下的忠诚军团被罗伯特·基里曼解散。在这一法案之后，星际战士军团实际上已经不复存在，取而代之的是数百个新的战团。
Organization 组织

A significant portion of the early Legions' organization was deeply rooted in the time-honored Terran models of strategy, hierarchy, and function found within the revered texts of the Principia Belicosa. The Emperor's ingenuity further enhanced this framework, providing an adaptable strategic approach that complemented the extraordinary strengths and abilities of the Legionaries themselves. The chain of command operated with clarity, with Legion officers leading their troops into battle personally.
早期军团组织的很大一部分深深植根于历史悠久的人族战略、等级制度和职能模式，这些模式在军团组织法典的受人尊敬的文本中有所体现。帝皇的聪明才智进一步加强了这一框架，提供了一种适应性强的战略方法，补充了军团本身的非凡优势和能力。指挥链运作清晰，军团军官亲自率领部队投入战斗。
Organization of a Space Marine Legion 星际战士军团组织

At the head of the Legion was its Primarch, seconded by Command structures who oversaw the Legion's organization. Below this were the Chapters of the Legion, each of which was commanded by a Lord Commander. Each Chapter in turn was divided into a number of Battalions, each of which was further divided into Companies. The Company, itself divided into a number of Squads, was the basic military division of the Legio Astartes. Due to the varying sizes of each Legion, there was no fixed number of how many Chapters, Companies, and Squads a Legion could contain.
军团的首领是其原体，由监督军团组织的指挥机构借调。下面是军团的各个战团，每个战团都由一位领主指挥官指挥。每战团又分为若干战斗营，每个战斗营又分为连队。连队本身分为多个小队，是阿斯塔特军团的基本军事单位。由于每个军团的规模各不相同，一个军团可以包含多少个战团、连队和小队并没有固定的数量。
Nominally , the structure of a Legion should have been as follows:
名义上，军团的结构应该如下：
Each chapter should be 2 Battalions strong, each Battalion composed of 5 companies numbering 100 Legionaries, as well as various specialists and support staff.
每战团应由2个战斗营组成，每个战斗营由5个连队组成，每个连队有100名军团士兵，以及各种专家和支援人员。
The Ist company was composed of Veterans, the II, III and IV of line companies, and the Vth of specialists troops.
第一连由老兵组成、第二、第三和第四线列连以及特种部队第五连。

Despite the standard template organization, it seems a lot of Legions went against this organizational layout. For instance, a single World Eaters Chapter during the Battle of Beta-Garmon consisted of 5,000 Legionnaires (5x the "standard" size).
尽管有标准的组织模版，但似乎很多军团都反对这种组织布局。例如，在贝塔·伽蒙战役期间，一个吞世者战团由5000名军团士兵组成（是“标准”尺寸的5倍）。

Divergence between Legions 军团之间的分歧

Throughout the two centuries of the Great Crusade, the Terran Legions underwent myriad transformations. Influences from the worlds they recruited from and the development of customs and hierarchies within each Legion played pivotal roles. The discovery of the Primarchs further reshaped the Legions, imprinting their own personalities and will onto their respective forces. This process led to the rewriting of entire cultural, traditional, and ideological paradigms within the Legions. As a result, the regimens of training and indoctrination within each Legion diverged significantly, with many abandoning the strictures, doctrines, and terminology of the Principia Belicosa to tailor themselves to preferred styles of warfare. By the conclusion of the Great Crusade, each Legion had developed its own distinct character. These unique identities within the once-united body of the Legiones Astartes fostered rivalries and, eventually, feuds that would be exploited during the Horus Heresy.

在大远征的两个世纪里，人类军团经历了无数的转变。来自他们的募兵世界的影响以及每个军团内部习俗和等级制度的发展发挥了关键作用。原体的回归进一步重塑了军团，将他们自己的个性和意志铭刻在各自的武装上。这一过程导致了军团内部整个文化、传统和意识形态范式的重写。因此，每个军团内部的训练和灌输方案存在显著差异，许多人放弃了军团组织法典的限制、理论和术语，以适应原体的战争风格。到大远征结束时，每个军团都发展出了自己独特的性格。这些独特的身份在曾经团结的阿斯塔特军团内助长了竞争，并最终导致了在荷鲁斯叛乱期间被利用的争斗。
Number of Legionaries 军团士兵的数量

The Legions were massive armies, and the size of each could vary tremendously. A precise number was never truly achieved and maintained. Even during the Great Crusade, some Legions were very numerous, while others were not. The numbers  would always vary with new recruits and inevitable battle-losses, and also important was the availability of potential recruits and the administrative skills of the Primarch and his officers.
军团是一支庞大的军队，每支军队的规模可能差异很大。从未真正实现和保持一个精确的数字。即使在大远征期间，一些军团也非常庞大，而另一些则没有。人数总是随着新兵和不可避免的战斗损失而变化，潜在新兵的可用性以及原体及其军官的管理技能也很重要。

The most numerous Legion of all was the Ultramarines. The Thousand Sons of Magnus were of a small number as many of them had developed mutations or uncontrollable levels of psychic powers. Fulgrim's samples had been largely lost, and this left the Legion of the Emperor's Children also with a very small number. Both of these Legions would increase their numbers to acceptable standards only after their Primarchs were found.
在所有军团中，人数最多的是极限战士。马格努斯的千子最少，因为他们中的许多人已经展现出突变或无法控制的灵能力量水平。福格瑞姆的样本大部分已经丢失，这使得帝皇之子军团也只有很少的数量。只有在找到他们的原体后，这两个军团才将人数增加到可接受的标准。
The approximate sizes of a few of the Legions at the start of the Heresy have been given in various sources:
叛乱开始时，一些军团的大致规模已在各种来源中给出：
Ultramarines 极限战士 — 250,000
Dark Angels 黑暗天使 — 200,000-
Iron Warriors 钢铁勇士 — 150,000 ~ 180,000
Sons of Horus 荷鲁斯之子 — 130,000 ~ 170,000
World Eaters 吞世者 — 150,000
Word Bearers 怀言者 — 100,000 ~ 150,000
Blood Angels 圣血天使 — 120,000
Night Lords 午夜领主 — 90,000 ~ 120,000
Iron Hands 钢铁之手 — 113,000
Emperor's Children 帝皇之子 — 110,000
Imperial Fists 帝国之拳 — 100,000+
Space Wolves 太空野狼 — 95,000 ~ 100,000
Death Guard 死亡守卫 — 95,000
White Scars 白色伤疤 — 95,000
Alpha Legion 阿尔法军团 — 90,000 ~ 180,000
Salamanders 火蜥蜴 — 89,000
Raven Guard 暗鸦守卫 — 80,000
Thousand Sons 千子 — 85,000

The Legion size issue is contentious, with several types of numbers mentioned in separate sources meant to reflect a general or nominally-sized legion. As well as numbers directly given in sources themselves, several authors have commented on the issue. Pressed with questions about pre-Heresy organisation - although declaring there is not any real information about it — Andy Chambers answered that "Space Marines started out in Legions of approximately 10,000 strong (or more, depending on the specific legion), which were broken down into Chapter-sized Great Companies rather like the Space Wolves (who are renowned for not adopting the Codex Astartes alterations made by Guilliman post-heresy and who thus follow pre-heresy organisation more closely)".

军团规模问题是有争议的，在不同的来源中提到了几种类型的数字，旨在反映一个一般或名义上规模的军团。除了来源本身直接给出的数字外，几位作者也对这个问题发表了评论。当被问及有关叛乱前组织的问题时——尽管声称没有任何关于它的真实信息——安迪·钱伯斯回答说：“星际战士最初是由大约1万人（或更多，取决于具体的军团）组成的军团组成的，这些军团被分解成战团级的大连，就像太空野狼一样（他们以不采用基里曼在叛乱后对阿斯塔特圣典的修改而闻名，因此更密切地遵循叛乱前的组织）”。
Note 1: In The Crimson Fist (Novella) it is mentioned that 20,000 Imperial Fists constituted one-fifth of the entire Legion, making 100,000 the likely number.
注1：在绯红之拳（中篇小说）中提到，20000名帝国之拳占整个军团的五分之一，可能达到100000名。

Before the Word Bearers invasion of the Boros Gate it is mentioned that the Black Legion's strength is unparalleled and that their ranks outnumbered the Word Bearers by almost ten to one. If at that point the Word Bearers kept the ranks at the size of 100,000 space marines it means the Black Legion had vastly increased their numbers to around 1,000,000 space marines.
在怀言者入侵波洛斯门之前，有人提到黑色军团的力量是无与伦比的，他们的队伍几乎是怀言者的十倍。如果在那时，怀言者将队伍保持在10万名星际战士的规模，这意味着黑色军团的人数大大增加，到了约100万名星际战士。

Note 2: Further down the page of the cited source, Betrayal states that this number is leading up to Istvaan III. After the conflict, some 60,000 Sons of Horus Astartes were lost, some of which are the Loyalists. After the betrayal at Istvaan III, the current numbers of the Sons of Horus are estimated to be 70,000-110,000.
注2：在引用的消息来源的下一册-背叛表示，这个数字源于伊斯塔万三号。冲突后，约有6万名荷鲁斯之子的阿斯塔特丧生，其中一些是忠诚派。在伊斯塔万三号的背叛后，荷鲁斯之子目前的人数估计为7万至11万。

Note 3: The novel A Thousand Sons stated the Thousand Sons to be 10,000 strong by the time of the Burning of Prospero. However numbers later provided by The Horus Heresy Book Seven - Inferno stated their size to be 89,000-90,000.
小说千子指出，到普罗斯佩罗之焚时，千子已经有一万人了。然而，荷鲁斯叛乱第七册-炼狱后来提供的数字表明，他们的规模为89000-90000。
Original names and appearances 原始名称和外观

Originally, each Legion was known simply by its number (i.e., the Dark Angels were originally known as I Legion) and had plain grey armour. However upon rediscovering their Primarch the Legion would take his homeworld as their own, gain a name instead of just being known by their number, and change their Power Armour from grey to one consisting of a combination of battle honours and their Primarch's own tastes.
最初，每个军团仅以其编号而闻名（即，黑暗天使最初被称为I军团），并拥有朴素的灰色盔甲。然而，在重新发现他们的原体后，军团将把他的家园世界视为自己的家园，获得一个名称，而不仅仅是他们的编号，并将他们的动力盔甲从灰色变成由战斗荣誉和原体自己的喜好组成的盔甲。

The Emperor saw no problems with this development; the loyalty of the Primarchs to him was believed to be unshakable. This reasoning would be proven to be mistaken as half of the known Legions revolted during the Horus Heresy.
帝皇认为这一发展没有问题；人们相信，原体们对他的忠诚是不可动摇的。这一推理将被证明是错误的，因为已知的军团中有一半在荷鲁斯叛乱期间起义。
I  Angels of Death,The Uncrowned Princes 死亡天使，无冕王子
IV  Corpse Grinders (Unofficial) 尸体研磨机（非官方）
V  Star Hunters,Other informal titles included the Pioneers, Vanguard, Blood Debt, Grey Ghosts 星辰猎手，其他非正式头衔包括开拓者，先锋，血债，灰色幽灵
VI  The Rout,Other informal titles included The Emperor's Executioners 野群，其他非正式头衔包括帝皇的刽子手
VII  None officially.Informal titles included the Stone Men, Iceborn, Sentinels of the Void, Defenders of Terra, His Protectors 无官方，其他非正式头衔包括石人，冰裔，虚空哨兵，泰拉守卫，他的保护者
VIII  None official.Informal titles included the Night's Children, The Terror 无官方，其他非正式头衔包括午夜之子，恐惧
IX  None official.Informal titles included the Revenant Legion, The Eaters of the Dead, The Charnel Feast 无官方，其他非正式头衔包括归来者军团，食尸者，阴森盛宴
X  Storm Walkers,Iron Tenth (informal) 风暴行者，钢铁第十(非官方）
XII  War Hounds 战犬
XIII  War-Born 战争之子
XIV  Dusk Raiders 黄昏突袭者
XV  Thousand Sons 千疮之子
XVI  Luna Wolves 影月苍狼
XVII  Imperial Heralds,Iconoclasts (informal) 帝国传道者，圣像破坏者（非官方）
XVIII  Dragon Warriors,The Fearless (informal, used by Imperial Army) 火龙战士，无惧者（非官方）
XIX  None formally. Informal titles included the Pale Nomads, Dust Clad 无官方，其他非正式头衔包括苍白牧者，覆尘者

XX  None formally.Various informal titles included the Ghost Legion, Harrowing, Unbroken Chain, Strife Wrought, Hydra, Combine, Left Hand of Darkness, Azure Serpent, Amaranth Coil, and simply The Legion 无官方，其他非正式头衔包括幽灵军团，无损之链，冲突制造者，九头蛇，聚合体，暗之左手，蔚蓝毒蛇，以及最简单的军团
De jure the homeworld of the Imperial Fists is Terra, but de facto it is Phalanx.从法律上讲，帝国之拳的家园是泰拉，但事实上是山阵号。
Two Unknown Legions 两支未知的军团

While the nine "Excommunicate Traitoris" Legions are known to the Imperium as the Traitor Legions, of the 2nd and 11th Legions no records remain, including of which side they took during the Horus Heresy. The history of the Dark Angels during the Heresy is similarly known only to themselves, and possibly the Emperor. Therefore, excluding the role of the Dark Angels, there were at least nine, and as many as eleven Legions who took the side of Horus.
虽然帝国将九个“绝罚叛徒”军团称为叛徒军团，但第二和第十一军团没有留下任何记录，包括他们在荷鲁斯叛乱期间站在了哪一方。叛乱时期黑暗天使的历史同样只有他们自己知道，也可能只有帝皇知道。因此，除了黑暗天使的角色，至少有九个，多达十一个军团站在荷鲁斯一边。

Recent writings have shown that the two unknown legions were lost prior to the Heresy. They are referred to as the forgotten and purged. It is rumoured by some members of the Word Bearers Legion that the Astartes from one, if not both, of these unknown Legions were inducted into the Ultramarines after their Primarchs were 'forgotten'. An oath was sworn by the Primarchs to never speak the names of their two lost brothers. The loss of the 2nd and 11th sons grieved Lorgar deeply.
最近的著作表明，这两个未知的军团在叛乱之前就已经消失了。他们被称为被遗忘者和被净化者。有传言说，怀言者军团的一些成员说，这些未知军团中的一个（如果不是两个）的阿斯塔特在他们的原体被“遗忘”后被编入了极限战士军团。原体们宣誓永不说出他们两个失散兄弟的名字。失去第二和第十一原体让珞珈深感悲痛。
Modern Setting 现在环境
Second Founding 二次建军
The loyalist Legions were later reorganised by the Codex Astartes and broken up into several 1,000 Marine-strong Chapters during the Second Founding.
忠诚的军团后来被阿斯塔特圣典重组，并在二次建军期间分为数千个星际战士战团。

A single Chapter kept the name, traditions, rituals, homeworld, and original identity of the origin Legion, while the remaining Chapters received a part of their Legion's gene-seed, new homeworlds, new names, and over time eventually developed their own traditions and identities. These Chapters are known as "Successor Chapters", a title which is not granted to Chapters created during later Foundings.
一个战团保留了原始军团的名称、传统、仪式、家园和原始身份，而其余战团则获得了军团的一部分基因种子、新的家园、新的名字，随着时间的推移，最终发展出了自己的传统和身份。这些战团被称为“子战团”，这是一个不授予后期建军期间创建的战团的头衔。
The nine "original Chapters", to a certain extent, are more highly thought of. These Chapters are called "First Founding Chapters" or something similar.
九个“起源战团”在一定程度上受到了更高的评价。这些战团被称为“初创战团”或类似的东西。
I  Angels of Absolution, Angels of Redemption, Angels of Vengeance 赦免天使、救赎天使、复仇天使
V  Marauders, Rampagers, Destroyers, Storm Lords 掠夺者，狂暴者，毁灭者，风暴领主
VI  Wolf Brothers 狼兄弟
VII  Black Templars, Crimson Fists, Fists Exemplar, Excoriators, Soul Drinkers 黑色圣堂，绯红之拳，典范之拳，责难者，饮魂者
IX  Angels Encarmine, Angels Sanguine, Flesh Tearers, Angels Vermillion, Blood Drinkers 泛红天使，血红天使，撕肉者，朱红天使，饮血者
X  Red Talons, Brazen Claws 鲜红利爪，黄铜之爪

XII  Novamarines, Patriarchs of Ulixis, White Consuls, Black Consuls, Obsidian Glaives, Praetors of Orpheus, Inceptors, Genesis Chapter, Mortifactors, Aurora Chapter, Doom Eagles, Eagle Warriors, Libators, Nemesis, Silver Eagles, Silver Skulls 新星战士，尤利西斯族长，白色执政官，黑色执政官，黑曜石之剑，俄尔普斯执政官，先驱者，起源战团，苦行者，曙光女神，毁灭之鹰，雄鹰勇士，祭祀者，复仇女神，银鹰，银色颅骨
XIX  Black Guard, Raptors, Revilers 黑色守卫，猛禽，谩骂者
There are some works of Imperial literature dealing about the Legions and the Second Founding; the known ones are:
有一些关于军团和二次建军的帝国文学作品；已知的有：

The Mythos Angelica Mortis, which deals mainly with the Astartes Praeses, but also provides information about the Dark Angels and its Successor Chapters. It reports that these Chapters refer to themselves as the "Unforgiven".
死亡天使传说主要讲述阿斯塔特总督，但也提供了关于黑暗天使及其子战团的信息。据报道，这些战团自称“不可饶恕者”。

The Apocrypha of Skaros and the Apocrypha of Davio, the first one tells us that there were 23 Successor Chapters of the Ultramarines, but fails to name them, the second source is able to provide eight names of them.
斯卡洛斯经书和达维奥大典，第一个告诉我们有23个极限战士的子战团，但没有命名，第二个来源能够提供他们中的八个的名字。

In the current Age of The Imperium, nearly three-fifths of all Chapters are "descendants" of the Ultramarines, either directly or indirectly through one of the Ultramarines' Second Founding Chapters. Many records have been lost over time, consequently there are many Chapters which are unaware of which Legion they ultimately descend from.
在当前的帝国时代，近五分之三的战团都是极限战士的“后裔”，无论是直接还是间接通过极限战士的二次建军战团之一。随着时间的推移，许多记录已经丢失，因此有许多战团不知道他们最终来自哪个军团。
The Grey Knights are an exception as this Chapter was created shortly before the Second Founding and its gene-seed is of secret origin.
灰骑士是一个例外，因为该战团是在二次建军前不久创建的，其基因种子是秘密起源的。
Chaos Space Marine Legions 混沌星际战士军团

From a technical standpoint, the "Traitor Legions", are the only Space Marine Legions still in existence. In reality however, all of them have been broken up to some degree and now exist largely as separated individual warbands following rival Chaos Champions. On occasion, a highly successful Chaos Champion, such as Abaddon the Despoiler, is able to reunite these Traitor Legions once more and unleash them upon the galaxy.
从技术角度来看，“叛徒军团”是唯一仍然存在的星际战士军团。然而，在现实中，所有这些都在一定程度上被打破了，现在主要是在竞争混沌冠军之后作为独立的战争团体存在。偶尔，一位非常成功的混沌冠军，如大掠夺者阿巴顿，能够再次团结这些叛徒军团，并将他们释放到银河系。

title: 新血 Newblood
parts: Newbloods were a type of Space Marine during the Horus Heresy.
新血是荷鲁斯叛乱时期的一种星际战士。

These Marines were created during the Heresy itself. Rushed into production to meet the demands of war, they were fully commissioned warriors after only 4 years of training and modification. Though suboptimal to the carefully cultivated Space Marines of the Great Crusade, they were still formidable fighters and were utilized by both sides. The production and training of Newbloods was more unstable and dangerous than normal, and even more Aspirants died during the process than normal. As such, they were often known for their savage and brutal nature.
这些星际战士是在叛乱时期创建的。为了满足战争的需要，他们匆匆投入生产，经过4年的训练和改造，就成为了正式服役的战士。尽管与大远征中精心培养的星际战士相比，他们不是最佳选择，但他们仍然是强大的战士，被双方利用。新血的生产和训练比正常情况更不稳定和危险，在此过程中死亡的有志者甚至比正常情况更多。因此，他们往往以野蛮和残忍的本性而闻名。
Known Newbloods 著名新血
Jangsai Khan - White Scars
江塞可汗 - 白色疤痕
Saduran - Sons of Horus
萨杜兰 - 荷鲁斯之子
Ikrek - Sons of Horus
艾克瑞克 - 荷鲁斯之子

title: 原型军团士兵 Prototype Legionaries
parts: Prototype Legionaries were functional prototypes of Space Marine Legionaries, who were created before the process was perfected by the Imperium.
原型军团士兵是星际战士军团士兵的功能原型，他们是在帝国完善这一过程之前创建的。

Known as the Primordial Strain, almost none of these initial prototypes are known to not have survived the process of becoming Space Marines but they nonetheless formed the basis of the initial culture of the First Legion. The process first began around 550.M30.
被称为原种的这些最初的原型几乎都没有在成为星际战士的过程中幸存下来，但它们仍然构成了第一军团最初文化的基础。这一过程始于550.M30左右。

They were unrefined and ill-favored, when compared to Legionaries, but were still potent and served as the bridge between the unique power of the Primarchs and their sons. The vast majority of the Prototypes were born of the Primarch Lion El'Jonson's Gene-seed, as it was noted for its stability. At least one, however, was created from the genetic material of the Emperor and the Perpetual Erda.
与军团士兵相比，他们没有受过训练，也不受欢迎，但仍然很强大，是连接原体和他们的儿子的独特力量的桥梁。绝大多数原型都是由原体莱昂·艾尔庄森的基因种子产生的，因为它以稳定性而闻名。然而，至少有一个是由帝皇和永恒者尔达的遗传物质创造的。
Known Prototypes 著名原型
Abraxus Ghent - Created from the Primarch Lion El'Jonson's Gene-seed.
阿布拉克斯·根特 - 由原体莱昂·艾尔庄森的基因种子创造。
Leetu - Created from the genetic material of the Emperor and the Perpetual Erda
勒图 - 由帝皇和永恒者尔达的遗传物质创造

title: 两个未知军团 Two Unknown Legions
parts: Precious little is known about two of the twenty Space Marine Legions, numbered II and XI, and their respective Primarchs, as their records are simply noted as having been "expunged" or "destroyed" in Imperial listings of the 20 Legions.
关于20个星际战士军团中的两个，编号为II和XI，以及他们各自的原体，我们知之甚少，因为他们的记录在帝国列出的20个军团中被简单地记为“删除”或“销毁”。

Nothing is known for sure about the names of the Legions, their Primarchs, homeworlds and their ultimate fate. There are conflicting reports as to whether the two unknown Legions met their fate prior to or after the Horus Heresy and which side they joined in the Heresy, if they participated in it at all.
关于军团的名字、他们的原体、家园世界和他们的最终命运，目前还没有确切的消息。关于这两个未知的军团是在荷鲁斯叛乱之前还是之后遭遇了他们的命运，以及他们加入了叛乱的哪一方（如果他们参与了叛乱的话），有相互矛盾的报告。
Overview 概述
Currently, all that is stated about this issue is:
目前，关于这个问题的说法是：
The Emperor created 20 Primarchs, who were snatched from Terra by a Chaos vortex and scattered around the galaxy.
帝皇创造了20位原体，他们被混沌漩涡从泰拉中夺走，分散在银河系中。

The 20 incubation capsules drifted through the warp for decades or even centuries, until finally coming to rest on human-inhabited worlds throughout the galaxy, "where they were variously adopted by human parents."
这20个孵化舱在亚空间中漂流了几十年甚至几个世纪，直到最终停在整个银河系的人类居住的世界上，“在那里它们被人类父母收养了。”
The only exception to this is the Primarch Konrad Curze, who survived utterly alone (and whose background, in any case, was only described in later material).
唯一的例外是原体康拉德·科兹，他独自一人幸存下来（无论如何，他的背景只在后来的材料中有所描述）。

In the listings of the 20 Legions in Imperial records, Legions II and XI are stated as having "all records expunged from the library". Earlier background (Codex Imperialis and second edition's Ultramarines Codex) less ambivalently states that the records for these two Legions were deleted following the Heresy. Considering that the Traitor Legions are simply listed as excommunicate traitoris but still included in these same lists, this suggests that the records were deleted deliberately and for a reason only known by those who perpetrated the action.
在帝国记录中列出的20个军团中，第二和十一军团被称为“从图书馆中删除了所有记录”。早期的背景（帝国圣典和第二版的极限战士圣典）不那么矛盾地指出，这两个军团的记录在叛乱之后被删除了。考虑到叛徒军团只是被列为绝罚叛逆，但仍被列入这些名单，这表明这些记录是故意删除的，其原因只有实施行动的人知道。
The Emperor met each Primarch in turn, and each Primarch had risen to a position of authority within the cultures in which they had found themselves.
帝皇依次会见了每位原体，每位原体都在他们所处的文明中获得了权威地位。
20 Legions took part in the Great Crusade, each led by their own Primarch.
20个军团参加了大远征，每个军团都由自己的原体领导。
Alpharius was known to be the last Primarch to be found, a fact which even earned him the nickname "The Last". This suggests that all the other Primarchs had been found already.
众所周知，阿尔法瑞斯是最后一位被发现的原体，这一事实甚至为他赢得了“最终者”的绰号。这表明所有其他的原体都已经被发现了。

20 statues of the Primarchs were erected in the Imperial Palace on Terra. By the time of the Horus Heresy, plinths II and XI "[...] had been vacant for a long time. No-one ever spoke of those two absent brothers [and] their separate tragedies."
20尊原体雕像竖立在泰拉上的皇宫。到荷鲁斯叛乱时期，第二和十一的底座“（…）已经空置了很长一段时间。没有人谈论过这两个缺席的兄弟（和）他们各自的悲剧。”
This suggests that the two unknown Primarchs had been found previously and that something tragic had happened. The two Primarchs were "absent" but not referred to as "dead".
这表明之前已经发现了这两位未知的原体，并且发生了悲剧。这两位原体“缺席”，但并未被称为“死亡”。

Prior to sending Sigismund and his Imperial Fists to Mars during the Heresy, Dorn mused to Malcador on the loyalist support of two Legions, possibly the two unknown Legions, during the Heresy. Malcador quelled the Primarch's thoughts, stating that "They are lost to us forever."
在叛乱期间将西吉斯蒙德和他的帝国之拳派往火星之前，多恩向马卡多沉思了叛乱期间两个军团的忠诚支持，可能是两个未知的军团。马卡多平息了原体的想法，说：“我们永远失去了他们。”

Horus convinced "no less than 9" Space Marine Legions to side with him at the onset of the Heresy, a number also referred to as "fully half" of the Legions. When he assaulted Terra, this number was given as 9.
荷鲁斯在叛乱开始时说服了“不少于9个”星际战士军团与他站在一起，这个数字也被称为军团的“整整一半”。当他袭击泰拉时，这个数字是9。

This also implies, but does not categorically state, that the 9 known Traitor Legions are all of the Legions that followed him into rebellion and that 18 Legions were the total number of Legions active at the time. A passage detailing Horus's plans for the various Legions at the outset of the Heresy mentions by name all 18 known Legions
这也意味着，但并没有明确指出，9个已知的叛徒军团都是跟随他叛乱的军团，18个军团是当时活跃的军团总数。一段详细描述荷鲁斯在叛乱开始时对各个军团的计划的段落提到了所有18个已知的军团

"Of the original 20 Primarchs, only 9 survived the Horus Heresy. The remainder were either killed in the fighting (like Horus) or fled with their [Legions] into the Eye of Terror. The survivors helped [to rebuild] the Imperium."
“在最初的20位原体中，只有9位在荷鲁斯叛乱中幸存下来。其余的要么在战斗中被杀（像荷鲁斯一样），要么带着他们的[军团]逃到恐惧之眼。幸存者帮助[重建]了帝国。”

It is currently accepted that 3 Primarchs died during the Heresy (Ferrus Manus, Sanguinius, and Horus) and 6 are known to have fled into the Eye of Terror (Fulgrim, Perturabo, Angron, Mortarion, Magnus, and Lorgar). The fates of the other 11 are open to multiple interpretations. However, Roboute Guilliman was held in stasis (as his throat was cut) until his resurrection at the end of M41 and Lion El'Jonson has now also returned, at the climax of the Arks Of Omen campaign.
目前普遍认为，有3位原体在叛乱期间死亡（费鲁斯·马努斯、圣吉列斯和荷鲁斯），6位已知已逃入恐惧之眼（福格瑞姆、佩图拉博、安格隆、莫塔里安、马格努斯和珞珈）。其他11人的命运有多种解释。然而，罗伯特·基里曼一直处于停滞状态（因为他的喉咙被割断了），直到他在M41结束时复活，莱昂·艾尔庄森现在也回来了，在噩兆方舟战役的高潮。

Two traitors, Konrad Curze and Alpharius, did not flee into the Eye of Terror and were killed later on. 7 loyal Primarchs seem to have survived. It is possible that Curze and Alpharius were counted as part of the 9 survivors. However, in the novel Betrayer it mentions the "18 Legions", a clear statement that the unknown Legions disappeared before the Heresy and played no part in them.
康拉德·科兹和阿尔法瑞斯这两个叛徒没有逃到恐惧之眼，后来被杀。7名忠诚的原体似乎幸存了下来。科兹和阿尔法瑞斯可能是9名幸存者中的一员。然而，在小说《背叛者》中，它提到了“18个军团”，明确表示未知的军团在叛乱之前就消失了，没有参与其中。
Other Information 其他信息
Ultramarines Codex 极限战士圣典

Second Edition's Ultramarines Codex states that it seems likely that Legions II and XI fought for Horus at least during the beginning of the Heresy. It also refers to the records as being destroyed following the Heresy. However, this conflicts with more recent information in the novel The First Heretic where Magnus and Lorgar discuss the two unknown Primarchs and the death of them and their Legions 43 years before the Drop Site Massacre.
第二版的极限战士圣典指出，似乎第二军团和十一军团至少在叛乱开始时为荷鲁斯而战。它还提到记录在叛乱之后被销毁。然而，这与小说《叛乱之首》中的最新信息相冲突，马格努斯和珞珈在小说中讨论了两位未知的原体，以及他们和他们的军团在登陆点大屠杀43年前的死亡。
False Gods 伪神

As Horus lay in coma inside the Davinite temple after being wounded by Eugen Temba, Erebus gave him visions that showed him events from various points in time. In one of these experiences, Horus found himself in the geno-vault where he was created, and looked down upon the genetor-tanks containing the infant Primarchs. At one point he stopped before tank XI and reflected upon the "untapped glories that lay within, knowing they would never come to pass". This referred to one of the unknown Primarchs. Later on, Horus's anger took control and he smashed his fist upon tank XI, damaging it. Shortly after, a vortex swooped up all the genetor-tanks and scattered them across the galaxy.

荷鲁斯在被欧根·坦巴打伤后昏迷在戴文神庙内，艾瑞巴斯给了他幻象，向他展示了不同时间点的事件。在其中一次经历中，荷鲁斯发现自己身处他被创造的基因库，并俯视着装有婴儿原体的基因水箱。有一次，他在XI号箱前停了下来，思考着“内在尚未开发的荣耀，知道它们永远不会实现”。这指的是一位未知的原体。后来，荷鲁斯的怒火控制了局面，他用拳头砸在XI号箱上，损坏了水箱。不久之后，一个漩涡袭击了所有的基因水箱，并将它们分散到银河系。
The truth of this vision is unclear; it should be noted that the whole experience was orchestrated by the Chaos powers, in other words, Horus saw what the Chaos Gods wanted him to see.
这一幻象的真相尚不清楚；应该指出的是，整个经历都是由混沌力量精心策划的，换句话说，荷鲁斯看到了混沌诸神想让他看到的东西。
Red Fury 赤红狂怒

When Dante asked the Blood Angels' Successor Chapters for men to bring the Blood Angels back to full strength, having suffered heavy casualties during Arkio's heresy, Gabriel Seth, Chapter Master of the Flesh Tearers, made a counter to this demand: disband the Blood Angels and spread them amongst the Successors. When Orloc (Chapter Master of the Blood Drinkers) protested that there was no way a First Founding Chapter could end like this, Seth retorted that, actually, it has happened before.
当但丁要求圣血天使的子战团让人们将圣血天使带回全部力量时，在阿基奥的叛乱中遭受了重大伤亡，撕肉者战团战团长加百列·赛斯对这一要求做出了回应：解散圣血天使并将其分散在子战团中。当奥洛克（饮血者的战团长）抗议初次建军战团不可能以这种方式结束时，赛斯反驳说，事实上，这种情况以前也发生过。

This statement is no definite indicator, as the two Unknown Legions were Legions and not Chapters. Additionally, James Swallow is known for taking certain liberties with the way he depicts the Blood Angels. Technically, there are no First Founding Chapters, as Chapters in that sense did not come into existence before the Second Founding (which Swallow might be referring to as "First").
这一说法并不是一个明确的指标，因为这两个未知军团是军团，而不是战团。此外，詹姆斯·斯沃洛以对描绘圣血天使的方式采取某些自由而闻名。从技术上讲，没有初次建军战团，因为从这个意义上讲，战团在二次建军之前并不存在（斯沃洛可能会称之为“初次”）。
The Crimson Fist 深红之拳

In the short story The Crimson Fist, Sigismund looks at the shrouded statues of the Traitor Primarchs, and says that they are traitors and should be torn down. This could be a hint saying that the two missing statues were torn down because the unknown Primarch(s) were traitors as well. But using information from Betrayer, this would mean they were traitorous before the Heresy.
在短篇小说《深红之拳》中，西吉斯蒙德看着被覆盖的叛徒原体雕像，说他们是叛徒，应该被拆除。这可能是一个暗示，说这两个丢失的雕像被拆除是因为未知的原体也是叛徒。但根据《背叛者》的信息，这意味着他们在叛乱之前是叛徒。
The First Heretic 叛乱之首
The First Heretic (Novel) sheds more light on the subject of the two unknown Primarchs:
《叛乱之首》（小说）更深入地揭示了两位未知的原体的话题：

The Lost Primarchs were erased from Imperial records at least 43 years prior to the events of Isstvan V, as only eighteen Legions are referenced during the events at Monarchia. This could be a precursor to the Horus Heresy, the belligerents serving the Chaos Gods. However, this seems unlikely as the Primarchs would be aware of Chaos, yet are easily seduced by it.
在伊斯塔万五号事件发生前至少43年，失落的原体从帝国记录中被抹去，因为在摩纳齐亚事件中只有18个军团被提及。这可能是荷鲁斯叛乱的前身，即为混沌诸神服务的交战者。然而，这似乎不太可能，因为原体们会意识到混沌，但很容易被它诱惑。

It is implied that the Emperor personally cast aside the two lost Primarchs: "I fear the Emperor will break the Word Bearers - and break me. We would be cast alongside the brothers we no longer speak of."
这意味着帝皇亲自抛弃了两位失落的原体：“我担心帝皇会摧毁持词者，也会摧毁我。我们会被抛弃在我们不再谈论的兄弟身边。”

In response to the previous quote, Magnus the Red mentions that, prior to the events at Monarchia, the Emperor had considered expunging Lorgar and the Word Bearers in the same manner as the II and XI Legions, due to their religiosity. He was talked out of doing so by several other Primarchs, including Leman Russ, Horus, and Magnus himself, with Russ arguing that he did not wish to lose a third brother (although Magnus believed he was motivated more by his own spirituality). This implies that Lorgar's religiosity was on par with what they had done in some way, even if they were not necessarily purged for the same reason.
在回应前一句话时，赤红之马格努斯提到，在摩纳齐亚事件发生之前，帝皇曾考虑以与第二和十一军团相同的方式抹去珞珈和怀言者，因为他们的宗教信仰。他被其他几位原体说服不要这样做，包括黎曼·鲁斯、荷鲁斯和马格努斯本人，鲁斯认为他不想失去第三个兄弟（尽管马格努斯认为他更多的是受到自己的精神激励）。这意味着珞珈的宗教信仰在某种程度上与他们所做的事情相当，即使他们不一定因为同样的原因而被清除。
Throughout the remainder of the Great Crusade, the remaining Primarchs swore an oath not to even talk about the lost Primarchs.
在大远征的剩余时间里，剩下的原体们发誓甚至不谈论失落的原体。

The lost Primarchs/Legions are referred to as 'the forgotten and the purged'. This could simply be a way of describing traitors, or they are references to the individual Legions (i.e. one Legion "the forgotten" and the other "the purged").
失落的原体/军团被称为“被遗忘和被清洗者”。这可能只是描述叛徒的一种方式，也可能是指单个军团（即一个军团“被遗忘”，另一个军团则“被清洗”）。
Magnus confirms that the Emperor personally purged the two lost Primarchs/Legions from history.
马格努斯证实，帝皇亲自将两名失落的原体/军团从历史中清除。

During the vision of the Gal Vorbak, the eleventh Primarch is referenced as still being innocent and pure prior to the scattering of the Primarchs. This implies that the eleventh Primarch either becomes corrupted or is guilty of some degree of transgression against the Emperor/Imperium, or both. One of the Gal Vorbak also says that killing the eleventh Primarch in the past would "save them a lot of trouble", which could be interpreted as meaning the Word Bearers had some connection to "dealing" with the Legion.
在受祝之子的视野中，第十一位原体被认为在原体分散之前仍然是无辜和纯洁的。这意味着第十一位原体要么腐化，要么对帝皇/帝国犯下某种程度的罪行，或者两者兼而有之。受祝之子中的一位还说，在过去杀死第十一位原体将“为他们省去很多麻烦”，这可以被解释为怀言者与“处理”军团有某种联系。

Both lost Legions are said to have been expunged from Imperial records for 'good reason'. Argel Tal notes specifically that killing the eleventh Primarch in his infancy would 'unwrite a shameful future'.
据说，这两支失落的军团都有“充分的理由”从帝国记录中删除。安格尔·塔尔特别指出，在第十一位原体幼年时期杀死他将“不会写出一个可耻的未来”。

A rumour is revealed that could explain what ultimately became of the II and XI Legions. Around the time that the II and XI Legions were expunged from Imperial records, the Ultramarines Legion swelled in Astartes numbers to eclipse all other Legions. It could merely be a rumour, or it could actually be the case that the II and XI Legions' Astartes were inducted into the XIII Legion after they were officially expunged from Imperial records. If this were true, it would suggest that the legionnaires of the II and/or the XI had not committed any offence, the crime instead residing with the Primarch(s) and possibly a minority of the Legion(s). This rumour, however, still does not explain what actually happened to the II and XI Primarchs. Furthermore, multiple people express skepticism about the idea when it is brought up, with Ingethel referring to it as 'insipid conjecture'.

有传言说，这可能解释了第二和十一军团的最终结局。大约在第二和十一军团被从帝国记录中删除的时候，极限战士军团的阿斯塔特数量膨胀到了超过了所有其他军团。这可能只是一个谣言，也可能是第二和十一军团的阿斯塔特在被正式从帝国记录中删除后被编入第十三军团的事实。如果这是真的，这将表明第二和/或十一军团没有犯下任何罪行，而是与原体（们）和可能的少数军团（们）一起犯罪。然而，这个谣言仍然无法解释第二和十一原体的实际情况。此外，当这个想法被提出时，许多人表示怀疑，英格泰尔称之为“平淡的猜测”。
Prospero Burns 普罗斯佩罗之焚

In the novel Prospero Burns, on an assault run into a new war zone, a group of Space Wolves were growling over the announcement of Horus as Warmaster. When asked if they were angry over the announcement, and whether they thought that Leman Russ should have been given leadership, the Rune Priest leading the pack said that they were really just angry that they could not be present for the announcement, since this was the last time the Emperor would fight with His Legions. He went on to explain that all the Primarchs and their Legions were created with a purpose or "wyrd". One was destined to be the Emperor's statesman, one to be His storm trooper, one to lead His armies, and so on. Horus was always destined to be Warmaster, the priest said. When the Rune Priest was asked what Leman Russ's wyrd was, the priest stated simply "He is the Emperor's executioner". This gives the reason why it was the Space Wolves that were sent to destroy the Thousand Sons.

在小说《普罗斯佩罗之焚》中，一群太空野狼在突袭一个新的战区时，对荷鲁斯被宣布为战帅咆哮。当被问及他们是否对这一宣布感到愤怒，以及他们是否认为黎曼·鲁斯应该被赋予领导权时，领导队伍的符文牧师说，他们真的只是因为不能出席这一宣布而感到愤怒，因为这是帝皇最后一次与他的军团作战。他接着解释说，所有的原体和他们的军团都是为了一个目的或“命运”而创建的。一个注定要成为帝皇的政治家，一个是他的突击队员，一个领导他的军队，等等。牧师说，荷鲁斯注定要成为战帅。当符文牧师被问及黎曼·鲁斯的命运是什么时，牧师简单地说：“他是帝皇的刽子手”。这就解释了为什么是太空野狼被派去摧毁千子。

In a conversation near the end of the novel, Leman Russ discussed the coming destruction of the Thousand Sons Legion. When asked if he was concerned over the fact that Space Marines were fighting other Space Marines, he commented that this was not the first time the Wolves had been called on to perform this task. This might be a reference to the possible destruction of the II and/or XI Legion. However, Leman Russ could be referring to when he and his Legion battled the World Eaters during the Great Crusade, or when he fought against Lion El'Johnson and the Dark Angels.
在小说接近尾声的一次谈话中，黎曼·鲁斯讨论了千子军团即将被摧毁的问题。当被问及是否担心星际战士正在与其他星际战士作战时，他评论说，这不是野狼第一次被要求执行这项任务。这可能是指第二和/或十一军团可能被摧毁。然而，黎曼·鲁斯可能指的是他和他的军团在大远征期间与吞世者作战的时候，或者他与莱昂·艾尔庄森和黑暗天使作战的时候。

All of these events happen just prior to Horus openly turning against the Emperor. This seems to corroborate that both the II and XI Legions had been destroyed or expunged prior to the start of the Horus Heresy, and as such, neither one of these Legions took part in the events of the Heresy itself.
所有这些事件都发生在荷鲁斯公开对抗帝皇之前。这似乎证实了第二和十一军团在荷鲁斯叛乱开始之前已经被摧毁或抹去，因此，这两个军团都没有参加叛乱本身的事件。

Kasper Hawser, during his narrative in the 13th chapter of the book, states: "The fortress homes of the All-father's eighteen Legions Astartes are the most formidable and impregnable sites in the new Imperium." This appears to clearly indicate that the missing Legions were gone prior to the Burning of Prospero, thus prior to the Horus Heresy.
卡斯帕·豪瑟尔在本书第13章的叙述中指出：“全父的十八个阿斯塔特军团的堡垒是新帝国中最强大、最坚不可摧的地点。”这似乎清楚地表明，失落的军团在普罗斯佩罗之焚之前就已经消失了，因此在荷鲁斯叛乱之前。
Deliverance Lost 拯救星陷落

In the novel Deliverance Lost, in Corax's reflection on his first meeting with the Emperor, the Emperor mentions that there are seventeen other Primarchs. When Corax asks how this can be possible, as he is the nineteenth, the Emperor's face becomes "bleak, filled with deep sorrow", and He says that it is "... a conversation for another day." This indicates that the II and XI Legions were already lost, and possibly expunged, by the time that Corax was reunited with the Emperor. It also suggests that they were lost in the earlier years of the Crusade, as the Emperor mentions that most of the other Primarchs had already been discovered by the time that He came to Lycaeus.
在小说《拯救星陷落》中，在科拉克斯对他与帝皇第一次会面的回忆中，帝皇提到还有其他十七位原体。当科拉克斯问这怎么可能，因为他是第十九个，帝皇的脸变得“黯淡，充满了深深的悲伤”，他说这是“……另一天的对话”。这表明，当科拉克斯与帝皇团聚时，第二和十一军团已经失落，可能已经被抹去。这也表明，他们在远征的早期就已经迷失了方向，因为帝皇提到，在他来到吕凯乌斯时，大多数其他原体已经被发现了。
The Outcast Dead 放逐死者

In the novel The Outcast Dead, Evander Gregoras, the Master of the Cryptaesthesians, states that the "Wolves will be loosed again", this time to make an example of Magnus who used forbidden powers to contact the Emperor. Assuming that the Space Wolves are meant, this implies that there are people apart from the Emperor and the Primarchs who are aware of what had happened and confirms the role of the Space Wolves as an instrument to sanction other Legions and Primarchs.
在小说《放逐死者》中，隐知大师埃文德·格雷格拉斯表示“野狼将再次被释放”，这一次是以马格努斯使用被禁止的力量联系帝皇为例。假设太空野狼是本意，这意味着除了帝皇和原体之外，还有其他人知道发生了什么，并证实了太空野狼作为制裁其他军团和原体的工具的作用。
A Thousand Sons 千子
In the novel A Thousand Sons, during the Ullanor Triumph, Magnus the Red mentions missing Primarchs in the conversation with Mortarion.
在小说《千儿》中，在乌兰诺胜利期间，赤红之马格努斯在与莫塔里安的对话中提到了失落的原体。
"Brother," said Magnus, ignoring Mortarion's words. "A great day is it not? Nine sons of the Emperor gathered together on one world, such a thing has not happened since..."
“兄弟，”马格努斯说，无视莫塔里安的话。“这不是一个伟大的日子吗？帝皇的九个儿子聚集在一个世界上，从那以后就没有发生过这样的事情……”
"I know well when it was, Magnus," said Mortarion, his voice robust and resolute in contrast to his pallid features. "And the Emperor forbade us to speak of it again. Do you disobey that command?"
“我很清楚那是什么时候，马格努斯，”莫塔里安说，他的声音与苍白的面容形成鲜明对比。“帝皇禁止我们再提这件事。你不服从这个命令吗？”

In the prologue of Fear to Tread, Sanguinius is called to deal with one of his Blood Angels, Alatros, who has succumbed to the Red Thirst. Horus witnesses his brother kill Alatros and asks why he did it. When Horus asks Sanguinius why he never talked about that with his Primarch brothers and, above all, why he never asked for help from their creator, the Emperor, Sanguinius replies he feared the most radical solution his father could propose:

在《惧于踏足》的序言中，圣吉列斯被召唤去对付他的一位圣血天使阿拉托斯，他死于血渴。荷鲁斯目睹了他的兄弟杀死阿拉托斯，并问他为什么这样做。天使最初拒绝回答，但随后透露了血渴的存在，这是圣血天使基因种子中的一个缺陷，使他的军团士兵变成了无脑、嗜血的杀手，除了少数人外，他对整个军团保密。当荷鲁斯问圣吉列斯为什么他从未与他的原体兄弟谈论过这件事，最重要的是，为什么他从未向他们的创造者帝皇寻求帮助时，圣吉列斯回答说，他担心父亲会提出最激进的解决方案：

"You know the reason! [...] I will not be responsible for the erasure of the Blood Angels from Imperial history. I will not have a third empty plinth beneath the roof of the Hegemon as my Legion's only memorial!"
“你知道原因！[…]我不会对从帝国历史上抹去圣血天使负责。我不会在霸权的顶部之下有第三个空底座作为我的军团唯一的纪念碑！”
This response implies that the Legions were purged because of an inherent flaw in their gene-seed and Sanguinius fears the same fate.
这一反应意味着军团被清除是因为他们的基因种子存在固有缺陷，圣吉列斯担心同样的命运。

In the Forge World book The Horus Heresy Book One - Betrayal, the Primarchs and their Legions are listed in a table with the names of the II and XI Legions and Primarchs blacked out only as far as the text concealed. 在FW的书《荷鲁斯叛乱之书第一册-背叛》中，原体和他们的军团被列在一张表中，第二和十一军团和原体的名字只在隐藏文本的范围内被涂黑。这些黑线的长度表明，第二军团的名称相当长，仅略短于“帝皇”，十一军团的名称与“千子”的长度大致相同。二号原体的名字大约和“阿尔法瑞斯”一样长（也只是一个名字），十一号原体的名称大约和“赤红之马格努斯”一样长。在同一页上，这本书还指出，“在这二十个军团中，随着时间的推移，人数稳步增加，到大远征结束时，十八个军团幸存下来，成长为庞大的部队 — 至于那些没有幸存下来的军团，这个记录中什么也无法说出。”
Also, in a section of the book discussing the Primarchs, the author notes that
此外，在本书中讨论原体的一节中，作者指出

Over the course of the Great Crusade the Emperor was reunited with each Primarch in turn and, save two whose secrets are far beyond this record, each was sooner or later placed in command of one of the Emperor's Space Marine Legions as its master, second only in authority to the Emperor itself.
在大远征的过程中，帝皇依次与每位原体重聚，除了两位其秘密远远超出此记录的原体外，每位原体迟早都会被任命为帝皇的星际战士军团的一名指挥官，仅次于帝皇本身。

This suggests that the two lost Primarchs never led their respective Legions before being purged from Imperial records. However, this seemingly contradicts the story The Chamber at the End of Memory, where Malcador the Sigillite, one of the few who still remembers what happened to the Primarchs, states that whatever fate befell them left their Legions' Space Marines adrift and leaderless, implying that this event (or events) had stripped them of their leadership. It also contradicts the novel Fulgrim: The Palatine Phoenix, where Fulgrim explicitly refers to the Primarch of the II Legion, his "quiet brother", as the "Master of the Second".

这表明，这两位失落的原体在从帝国记录中清除之前从未领导过各自的军团。然而，这似乎与《记忆尽头的房间》的故事相矛盾，在这个故事中，掌印者马卡多是少数几个仍然记得原体发生的事情的人之一，他说，无论命运如何，他们的星际战士军团都会漂泊无依，没有领导者，这意味着这一事件（或多个事件）剥夺了他们的领导权。这也与小说《福格瑞姆：帝国凤凰》相矛盾，在小说中，福格瑞姆明确地将他的“安静的兄弟”第二军团的原体称为“第二军团之主”。

The book also includes a Galactic Map of the Great Crusade era Imperium, circa 892.005.M31. All the important planets, Calth, Terra, Fenris, Prospero, Baal, Inwit, Hellion, etc... are listed. Every known Primarchs' homeworld is shown in its respective location. However, in the Segmentum Pacificus there's a spot known as the "Finding of the Lost Son". This could be a reference to Alpharius as he was the last to be found and his homeworld never revealed, or it could reference where one of the lost Primarchs were originally found.
这本书还包括一张大约892.005.M31的大远征时期帝国的银河地图。列出了所有重要的行星，如考斯、泰拉、芬里斯、普罗斯佩罗、巴尔、因维特、赫利恩等。每个已知的原体的家园世界都显示在各自的位置。然而，在太平星域有一个地方被称为“寻找丢失的儿子”。这可能是对阿尔法瑞斯的提及，因为他是最后一个被发现的人，他的家园世界从未被揭示，也可能是对其中一位失落的原体最初被发现的地方的提及。

《荷鲁斯叛乱第二册 - 屠杀》中的时间线列出了两个事件，即965和969.M30的《所有数据已编辑》，其中太空野狼军团被列为参与方。这可能是野狼对两支未知军团的毁灭。

然而，在《叛乱之首》第10章中，珞珈和马格努斯之间的对话发生在摩纳齐亚被夷为平地后不到七个月的时间里（在时间线上被列为发生在964.M30），这意味着未知的军团已经从记录中消失了一段时间。如果这两个来源都是正确的，这将意味着在野狼摧毁军团之前，军团仍然以某种形式活跃。

In a dialogue between the Primarch Vulkan and his equery Artellus Numeon on Kharaatan during the Great Crusade, the Drakelord confesses to the Captain that he has seen darkness in the heart of his fellow Primarch Konrad Curze. At a direct question of Numeon asking if it was not wise to discuss the matter with Horus or Rogal Dorn, Vulkan replies:
在大远征期间，在哈拉坦的原体沃坎他的侍从官阿泰勒斯·努梅昂之间的对话中，火龙领主向连长承认，他看到了他的同胞原体康拉德·科兹内心的黑暗。当努梅昂直接询问与荷鲁斯或罗格·多恩讨论此事是否不明智时，沃坎回答说：

“我（很困扰）阿泰勒斯。非常困扰。我们都不希望再次受到制裁，希望大群英广场再次出现一根空柱子，希望从所有记录中删除另一个兄弟的名字。为两个人承受悲痛已经够可耻的了。我不想再增加了，但我还有什么选择呢？”

这一回应意味着军团因某种原因受到制裁和净化。

In the creation history of the Alpha Legion, some names were REDACTED three times. One suggests to us about the failed Legion created from the source of potentially tainted population. 在阿尔法军团的创建历史中，一些名字被修改了三次。有人向我们提出，从潜在污染人口的来源创建了失败的军团。另一种观点认为，帝皇将他们消灭是一次失败的实验，并且没有通过原型军团状态（军团从1000-2000名原型星际战士发展到数万名完全成长的军团的时间）。另一种观点认为，与二十军团一样，其中一支被摧毁的军团与“禁军军团实验”和“拉布里克北极星事件”有关。

In The Horus Heresy Book Seven, it is hinted that one or perhaps both of the missing Legions were lost during the Rangdan Xenocides. However, much of the account is left deliberately redacted.

In the revised edition of the novel Dark Imperium, released in 2021, Roboute Guilliman briefly mentions and discusses the two unknown Primarchs during a conversation with the priest Frater Mathieu:

'I was one of twenty. Two failed. Half the rest turned on my father. The Emperor is not infallible, nor am I.' The blasphemy was intended to provoke the priest. A cheap tactic. Mathieu was thankfully unmoved.
“我是二十个人中的一个。两个失败了。剩下的一半都背叛了我父亲。帝皇不是绝对可靠的，我也不是。”亵渎神灵是为了激怒牧师。一种廉价的策略。谢天谢地，马蒂厄没有动。
‘Twenty?’ The priest arched an eyebrow.
“二十？”牧师扬起眉毛。
‘Yes,’ said Guilliman.
“是的，”基里曼说。
‘Not eighteen? Nine holy primarchs, nine fallen devils? That is what the scriptures say.’
“不是十八个？九个神圣的原体，九个堕落的魔鬼？这就是经文所说的”

虽然次级可能只是指叛徒原体，但这可能意味着失落的军团的原体应该为他们各自的失落负责，而不是他们的星际战士。这与掌印者马卡多在《记忆尽头的房间》中的证词是一致的，他在证词中声称，两个军团的星际战士被思维抹除，并被用于其他地方，而不是分享他们各自原体的命运；他特别将此描述为一种慈悲之举。这可能表明考尔对两个军团发生的事情有所了解。
