title: 铁带 Belt of Iron
parts: The Belt of Iron is a vast region of space, comprising thousands of Systems across the borders of Segmentum Tempestus and Segmentum Pacificus. The name comes from the countless Forge Worlds located in the region, which warred upon each other during the Horus Heresy.
铁带是一个广阔的空间区域，由跨越暴风星域和太平星域边界的数千个星系组成。这个名字来自该地区无数的铸造世界，它们在荷鲁斯叛乱期间相互争斗。
The Belt of Iron 铁带
History 历史

Most of the Forge Worlds within the Belt of Iron were settled before the Age of Strife and managed to weather the subsequent millennia in complete isolation. So isolated, each Forge World wrote its own history and established their own empires. When the Great Crusade pushed into the region the nascent Imperial encountered a series of geographically close but vastly different Forge Worlds. The first wave of Imperial expansion recruited Graia, Kalibrax, and Urdesh and their respective Titan Legions. The armies of these Forge Worlds joined the Crusade and were subsequently granted additional territories as a mark of loyalty. During this time, forces such as the Legio Astraman and Legio Kulisaetai fought against fellow Forge Worlds which refused to join the Imperium.

铁带内的大多数铸造世界都是在纷争时代之前被定居的，并设法在完全隔离的情况下度过了随后的数千年。如此孤立，每个铸造世界都写下了自己的历史，建立了自己的帝国。当大远征进入该地区时，新生的帝国遇到了一系列地理位置相近但截然不同的铸造世界。帝国扩张的第一波招募了格拉亚、卡利布拉克斯和乌尔德什以及他们各自的泰坦军团。这些铸造世界的军队加入了远征，随后被授予额外的领土作为忠诚的标志。在此期间，旅星者军团和库利塞泰军团等部队与拒绝加入帝国的铸造世界同行作战。

By the end of the Crusade the Belt of Iron spanned from Atar-Median to Graia and Valia-Maximal. During the subsequent Horus Heresy the disparate loyalties and ideals within this region proved a fertile ground for the agents of Fabricator-General Kelbor-Hal and many worlds rose up against the Emperor. In the ensuing Cataclysm of Iron, the region was devastated.
远征结束时，铁带从阿塔尔·梅迪安延伸到格拉亚和瓦利亚-马克西马尔。在随后的荷鲁斯叛乱时期，该地区不同的忠诚和理想被证明是铸造将军凯尔博-哈尔的特工的沃土，许多世界都起来对抗帝皇。在随后的铁灾中，该地区遭到了破坏。

title: 47-16 Forty-seven sixteen
parts: Forty-seven sixteen was the Imperial designation given to a Human World destroyed by the Word Bearers during the Great Crusade. Its name before encountering the Imperium has been lost to time
47-16是帝国对在大远征期间被怀言者摧毁的人类世界的称呼。在遇到帝国之前，它的名字已经随着时间的推移而消失了
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Forty-Seven Sixteen
Population:~200,000,000; Unknown after re-population
人口：约2亿；再后人口未知
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Unknown, former Civilised World
类别：未知，前文明世界
Overview 概述

A beautiful, clean world riddled with crystalline cities, the people of 47-16 worshipped the Emperor as a god due to a copy of the Lectitio Divinitatus they had received. The society was advanced, using crystalized artificial soldiers in battle nicknamed Obsidians by the Word Bearers.
这是一个美丽、干净的世界，到处都是水晶城市，47-16的人们因为收到了一本《帝皇圣言录》而把帝皇当作神来崇拜。这个社会是先进的，在战斗中使用了被怀言者昵称为黑曜石的结晶人造士兵。

The human inhabitants of 47-16 could trace their history back for over four thousand years of separation from any other human civilization, and had come to think of Terra as a myth. As a result, they were overjoyed when the Word Bearers envoys, led by First Captain Kor Phaeron, arrived. The First Captain's initial impression, however, was less positive. He reported back that the entire population were heathen idolaters and considered them beyond redemption. While some of the senior commanders at the briefing (such as Sor Talgron) believed that the populace could be re-educated into belief in the Emperor, Kor Phaeron thought they should be exterminated. The First Captain, along with Erebus, communicated the news to their primarch, who finally emerged from his seclusion. Announcing that, in the light of the Emperor's proclamation that the Word Bearers moved too slowly in the Great Crusade, the world was to made compliant quickly, Lorgar unleashed the full combat potential of the 47th Expedition upon the waiting world.

47-16的人类居民可以追溯到他们与任何其他人类文明分离的4000多年前，并将泰拉视为一个神话。因此，当由第一连长科尔·法伦率领的怀言者使者到达时，他们欣喜若狂。然而，第一连长最初的印象并不乐观。他报告说，整个人口都是异教徒的偶像崇拜者，认为他们无可救药。虽然简报会上的一些高级指挥官（如索尔·塔格隆）认为民众可以重新接受教育，信仰帝皇，但科尔·法伦认为他们应该被消灭。第一连长和艾瑞巴斯将这一消息传达给了他们的原体，后者终于从隐居中走了出来。珞珈宣布，鉴于帝皇的宣告，即怀言者在大远征中行动过于缓慢，世界应迅速平定，他向等待的世界释放了第47远征队的全部战斗潜力。

In a 24 hour bombardment, every city was destroyed save the capital which was protected by shielding. The Word Bearers launched a ground assault on the city in cooperation with the Legio Cybernetica and a small contingent of Custodes led by Aquillon. Despite fierce resistance from its crystal soldiers which vomited lightning, the Imperial forces made rapid advances and soon the citizens of the city themselves began a desperate defense with crude small arms that could not harm Power Armour. The last gasp of the planet's old civilization came crashing down when the Word Bearers, on orders from Lorgar himself, massacred the confused planetary leaders and priests who had insisted they worshiped the Emperor and welcomed entry into the Imperium. Lorgar maintained that ignorance of the Imperial Truth was no excuse for heresy.

在24小时的轰炸中，除了被护盾保护的首都外，每一座城市都被摧毁了。怀言者与智控军团和阿奎隆领导的一小分队禁军合作，对这座城市发动了地面进攻。尽管水晶士兵射出闪电进行了激烈的抵抗，帝国部队还是迅速前进，很快，这座城市的居民自己开始用无法伤害动力盔甲的简陋小型武器进行绝望的防御。这个行星上古老文明的最后一口气崩溃了，当时怀言者根据珞珈本人的命令，屠杀了困惑的行星领导人和牧师，他们坚持崇拜帝皇，欢迎进入帝国。珞珈坚持认为，对帝国真理的无知不能成为异端的借口。
Shortly after news reached the Imperium of 47-16's Compliance, several settler fleets were sent to repopulate the world.
47-16平定的消息传到帝国后不久，几支殖民者舰队被派往世界各地重新定居。

title: 乔拉纳 Jollana
parts: Jollana is a world of the Imperium known for its Great Librarium, which is said to hold a collection of lost knowledge rivaled only by the worlds of the Sol System itself.
乔拉纳是一个以其大图书馆而闻名的帝国世界，据说那里收藏了只有太阳系的世界才能与之匹敌的失落知识。
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Jollana
名称：乔拉纳
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Civilised World
类别：文明世界
History 历史

In 913.M41, the planet would be devastated by an attack by the Chaos Sorcerer Ahriman and hordes of Daemons he would summon to the planet in an effort to steal the Librarium's lost knowledge. With the combined efforts of the Grey Knights and Invaders Space Marine Chapter, Jollana would be saved and allowed to rebuild.
913.M41，这颗行星被混沌巫师阿里曼和他召集到这颗行星上的成群的恶魔的攻击摧毁，他们试图窃取图书馆失落的知识。在灰骑士和入侵者星际战士战团的共同努力下，乔拉纳得以获救并得以重建。

title: 63/19 Sixty-Three Nineteen
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Sixty-Three Nineteen
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Sixty-Three Nineteen was the nineteenth world to be brought back under Imperial rule by the 63rd Expeditionary Fleet under the command of Warmaster Horus during the Great Crusade.
63/19是大远征间由战帅荷鲁斯指挥的第63远征舰队带回帝国统治下的第19个世界。
Background 背景

Third planet of nine that orbited a yellow sun, Sixty-Three Nineteen was ruled by a self-appointed "Emperor", who claimed it to be Terra itself. He therefore reasoned that he was the rightful ruler of mankind, and as such he demanded that Horus' forces bow to him instead. After the initial embassies sent from the 63rd Fleet were met with violence, Horus had no choice but to conquer the world by force. With the removal of the false Emperor, the human population of the planet bitterly accepted their new role as citizens of the Imperium. After the main battle General Rakris was assigned as a Lord Governor Elect of Sixty-Three-Nineteen. Some small resistance did continue however, with several cities on the western continent holding out for brief periods and scattered pacification actions required on three other planets in the system. The most serious incident of non-compliance occurred in the Whisperhead Mountains range and lasted for around three months, but this last pocket of resistance was eventually excised by the Luna Wolves' 10th Company.

九颗围绕黄色太阳运行的行星的第三颗，63/19，由一位自封的“皇帝”统治，他声称自己就是泰拉本身。因此，他认为自己是人类的合法统治者，因此他要求荷鲁斯的军队向他鞠躬。在第63舰队派出的最初使者遭到暴力袭击后，荷鲁斯别无选择，只能用武力征服世界。随着假皇帝的下台，行星上的人们痛苦地接受了他们作为帝国公民的新角色。主要战斗结束后，拉克里斯将军被任命为63/19的当选领主总督。然而，一些小规模的抵抗确实在继续，西部大陆的几个城市在短时间内坚持了下来，并在星系中的其他三个行星上采取了分散的平定行动。最严重的不服从事件发生在低语之首山脉，持续了大约三个月，但最后的抵抗最终被影月苍狼的第十连队消灭了。
Sixty-Three Nineteen had a high-tech martial element and at least 3 new STC patterns were recovered from it.
63/19具有高科技军事基础，至少从中恢复了3种新的STC型号。

The capital appeared to be called simply the High City, and large parts of it were given over to the Emperor's palace. It also contained a residential sector lower down the ediface upon which it was constructed, and an area to the west known as the Regency that was notable for its ornamental lakes and gardens. There was also a necropolis present in the city, where Horus had the deceased Emperor interred.
首都似乎被简单地称为高城，其中大部分被给予了皇帝的宫殿。从建造它的底面往下走还包含一个住宅区，以及一个以观赏湖泊和花园而闻名的西部地区，称为摄政。这座城市还有一个墓地，荷鲁斯将死去的皇帝安葬在那里。

The palace was extremely large and constructed of ouslite, stone and plaster. It featured several tall towers known as phototropic towers due to the way their tops were designed to swivel so that their crystal-glass windows always faced the light. This proved slightly disconcerting during the military campaign, as the towers swivelled this way and that due to intense weapons fire and explosions. The Emperor's golden throne was located at the top of one of these towers, protected by his Invisibles bodyguard and powerful force-field-derived weaponry.
这座宫殿非常大，由欧石、石头和灰泥建造而成。它有几个被称为向光塔的高塔，因为它们的顶部设计成可以旋转的，所以它们的水晶玻璃窗总是面向光线。在军事战役中，这被证明有点令人不安，因为由于激烈的武器射击和爆炸，塔楼来回旋转。皇帝的黄金御座位于其中一座塔楼的顶部，由他的隐形护卫和强大的力场衍生武器保护。
The residential areas of the city featured basalt buildings and large, often enclosed squares.
该城的住宅区以玄武岩建筑和大型封闭广场为特色。

The Regency area was carefully landscaped and attractive to the eye. Large formal lawns were bounded by rows of pollarded trees, and there were sizable amounts of ornamental lakes and ponds enclosed by tall hedgerows and heavy with water-flowers and ferns. It was in one of these gardens that Captain Garviel Loken was inducted into the elite Mournival council.
摄政区精心设计了景观，令人赏心悦目。大型的整齐草坪以一排排未修剪的树木为界，还有大量的观赏湖泊和池塘，周围是高大的树篱，开满了水生花和蕨类植物。正是在其中一个花园里，加维尔·洛肯连长被引入了精英四王议会。

The High City in general design was described as 'heliotropic' in nature, in that it was designed to take advantage of as much of the sun's light as possible. This principle was to be continued into the Imperial redesign of the city, to be planned by architect Peeter Egon Momus.
高城在总体设计上被描述为“向光的”，因为它的设计是为了尽可能多地利用太阳光。这一原则将延续到帝国对城市的重新设计中，由建筑师彼得·埃贡·莫穆斯进行规划。
There was also a city to the east of the capital called Kaentz.
首都以东还有一座城市叫坎茨。
The Whisperhead Mountains 低语之首山脉

The Whisperhead Mountain range was located in the southern hemisphere and became the last bolt-hole of the forces combating Imperial rule. The general area featured a population more superstitious than that of the northern regions, and organized religion fell away to something different there. The main population centre was called Katheri, composed mainly of longhouse-style dwellings, but the hold-out forces made their stand in a fortress carved out of the rock of a particularly high-peak that was connected to a plateau by natural rock bridges. Inside the mountain-fortress were what appeared to be several fanes of a primitive religion, perhaps connected to a local superstition about a being called Samus. All of these were destroyed by the Luna Wolves.
低语之首山脉位于南半球，成为对抗帝国统治的最后一个据点。普遍地区的人口比北方地区的人口更迷信，那里的有组织宗教走向了不同的方向。主要的人口中心被称为卡瑟里，主要由长屋式住宅组成，但抵抗军在一座由一座特别高山峰的巨石雕刻而成的堡垒中站稳了脚跟，这座堡垒通过天然石桥与高原相连。在这座山上的堡垒里，似乎有几个原始宗教的信徒，他们可能与当地人对一个叫萨姆斯的人的迷信有关。所有这些都被影月苍狼摧毁了。

title: 卡尔德拉 Caldera
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Caldera
名称：火山口星
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Hive World, Death World
类别：巢都世界，死亡世界
Caldera, originally known to the Great Crusade as One-Five-Four Four, is a Hive World and Death World of the Imperium.
火山口星，最初在大远征中被称为“154-4”，是帝国的巢都世界和死亡世界。
History 历史

Known to the Eldar as Caldera, it was a rare example of Eldar-Human coexistence; the Human population of the world were descendants of Nocturne who had been liberated from Dark Eldar captivity by their Craftworld kin.
灵族称之为卡尔德拉，这是灵族-人类共存的罕见例子；世界上的人类是夜曲星的后代，他们被黑暗灵族的方舟世界亲裔从囚禁中解放出来。

The world subsequently brought into compliance by Vulkan, Ferrus Manus, and Mortarion during the Great Crusade. During the campaign on the planet, the Imperials battled the Eldar who had psychically enslaved a race of chitlin-armored insect warriors. The entire campaign was in truth an Eldar trap to lure Ferrus Manus into a psychic labyrinth, where he could learn of the eventual Horus Heresy. When the attempt failed, the Eldar fled the world and it fell to the Imperials. After fighting against the Eldar and their Human cohabitants, the Vulkan unleashed a great purging flame across the world. Disgusted by his own actions against the population, Vulkan pledged that never again would Caldera face such destruction. He briefly returned to the world in search of a passage to Terra during the Horus Heresy.

在大远征期间，世界随后接受了沃坎、费鲁斯·马努斯和莫塔里安的平定。在行星上的战役中，帝国与灵族作战，灵族在精神上奴役了一个奇特林装甲昆虫战士种族。事实上，整个战役都是一个灵族陷阱，目的是引诱费鲁斯·马努斯进入一个灵能迷宫，在那里他可以了解最终的荷鲁斯叛乱。当尝试失败时，灵族逃离了世界，世界落入了帝国之手。在与灵族及其人类同居者作战后，沃坎在世界各地释放了巨大的净化火焰。沃坎对自己对平民的行为感到厌恶，他承诺火山口星再也不会面临这样的破坏。在荷鲁斯叛乱期间，他短暂地回到了这个世界，寻找通往泰拉的道路。

Vulkan reappeared from his self-imposed exile 1,500 years later to uphold his vow during the War of the Beast, fighting on his own against a massive Ork invasion. Thanks to the efforts of Imperial forces led by Koorland, Caldera was saved from being converted into an Attack Moon.
1500年后，沃坎从自我流放中重新出现，在野兽战争中坚持自己的誓言，独自对抗大规模的欧克入侵。由于库兰德领导的帝国部队的努力，火山口星得以避免被改造成攻击月亮。
Trivia 琐事
A caldera is a large cauldron-like hollow that forms shortly after the emptying of a magma chamber in the eruption of a volcano, creating a linguistic link between the planet name and Vulkan.
火山口星是一个巨大的大锅状空洞，在火山爆发时岩浆室排空后不久形成，在行星名称和沃坎之间建立了语言上的联系。

title: 谋杀星 Murder
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:One-Forty-Twenty (Murder)
Class:Death World
类别：死亡世界
Murder was a Death World inhabited by an arachnid race dubbed the "Megarachnids" by the Emperor's Children and Blood Angels Space Marines that encountered them.
谋杀星是一个死亡世界，居住着一个被遇到它们的帝皇之子和的圣血天使星际战士称为“巨蛛怪”的蜘蛛种族。
Background 背景

The planet was originally designated One-Forty-Twenty, signifying that it was the twentieth world to be encountered by the 140th Expeditionary Fleet. It was renamed after the last received transmission of Captain Khitas Frome, leader of the Blood Angels company that was the first Imperial force to land on the planet, and was soon wiped out: "This. World. Is. Murder."
这颗行星最初被命名为“140-20”，这意味着它是第140远征舰队遇到的第二十个世界。它在最后一次收到圣血天使连队领导人基塔斯·弗罗姆连长的信息后被重新命名，该连队是第一支登陆行星的帝国部队，很快就被消灭了：“这个世界就是谋杀。”

Due to atmospheric turbulence, all landings on the planet became disorganized and individual shuttles easily became separated from one another, forcing the Space Marines to fight in relatively small groups while searching for each other. One such group, lead by Emperor's Children Captain Saul Tarvitz, discovered large rock-like structures that resembled dead trees. These "trees" had the bodies of several Blood Angels Space Marines impaled on many of the branches with a flying variant of the Megarachnids feasting upon the bodies.
由于大气湍流，行星上的所有着陆都变得混乱，单个穿梭机很容易相互分离，迫使星际战士在相互搜寻的同时，以相对较小的小队进行战斗。其中一个由帝皇之子连长索尔·塔维兹领导的小队发现了类似于枯树的大型岩石结构。这些“树”上有几具圣血天使星际战士的尸体，他们的尸体被刺穿在许多树枝上，一种会飞的巨蛛怪变体正在享用尸体。

Upon destroying a few of the structures, Captain Tarvitz discovered that they were what was causing the massive atmospheric turbulence and managed to destroy a number of the "trees", thus allowing a relief force of the Emperor's Children, and newly-arrived-Luna Wolves and the Blood Angels (including their Primarchs - Horus and Sanguinius, Imperial Army regiments and Titans of Legio Mortis) to land and begin a full scale assault on the hostile natives.
在摧毁了一些建筑后，塔维兹连长发现它们是造成大规模大气湍流的原因，并设法摧毁了一些“树”，从而使帝皇之子的救援部队、新抵达的影月苍狼和圣血天使（包括他们的原体 - 荷鲁斯和圣吉列斯、帝国军队兵团和死亡军团的泰坦）登陆并开始对敌对的当地生物进行全面攻击。

After a short, yet violent, campaign against the Megarachnids the forces of the Crusade were approached by vessels belonging to an advanced human society called the Interex. The Interex informed Warmaster Horus, that the Megarachnids and the Interex had once met in a massive war. Upon the defeat of the Megarachnids the Interex removed all of their interstellar travel capabilities and transplanted them to the world, which they called Urisarach. Their intention was for the world to act as a reservation for the violent and only semi-sentient species, one where they could live unmolested by outsiders, and vice-versa. So the Imperial campaign of Murder was officially stopped, provoking the anger and disagreement of some Luna Wolves (including First Captain Abaddon), but not changing the firm decision of that by Horus himself.

在一场针对巨蛛怪的短暂而暴力的战役之后，远征队被一个名为英特雷斯的先进人类社会的战舰接近。英特雷斯告诉战帅荷鲁斯，巨蛛怪和英特雷斯曾经在一场大规模战争中相遇。在巨蛛怪战败后，英特雷斯移除了他们所有的星际航行能力，并将其转移到他们称之为乌里萨拉的世界。他们的意图是让世界成为暴力和只有半意识的物种的保留地，在那里他们可以不受外界干扰地生活，反之亦然。因此，帝国的谋杀星战役正式停止，激起了一些影月苍狼（包括第一连长阿巴顿）的愤怒和分歧，但并没有改变荷鲁斯本人的坚定决定。

title: 布雷贡迪亚 Bregundia
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Bregundia
名称：布雷贡迪亚
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Feudal World, Adeptus Astartes Recruiting World

类别：恶魔世界，堕落骑士世界

Korvosi, formerly known as Kolossi, was a former Knight World of the Imperium. It is now a daemon world and current seat of power of the Daemon Prince Be'lakor, along with being the homeworld of the Chaos Knights of House Korvax.
科尔沃西，原名科洛西，曾是帝国骑士世界。它现在是一个恶魔世界，是恶魔王子比'拉克的当前力量所在地，也是混沌骑士科瓦克斯家族的家园世界。
Overview 概述

Kolossi was home to the Knights of House Raven, amongst the most powerful, famed and numerous of the Questor Mechanicus Knight Houses. While it is not known with any certainty why House Raven was in possession of so many Knight suits, ancient records dating back to the settlement of the world refer to a STC archeotech long since lost. It is perhaps this miraculous technology and Kolossi's abundant natural resources that allowed House Raven to build its vast army of Knight suits. Others put forth the theory that the early settlers merely focused their output on the creation of Knight suits.
科洛西是骑士渡鸦家族的所在地，是最强大、最著名、数量最多的机械教探索者骑士家族之一。虽然目前尚不清楚渡鸦家族为什么拥有如此多的骑士机甲，但可以追溯到世界殖民的古代记录中提到了早已丢失的STC考古科技。也许正是这种神奇的技术和科洛西丰富的自然资源，让渡鸦家族制造了庞大的骑士机甲大军。其他人提出的理论是，早期定居者只是将他们的产出集中在骑士机甲的制造上。

The surface of Kolossi is wracked by environmental degradation from the constant strip mining of the planet's resources and endless manufacturing. The few cities that exist on Kolossi can be found in fissures that run for hundreds of miles across the surface. These cities are powered by geothermal generatora and the population toils away in deep-core mines, forge-shrines and nutrient-gruel vats. They are ruled over by Nobles from House Raven, but they are often away on campaign and the responsibility for the administration of these cities falls upon lesser officials.
科洛西的地表因行星资源的持续露天开采和无休止的制造业而受到环境退化的破坏。科洛西上存在的少数城市可以在地表数百英里的裂缝中找到。这些城市由地热发电机供电，人们在深核矿井、铸造圣地和营养粥桶中辛勤劳作。他们由渡鸦家族的贵族统治，但他们经常外出参加战役，这些城市的管理责任落在了下级官员身上。

The greatest of these cities was the fortress-city of the Keep Inviolate. Only the Fang on Fenris and the Emperor's Palace on Terra stand as mightier examples of such fortresses in the Imperium. Its upper heights reached past Kolossi's polluted atmosphere and out into the void of space. Likewise, its roots dug deep into Kolossi's crust and here amongst its foundation lay the Vault Transcendent, containing House Raven's massive number of Knight suits and relics.
这些城市中最伟大的是严守不渝的堡垒城市。只有芬里斯上的长牙堡和泰拉上的帝皇宫殿是帝国中此类堡垒的更强大的例子。它的上部高度超过了科洛西被污染的大气层，进入了太空的虚空。同样，它的根深深地扎进了科洛西的地壳，在它的基础上奠定了超验穹顶，里面有渡鸦家族的大量骑士机甲和遗物。
Fall 堕落

During the Charadon Campaign Kolossi met its end at the hands of the Daemon Prince Be'lakor, who unleashed a wave of darkness upon the planet. Assailed by dreams of madness, doubt, and hordes of Daemons the situation collapsed when corrupted Knights turned upon their lords. The planet fell, and the surviving elements of House Raven have now become a crusading force.
在查拉顿战役中，科洛西在恶魔王子比'拉克手中终结，他在行星上释放了一股黑暗浪潮。被疯狂、怀疑和成群的恶魔部落所攻击，当腐化的骑士们转向他们的领主时，情况崩溃了。行星沦陷了，渡鸦家族幸存的成员现在已经成为一支运动部队。
Former galactic position of Kolossi 科洛西的前银河位置
Trivia 琐事
The name "Korvosi" is likely a reference to Corvus, a genus of birds which includes ravens (referencing that the planet was once home to House Raven, now corrupted into House Korvax).
“科尔沃西”这个名字可能是指乌鸦属，这是一种包括乌鸦的鸟类（指这颗行星曾经是渡鸦家族的家园，现在被腐化成科瓦克斯家族）。
Notes 注释

Note 1: At one point in the 7th Edition Knights codex, during the description for Baron Daklorn, the planet's name is given as Kollossi. This is presumably a spelling error, as the planet's name is written as Kolossi both elsewhere in the book and when Daklorn's description was reprinted in the next edition's Knights codex.
注释1：在第7版骑士圣典中，在描述达克洛恩男爵时，这颗行星的名字被称为科罗西。这可能是一个拼写错误，因为这颗行星的名字在书中的其他地方都写为科洛西，当达克洛恩的描述在下一版的骑士圣典中重印时也是如此。

The battle's end saw the Blood Angels victorious and, centuries later, Terion has been rebuilt into a paradise. All that remains of that battle's legacy is a monument to Dante, sculpted in marble and standing as a colossus in the capital city, with the statue's outstretched hand reaching to the horizon, offering mercy to forefathers of Terion's citizens.

在第41个千年，阿刻戎被战争包围，在发现它拥有一种被称为凯恩之矛的灾难性武器。现在，血鸦战团长加百列·安杰罗斯、灵族比耶-坦先知玛查和欧克军阀猎头者戈古兹的部队正在为拥有武器而相互作战。

When the spear was finally discovered, it revealed to have been a ruse by Chaos forces to unleash a Daemonic horde. Desperate, Gabriel Angelos deliberately crashed a Battle Barge into one of Acheron's fissures, causing the planet to disintegrate.
当长矛最终被发现时，它被揭露为混沌部队释放恶魔部落的诡计。绝望之下，加百列·安杰罗斯故意将一艘战斗驳船撞向黄泉星的一条裂缝，导致行星解体。

Tarnis was once the home world of the Imperial Knights of House Drakkus, before they were destroyed in an attack by an invading Khorne Warband, lead by the Fallen Zufiel. The Warband was just the first of the forces to invade Tarnis, as the Waaagh! of Warboss Nekkruncha made planetfall as well. With two invading forces, all hope looked lost for Tarnis, until a Dark Angels strike force led by Master Tigraine soon arrived to save it. However, the Dark Angels did not realize that the Khorne Warband, had a dark purpose invading Tarnis, as it is the location where they planned to complete a Chaos ritual; that allowing them to free the mighty Bloodthirster Felfurion from the Warp. The last surviving Knight of House Drakkus, Vortigan, had managed to survive the attack on Fort Drakkus and assisted the Dark Angels with repelling the Ork and Chaos forces. They were further aided by the Iron Warden of Tarnis: Altorus. The combined forces successfully repelled the Waaagh by killing Nekkruncha, and defeating the Warband even after they had managed to summon Felfurion. While Altorus fell during the battle to retake Fort Drakkus, Vortigan took up his mantle as the new Iron Warden of Tarnis.

塔尔尼斯曾经是帝国骑士德拉库斯家族的家园世界，在他们被堕天使祖菲尔领导的入侵的恐虐战帮摧毁之前。战帮只是第一个入侵塔尔尼斯的部队，就像战争头目奈克努恰的Waaagh！一样也导致了行星陷落。随着两支入侵部队的出现，塔尔尼斯似乎失去了所有的希望，直到提格兰大师率领的黑暗天使打击部队很快赶来拯救它。然而，黑暗天使并没有意识到恐虐战帮入侵塔尔尼斯的目的是黑暗的，因为这是他们计划完成混沌仪式的地方；这使他们能够将强大的嗜血狂魔法里奥恩从亚空间中解放出来。德拉库斯家族最后一位幸存的骑士沃蒂根在对德拉库斯堡垒的袭击中幸存下来，并协助黑暗天使击退了欧克和混沌部队。他们得到了塔尔尼斯的钢铁守望：阿尔托鲁斯的进一步帮助。联合部队通过杀死奈克努恰成功击退了Waaagh！并在成功召唤法里奥恩后还是击败了战帮。当阿尔托鲁斯在夺回德拉库斯堡垒的战斗中倒下时，沃蒂根接过了他的衣钵，成为了塔尔尼斯的新钢铁守望。

History 历史

The Vindicator was developed in 356-372.M31 on Rothern I for heavy siege weaponry in the twisting streets of Stahlenberg, Techmarines of the Ultramarines Legion mounted modified macro-cannon breech and barrel assemblies inside structurally reinforced Rhino APCs. These early Vindicators proved highly effective in the dense fighting conditions in which they were deployed, as they carried far greater firepower than could be mustered by Heretic forces within the confines of the city. The Vindicators were instrumental in the recapture of Stahlenberg and hence ultimate victory in the pacification of Rothern I as a whole.
维护者于356-372.M31年在罗瑟恩一号上开发，用于斯塔伦伯格扭曲街道上的重型攻城武器，极限战士军团的技术军士在结构加固的犀牛装甲运兵车内安装了改进的大口径火炮后膛和炮管组件。这些早期的维护者在密集的战斗条件下被证明是非常有效的，因为他们携带的火力远远超过了异端部队在城市范围内所能调动的火力。维护者在夺回斯塔伦伯格的过程中发挥了重要作用，从而在整个罗瑟恩一号的平定中取得了最终胜利。

title: 庄严星 Solemnus
parts: Solemnus is a former Adeptus Astartes Homeworld of the Black Templars.
庄严星是黑色圣堂的前阿斯塔特修会家园世界。
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Solemnus

System:Solemnus System

Affiliation:Imperium

History 历史

Solemnus is believed to have been first settled by mankind during the millennia-distant Dark Age of Technology. A thousand years before the Black Templars, under Marshal Emrik, came to Solemnus to quash an insidious genestealer cult that had held almost the entire planet in its filthy talons. After cleansing the planet of the genestealer taint, the Black Templars claimed Solemnus and used it as a recruiting world. The chapter maintained a monastery-fortress on the planet, which they used to resupply and gather suitable recruits for their chapter between crusades; consisting of a permanent population of a hundred battle-brothers, as well as the neophytes, serfs, adepts and many other minions who saw to the needs of the Black Templars and the fortress itself.

人们认为，在千年前的黑暗技术时代，人类首次定居了庄严星。一千年前，在埃姆里克元帅的领导下，黑色圣堂来到庄严星，镇压了一个潜伏的基因窃取者教派，这个教派几乎把整个行星都控制在肮脏的爪子里。在清除了行星上的基因窃取者的污染后，黑色圣堂宣称拥有庄严星，并将其用作募兵世界。该战团在行星上维护着一座修道院堡垒，他们在远征之间用它来为战团补给和招募合适的新兵；由一百名战斗兄弟组成的常驻人口，以及满足黑色圣堂和堡垒本身需求的新进者、侍从、专家和许多其他下级官员。

A world troubled by storms, its populace sustained themselves by sheep-farming, forestry, the raising of livestock, basic mining and quarrying. Those same people maintained their own method of government via a system of petty kingdoms and vassal lords. But it was the castellan of the monastery-fortress who was the true overlord, and effectively governor, of the planet, who represented Solemnus to the greater Imperium.
一个饱受风暴困扰的世界，其民众依靠养羊、林业、畜牧业、基本采矿和采石来维持生计。这些人通过小王国和附庸领主制度维持着自己的政府方式。但只有修道院要塞的堡主才是这个行星真正的霸主，也是有效的统治者，他代表庄严星进入了更大的帝国。

Right before the Black Templars fleet, under Marshal Brant, were expected to return to the planet, from the Apollo Subsector, and the site of the Liberation of Lugnasad, Solemnus was attacked by an armada of the Blood Scar Ork tribe, under Warboss Morkrull Grimskar. The Ork armada targeted the monastery-fortress with an orbital bombardment, which the fortress' shield generators absorbed, before finally sending a Rok crashing down near the fortress. The rok fired its weapons at point blank range and the force of the impact caused the fortress' shields to overload and collapse. A section of its walls were destroyed during the attack, which allowed a large force of Orks to invade the fortress and massacre all inside.
就在布兰特元帅率领的黑色圣堂舰队预计将从阿波罗分区和卢格纳萨德解放的地点返回行星之前，庄严星遭到了战争头目莫尔克鲁尔·格里姆斯卡率领的血疤欧克部落舰队的袭击。欧克舰队对修道院堡垒进行了轨道轰炸，堡垒的护盾发生机吸收了轰炸，最终一个巨石被击落在堡垒附近。巨石在近距离发射了武器，冲击力导致堡垒的护盾过载并崩溃。它的一部分城墙在袭击中被摧毁，这使得一支庞大的欧克部队入侵了堡垒，并在里面进行了大屠杀。

When Marshal Brant's fleet, they found Solemnus under assault. The Black Templars fleet attacked the Ork armada, which began to retreat under fire, before sending drop pods to the planet. A fierce battle commenced, with the Black Templars fighting the Orks within the ruins of the fortress. Soon the battle was finished, with all the Orks on Solemnus killed. The Black Templars searched for any survivors amid the ruins, only finding Brother Jarold, nearly dead, atop a pile of Ork corpses. His wounds were so great that the only way to save him was to inter him within a Dreadnought.
当布兰特元帅的舰队发现庄严星遭到袭击时。黑色圣堂舰队袭击了欧克舰队，欧克舰队在炮火下开始撤退，然后向行星发射空投舱。一场激烈的战斗开始了，黑色圣堂在堡垒的废墟中与欧克作战。战斗很快就结束了，庄严星上的所有欧克都被杀死。黑色圣堂在废墟中寻找幸存者，只发现几乎死亡的贾罗德兄弟，躺在一堆欧克尸体上。他的伤口太严重了，唯一能救他的办法就是把他送入无畏里。

The Black Templars quit Solemnus, soon after the battle and destroyed the ruins of the fortress. It is no longer a recruiting world for the Black Templars. Or indeed any Chapter, thanks to the warning beacon left in orbit by the departing Space Marines. Now it was left as a memorial to those brethren who had lost their lives to the Blood Scar tribe's assault on the planet, making it no more, and no less, than another relic of the Black Templars Chapter.
战斗结束后不久，黑色圣堂离开了庄严星，摧毁了堡垒的废墟。这不再是一个黑色圣堂的招募世界。或者说，任何战团，都要归功于即将离开的星际战士在轨道上留下的警告信标。现在，它被留下来纪念那些在血痕部落对行星的袭击中丧生的兄弟们，使其不比黑色圣堂的另一个遗物多，也不少。

Marshal Brant's remaining forces departed in pursuit of the Orks. Renamed the Solemnus Crusade, they vowed to avenge their departed brethren against the hordes that followed Warboss Morkrull Grimskar.
布兰特元帅的剩余部队出发追击欧克。更名为庄严远征，他们发誓要为死去的兄弟们报仇，对抗跟随战争头目莫尔克鲁尔·格里姆斯卡的部落。

title: 皮希纳四号 Piscina IV
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Piscina IV
名称：皮希纳四号
System:Piscina System
星系：皮希纳星系
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Mining World
类别：矿业世界
Piscina IV is an Imperial mining planet that was the site of a Dark Angels stronghold.
皮希纳四号是一颗帝国矿业行星，是黑暗天使要塞的所在地。
Overview 概述

Though controlled by the Imperium, Piscina IV is in a state of constant battle with Orks. Each time the Orks seem to be defeated, the Imperial Guard Regiments stationed on the world come under fire at a different place. The Orks tend to shelter in abandoned mine heads and dig themselves in until they attain sufficient numbers to overwhelm the Guard troops sent to cleanse the area. In recent years, the Dark Angels' stronghold on Piscina IV has been visited more and more infrequently by the Tower of Angels, only coming once a generation or so to take aspirants gathered from the barbaric world of Piscina V for further testing and modification.
尽管受到帝国的控制，但皮希纳四号仍处于与欧克不断战斗的状态。每当欧克似乎被击败时，驻扎在世界各地的帝国卫队都会在不同的地方受到攻击。欧克倾向于在废弃的矿井头避难，并自掘，直到他们的人数足以压倒被派去清理该地区的卫队。近年来，天使之塔越来越不频繁地访问黑暗天使在皮希纳四号的堡垒，大约每一代人只来一次，将从野蛮的皮希纳五号世界聚集的有志者带到那里进行进一步的测试和改变。
Piscina IV was also the site of a great battle during the Third War for Armageddon.
皮希纳四号也是第三次阿玛吉多顿战争中一场大战的发生地。
Garrison 驻军
The Dark Angels squad stationed on the planet included:
驻扎在这个行星上的黑暗天使小队包括：
Interrogator-Chaplain Boreas, leader of the Dark Angels presence on the world;
审讯牧师玻瑞亚斯，黑暗天使存在世界上的领导者；
Techmarine Hephaestus, in charge of equipment repair and the annihilus virus weapon under the keep;
技术军士赫菲斯托斯，负责设备维修和湮灭病毒武器的保管；
Apothecary Nestor, keeper of the well-being of his squad and guardian of the gene-seed kept on the world;
药剂师内斯特，小队的健康守护者，世界基因种子的守护者；
Battle-brothers Thumiel and Zaul;
战斗兄弟图米尔和扎乌尔；
Veteran Sergeant Damas, who trained the aspirants gathered off-world until their departure on the Tower of Angels;
老兵军士达马斯，训练这些在世界各地聚集的有志者，直到他们在天使之塔离开；
All the members of this squad met their deaths inside their own keep due to an intricate plot by the Fallen Angels led by Cypher designed to steal the gene-seed kept in the Apothecarium vault.
由于塞弗领导的堕天使策划了一场复杂的阴谋，该小队的所有成员都在自己的堡垒主楼里丧生，他们的目的是窃取保存在药剂师密库中的基因种子。

The keep's virus weapon failsafe had been activated, and was going to destroy all life on the planet. Boreas realized that the only way that they could keep the planet's population safe was to not break the air-tight seals of the keep's doors, therefore containing the virus inside until its eventual end. Nestor, having been charged with keeping the gene-seed safe, sought to leave and was killed by Boreas, using Hephaestus' plasma pistol. The rest of the Space Marines decided that ending their lives before the hunger or thirst of waiting to die pushed them to leave was the better idea, and detonated meltabombs clasped against their chest as they prayed to their Primarch, Lion El'Jonson.
要塞的病毒武器故障保护已被激活，将摧毁行星上的所有生命。玻瑞亚斯意识到，他们保护行星人口安全的唯一方法是不要打破城堡门的气密密封，从而将病毒控制在里面，直到最终结束。内斯特被要求保护基因种子的安全，他试图离开，但被玻瑞亚斯用赫菲斯托斯的等离子手枪杀死。其余的星际战士决定，在等待饥饿或口渴的死亡迫使他们离开之前结束生命是更好的主意，并在向他们的原体莱昂·艾尔庄森祈祷时引爆了紧贴胸前的热熔炸弹。
In the aftermath, the Ravenwing, led by Grand Master Sammael, arrived at the stronghold to investigate the disappearance of the garrison.
随后，由萨麦尔大导师率领的鸦翼抵达要塞，调查驻军的失踪情况。
Piscina IV was later invaded by an Ork horde in M42 and the Dark Angels came to its defense once more.
皮希纳四号后来在M42中被一支欧克部落入侵，黑暗天使再次前来防御。

title: 艾米琳之希望 Emiline's Hope
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Emiline's Hope
名称：艾米琳之希望
System:Yerena System
星系：耶雷纳星系
Class:Shrine World
类别：圣地世界
Emiline's Hope is a Shrine World of the Adeptus Ministorum. It is famous for holding the bones of Saint Emiline.
艾米琳之希望是一个国教教会的圣地世界。它以保存圣艾米琳之骨而闻名。

In 452.M41, the world came under assault from an Ork Waaagh! under the Arch Maniac of Calvera, but was eventually defeated by the Order of the Bleeding Heart, the Adepta Sororitas Order that is charged with defending the planet.
452.M41，世界遭受了一场卡尔韦拉的大狂人的欧克Waaagh！的袭击，但最终被负责保卫行星的修女会修会 - 流血之心修会击败。
The primary spaceport of Emiline's Hope is Caprium.
艾米琳之希望的主要太空港是卡普里姆。

title: 摩洛三号 Moloch III
parts: Moloch III is a War World of the Imperium, currently fighting a Tyranid invasion.
摩洛三号是一个帝国战争世界，目前正在与泰伦入侵作战。
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Moloch III
名称：摩洛三号
System:Moloch System
星系：摩洛星系
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:War World, Mining World
类别：战争世界，矿业世界

Before the Tyranid invasion Moloch III, along with Moloch I and Moloch II, was a Mining World that held substantial mineral wealth and held several large colonies. That all changed when the Tyranids invaded the system and both Moloch I and Moloch II came under attack. Though the planets had orbital defenses, they both fell to the unrelenting swarm less than seventy two hours, from when the first Mycetic Spore landed on their surface. Moloch III soon found itself the only Imperium world left in the system and its Planetary Governor ordered feverish preparations to begin to resist the planet's imminent invasion. All of the planet's troops, civilians and equipment were evacuated to a series of giant fortresses, in the Thunderwall mountain range. By the time waves of Mycetic Spores filled the skies over Moloch III, an estimated 89% percent of its population had reached safety within the fortresses.

在泰伦入侵之前，摩洛三号与摩洛一号和摩洛二号是一个拥有大量矿产财富和几个大型殖民地的矿业世界。当泰伦入侵该星系，摩洛一号和摩洛二号都受到攻击时，一切都发生了变化。尽管这些行星有轨道防御，但它们都在不到七十二小时的时间里落入了无情的虫群，从第一个菌丝孢子降落在它们的地表开始。摩洛三号很快发现自己是星系中唯一剩下的帝国世界，其行星总督下令进行焦虑不安的准备，开始抵抗行星即将到来的入侵。行星上所有的军队、平民和装备都被疏散到雷霆之墙山脉的一系列巨型堡垒。当菌丝孢子的浪潮席卷摩洛三号上空时，估计89%的人口已经到达堡垒内的安全地带。

Despite their preparations, it took the Tyranids almost two days to find the first fortress and another three days to destroy it. The survivors fled to other fortresses and then fled again, as the Tyranids destroyed each fortress in turn. Soon only the fortress Zharr remained, located in the last and greatest hollowed mountain its population could defend. As thousands of the planet's remaining population fled to the safety of Zharr, a small but determined force of Imperial Guardsmen, composed of the remnants of several Regiments, fought as a rearguard around Refinery 13 on the southern slopes of the mountain. They managed to beat back one assault by the Tyranids, but they all knew they wold be swept aside as soon as the swarm massed for another attack. It was during this desperate time, that the Farseer Eldrad Ulthran arrived, with forces from his Craftworld Ulthwé offering their aid.

尽管他们做了准备，但泰伦花了将近两天的时间找到了第一座堡垒，又花了三天的时间摧毁了它。幸存者逃到了其他堡垒，然后又逃跑了，因为泰伦依次摧毁了每一座堡垒。很快，只剩下扎尔要塞了，它位于其人口能够防御的最后一座也是最大的空心山脉上。随着行星上数千名剩余人口逃往扎尔的安全地带，一支由几个兵团残余人员组成的规模虽小但意志坚定的帝国卫队在山脉南坡的13号精炼厂周围作为后卫作战。他们设法击退了泰伦的一次进攻，但他们都知道，一旦虫群集结起来再次进攻，他们就会被扫除。正是在这个绝望的时刻，先知埃尔德拉德·乌斯兰抵达，他的乌斯维方舟世界部队提供了援助。

Colonel Gurion, the ranking officer present, was apprehensive at first, as the Eldar had launched many raids on Moloch III in the past, but Eldrad assured him they were there to help. According to the Farseer, he had checked the lines of fate and learned that the fortress Zharr must not be allowed to fall to the Tyranids, but told Gurion his forces were too weak to survive another attack by the swarm. Knowing they would not be able to receive any reinforcements from Zharr, Gurion agreed to an alliance between the two forces. When the Tyranids attacked Refinary 13 the next morning, they faced the combined might of the Imperial Guard and Eldar - and it was not enough. Early in the battle Eldrad, was struck down by a Psychic attack from a Hive Tyrant and even more devastating, several Imperial Guardsmen had unknowingly been infected with Barbed Strangler seeds. Several times throughout the battle, the seeds would erupt killing their hosts and several Guardsmen nearby; sowing terror and confusion through the ranks of the remaining Guardsmen. With these major setbacks, the Tyranids were able to overwhelm and destroy the forces of the Guard and Eldar, despite taking severe losses while doing so. Eldrad survived the massacre, but the pathway to Zharr was left clear to the Tyranids; with the fortress' remaining defenders left alone to face the might of the swarm.

当时在场的高级军官古里安上校起初很担心，因为灵族过去曾对摩洛三号发动过多次袭击，但埃尔德拉德向他保证，他们会在那里提供帮助。据先知说，他已经检查了命运之线，并了解到绝不能让扎尔堡垒落入泰伦之手，但他告诉古里安，他的部队太弱了，无法在虫群的另一次攻击中幸存下来。古里安知道他们无法从扎尔那里得到任何增援，于是同意两军结盟。第二天早上，当泰伦袭击13号精炼厂时，他们面临着帝国卫队和灵族的联合力量 — 这还不够。在战斗的早期，埃尔德拉德被虫巢暴君的灵能攻击击倒，更具破坏性的是，几名帝国卫队卫兵在不知不觉中感染了荆茎绞藤的种子。在整个战斗中，种子多次爆发，杀死他们的宿主和附近的几名卫兵；在剩下的卫兵队伍中播下恐怖和混乱的种子。由于这些重大挫折，泰伦能够压倒并摧毁卫队和灵族的部队，尽管在这样做时遭受了严重损失。埃尔德拉德在大屠杀中幸存下来，但通往扎尔的道路对泰伦来说是畅通的；堡垒剩下的守军将独自面对虫群的力量。

title: 萨夫拉 Savlar
parts: Map 地图
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Savlar
名称：萨夫拉
System:Savlar System
星系：萨夫拉星系
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Penal World, Mining World
类别：刑罚世界，矿业世界
Planetary Image 行星图像
Savlar, also known as Savlar Penitens, is an Imperial Penal World. It is a toxic hellhole infamous for its Imperial Guard Regiments, known as the Savlar Chem Dogs.
萨夫拉，也被称为萨夫拉忏悔，是一个帝国刑罚世界。这是一个有毒的地狱，因其被称为萨夫拉化学狗的帝国卫队兵团而臭名昭著。
Overview 概述

Savlar is said to be a world of sinners, heretics, murderers, thieves and rapists; indeed, it is claimed that only one in four born on Savlar knows their father. The world is blighted by gang warfare and crime, only kept in control by the threat of violence from Imperial authorities.
据说萨夫拉是一个充满罪人、异端、杀人犯、小偷和强奸犯的世界；事实上，据说在萨夫拉出生的人中，只有四分之一的人认识他们的父亲。世界被帮派战争和犯罪所摧残，只有帝国当局的暴力威胁才能控制局面。
In addition to its societal maladies, Savlar is shrouded by a noxious and volatile atmosphere.
除了社会弊病，萨夫拉还笼罩着一种有害和不稳定的大气。
History 历史
Savlar was once a Mining World notable only for the rich chemical deposits found on its moons.
萨夫拉曾经是一个矿业世界，只因其卫星上发现的丰富化学沉积而闻名。

Unfortunately the planet failed in meeting its Imperial tithes, and so in M39 Savlar was converted into a penal colony populated by traitors, criminals and Adeptus Arbites troops guarding them. Since the mining workforce was bolstered by prisoners, the planet has come to supply raw material for three Civilised Worlds and two Forge Worlds in the nearby subsectors. The initial supply of prisoners consisted of those captured during the Bokur rebellion, but over the years regular shipments have come to Savlar from across the Armageddon Sector.
不幸的是，这个行星未能满足帝国的什一税，因此在M39，萨夫拉被改造成一个由叛徒、罪犯和守卫他们的法务部部队组成的流放地。由于采矿工人得到了囚犯的支援，行星已经为附近分区的三个文明世界和两个铸造世界提供了原材料。最初的囚犯供应包括博库尔叛乱期间被俘的囚犯，但多年来，定期从阿玛吉多顿星区运送到萨夫拉。

Some time later, an armed uprising took place. This would force Judge Callistar to form the Chem-Dogs as a response force to put the rebellion down. During the Third War for Armageddon, the Chem-Dogs would be deployed to Armageddon to meet the Imperium's desperate need for more troops.
一段时间后，发生了武装叛乱。这将迫使卡利斯塔法官组建化学犬部队，作为镇压叛乱的反应部队。在第三次阿玛吉多顿战争期间，化学犬被部署到阿玛吉多顿，以满足帝国对更多军队的迫切需求。
At some point, Savlar was raided by the Night Lords, who overran Hive Apraxis.
在某个时刻，萨夫拉遭到了午夜领主的突袭，他们占领了阿普拉克西斯巢都。
During the Arks of Omen Campaign, Savlar was attacked by a Chaos Balefleet. Despite the efforts of its defenders, the Balefleet wreaked havoc on the planet.
在噩兆方舟战役中，萨夫拉遭到混沌灾祸舰队的袭击。尽管守军付出了努力，灾祸舰队还是对行星造成了严重破坏。
Trivia 琐事
Conflicting sources 来源冲突

The Third War for Armageddon campaign website states that the Savlar system is located "just over a hundred light years from Armageddon". However, other sources place Savlar in the border regions between Segmentum Pacificus and Segmentum Solar, nowhere near Armageddon (which is located in the eastern part of Segmentum Solar).
第三次阿玛吉多顿战争战役网站称，萨夫拉星系位于“距离阿玛吉多顿仅一百多光年”的地方。然而，其他来源将萨夫拉定位在太平星域和太阳星域之间的边界地区，远离阿玛吉多顿（位于太阳星域的东部）。

title: 康达克斯星系 Chondax System
parts: The Chondax System is a large System of Imperial space.
康达克斯星系是一个庞大的帝国空域星系。
History 历史

During the Horus Heresy, the region was heavily infested by Orks and was chosen by the treacherous Warmaster Horus as the location to dispatch Jaghatai Khan and his White Scars. Due to its layout, it would take The Khan a lifetime of fighting to clear the System of Orks while he could meanwhile initiate his rebellion against the Emperor.
在荷鲁斯叛乱时期，该地区被欧克严重侵扰，并被背叛的战帅荷鲁斯选为派遣察合台可汗和他的白色伤疤的地点。由于其布局，可汗需要一生的战斗才能清除欧克星系，同时他可以发起对抗帝皇的叛乱。

After the lengthy Chondax Campaign, the White Scars were largely successful in defeating most of the Greenskins but escaped the System after receiving word of the Burning of Prospero. To escape, the White Scars had to break through a Alpha Legion blockade.
在漫长的康达克斯战役之后，白色伤疤在很大程度上成功击败了绿皮的大部分，但在收到普罗斯佩罗之焚的消息后逃离了星系。为了逃跑，白色伤疤不得不突破阿尔法军团的封锁。
Known Worlds 已知世界
Chondax Prime 康达克斯一号
Chondax Alpha Prime — Sun
康达克斯阿尔法一号 — 太阳
Irra Major 伊拉主星
Irra Minor 伊拉次星
Chondax Beta — Sun

title: 康达克斯 Chondax
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Chondax

System:Chondax System
星系：康达克斯星系
Class:Dead World
类别：死亡世界

Chondax is a barren but open world where nothing grows; it bears many similarities to Chogoris. Chondax is mostly covered in white glistering sands which slowly absorb everything that remains on their surface, leaving nothing behind. The planet is known to have three suns.
康达克斯是一个贫瘠但开阔的世界，没有任何东西生长；它与巧高里斯有很多相似之处。康达克斯大部分被白色光滑的沙子覆盖着，沙子会慢慢吸收表面上剩下的一切，什么也不留下。众所周知，这颗行星有三个太阳。
Chondax has several names, the official being Chondax Primus by Imperial cartographers, it also called Chondax Prime or just Chondax. The White Scars called it The White World.
康达克斯有几个名字，官方名称是帝国制图师的康达克斯一号，它也被称为康达克斯主星或简称康达克斯。白色疤痕称之为白色世界。
During the Great Crusade, the White Scars, along with the 915th Expedition Fleet, landed on Chondax to battle a significant Ork presence.
在大远征期间，白色疤痕与第915远征舰队一起登陆了康达克斯，与一支相当数量的欧克作战。

In what became known as the Chondax Campaign, Jaghatai Khan emerged victorious but soon found himself confronted by the Alpha Legion as the Horus Heresy broke out. The White Scars eventually left Chondax, running the Alpha Legion blockade for Prospero.
在后来被称为康达克斯战役中，察合台可汗取得了胜利，但很快发现自己在荷鲁斯叛乱爆发时遇到了阿尔法军团。白色疤痕最终离开了康达克斯，脱离阿尔法军团的封锁前往普罗斯佩罗。

title: 加拉斯帕星群 Galaspar Cluster
parts: The Galaspar Cluster is a region of space made up of eleven primary star systems. The main system of the cluster is the Galaspar System.
加拉斯帕星群是由11个主恒星系组成的太空区域。该星群的主要星系是加拉斯帕星系。
It was brought into compliance during the Great Crusade by the Death Guard when they crushed The Order, the former rulers of the region.
在大远征期间，死亡守卫镇压了该地区的前统治者秩序，使其平定。

Galaspar is a Hive World of the Imperium.
加拉斯帕是帝国的巢都世界。
History 历史

Settled during the Dark Age of Technology, the ancient civilization of Galaspar grew distinct and separate from the emerging Imperium of Man. Its surface was covered with massive Hives that rival those found within Segmentum Solar. Outside of the fortified hives, millennia of unbound human population expansion and industrial spoil had obliterated the planet's environment and rendered Galaspar an arid, irradiated wasteland.
在黑暗技术时代定居下来，加拉斯帕的古老文明与新兴的人类帝国截然不同。它的表面覆盖着巨大的巢都，与太阳星域内发现的相媲美。在加强巢都之外，数千年的无约束人口扩张和工业破坏摧毁了行星的环境，使加拉斯帕成为一片干旱、受辐射的荒地。

During the Age of Strife, Galaspar fell under the control of a tyrannical junta simply known as "The Order", which reduced its population to nameless labour units that were immediately euthanized when they were no longer able to work. The Order maintained its rule through mass terror and spreading addictive substances throughout the population. Thus it was that the people of Galaspar were rendered into humble and meek masses who would quietly obey authority. Soon Galaspar expanded its power, taking control of the surrounding worlds of its system in a pocket empire.
在纷争时代，加拉斯帕落入了一个被称为“秩序”的残暴军政府的控制之下，该军政府将其人口减少到无名的劳工单位，当他们不再能够工作时，这些劳工单位会立即被安乐死。秩序通过大规模恐怖活动和在整个人口中分发成瘾物质来维持其统治。因此，加拉斯帕的人民变成了谦卑和温顺的群众，他们会默默地服从权威。不久，加拉斯帕扩大了其力量，在一个袖珍帝国中控制了其星系的周围世界。

However The Order's rule of Galaspar ended when they refused assimilation into the Imperium during the Great Crusade and fired on Imperial Explorator vessels that attempted to make contact. In the ensuing Conquest of Galaspar, the Death Guard, led personally by Mortarion, obliterated The Order and killed every last one of its defenders, wreaking mass destruction and terror. Since then, the devastated world's population has obeyed the Adeptus Terra, replacing one tyrannical government with another.
然而，当秩序在大远征期间拒绝融入帝国，并向试图接触的帝国探索者战舰开火时，该组织对加拉斯帕的统治结束了。在随后对加拉斯帕的征服中，由莫塔里安亲自领导的死亡守卫消灭了秩序，杀死了每一个守军，造成了大规模的破坏和恐怖。从那时起，被摧毁的世界的人口就服从了中央政务部，用另一个暴政政府取代了。

During the Horus Heresy, though, Galaspar was seized by the forces of Warmaster Horus. The Raven Guard's Primarch, Corax, later sent a battlegroup of his Legion's Deliverers and their Therion Cohort Imperial Army allies to seize the world from the Traitors. This group was composed of forces led by the Centurion Beyar Kedron and the Cohort commanders who had criticized Corax, for the losses they suffered during the Breaking of the Perfect Fortress.
然而，在荷鲁斯叛乱期间，加拉斯帕被战帅荷鲁斯的部队占领。暗鸦守卫的原体科拉克斯后来派遣了一支由他的军团的拯救者和他们的圣兽大队帝国军队盟友组成的战斗群，从叛徒手中夺取世界。这个小队由百夫长贝亚尔·凯德隆领导的部队和批评科拉克斯在完美堡垒破裂期间遭受的损失的大队指挥官组成。

title: 黑暗9-50 Tenebrae 9-50
parts: Tenebrae 9-50 was the designation given to a Class-C planetesimal located in the Octiss System. It housed the Tenebrae Installation, an asteroid facility used as an Alpha Legion base during the Horus Heresy.
黑暗9-50是位于奥克提斯星系中的C类微行星的名称。它容纳了黑暗装置，这是一个在荷鲁斯叛乱期间用作阿尔法军团基地的小行星设施。

Used by the Demiurg for mining operations, it also housed an Alpha Legion garrison that utilized a Pylon to manipulate the Warp in surrounding Systems in order to jam communications for the White Scars, keeping them ignorant of Horus' rebellion, and strand loyalist troops. The garrison on the Tenebrae installation included 50 legionaries as well as Geno Seven-Sixty Spartocid Imperial Army troops loyal to the Legion. During the Heresy, Omegon dispatched a team led by Sheed Ranko on a suicide mission to destroy the facility, possibly fabricating a claim that it was leaking information to the Legion's enemies. After the destruction of the facility, the Warp calmed and the White Scars received word of Horus' rebellion.

被德穆革用于采矿作业，它还容纳了一个阿尔法军团驻军，该驻军利用一个方尖碑操纵周围星系中的亚空间，以干扰白色伤疤的通信，使他们不知道荷鲁斯的叛乱，并牵制忠诚派部队。黑暗设施上的驻军包括50名军团士兵以及忠于军团的基诺7-60斯巴托西德帝国军队部队。在叛乱期间，欧米伽派遣了一支由希德·兰科领导的小队执行自杀性任务，摧毁了该设施，可能是捏造了一个说法，称其正在向军团的敌人泄露信息。在设施被摧毁后，亚空间平静下来，白色疤痕部队收到了荷鲁斯叛乱的消息。

title: 乌兰诺一号 Ullanor Prime
parts: Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Ullanor Prime
名称：乌兰诺一号

星系：乌兰诺星系

Class:Ork World, later heavily modified planetoid battlestation.
类别：欧克世界，后来经过大规模改装的小行星战斗站。
Ullanor Prime was the central world of the Ullanor System that has played a key part in the history of the Galaxy. It has since become known as the world of Armageddon.
乌兰诺一号是乌兰诺星系的中心世界，在银河系的历史上发挥了关键作用。此后，它被称为阿玛吉多顿。
History 历史
Pre-History 前历史
By at least 560'000 BC Artifact XE3-36, a Necron construct, was entombed on the world near the equator.
至少在公元前560000年，死灵建造的造物XE3-36被埋在世界上的赤道附近。
Great Crusade 大远征

By M31, Ullanor Prime was the center of a vast Ork empire under the Warboss Urlakk Urg. During the famous Ullanor Crusade, Imperial forces under Horus Lupercal broke the Greenskins power and the Primarch earned the title Warmaster. Under the orders of the Emperor himself the planet was heavily modified by the Adeptus Mechanicus and became the site of the most famous Imperial parade in history, the Ullanor Triumph.
到M31时，乌兰诺一号已成为战争头目乌尔拉克·乌尔格领导下的一个庞大的欧克帝国的中心。在著名的乌兰诺远征期间，荷鲁斯·卢佩卡尔领导的帝国军队摧毁了绿皮力量，这位原体获得了战帅的称号。在帝皇本人的命令下，这颗行星被机械教严重改造，成为历史上最著名的帝国阅兵 — 乌兰诺大捷的所在地。
Horus Heresy 荷鲁斯叛乱

Following the Battle of Beta-Garmon Horus instructed a general order for all of his forces to muster at Ullanor in preparation for the drive on Terra. Ultimately, Fulgrim, Perturabo, Angron, Magnus, Alpharius, and Lorgar arrived with their forces as well as well as disparate Night Lords. The traitors then enacted a darker version of the original Ullanor Triumph, parading themselves before the assembled Primarchs. At the conclusion of the Triumph, each fleet sacrificed 1/10th of their slaves to the Chaos Gods to allow for safe and easy passage through the Warp on their way to Terra.
贝塔-伽蒙之战后，荷鲁斯下达了一项总命令，要求他的所有部队在乌兰诺集结，为在泰拉上的进攻做准备。最终，福格瑞姆、佩图拉博、安格隆、马格努斯、阿尔法瑞斯和珞珈带着他们的部队以及不同的午夜领主抵达。随后，叛徒上演了原初的乌兰诺大捷的黑暗版本，在聚集的原体面前阅兵。大捷结束时，每支舰队都向混沌诸神献祭了十分之一的奴隶，以便在前往泰拉的途中安全轻松地通过亚空间。
The Beast 野兽

1,500 years later, a massive Ork Warboss of unparalleled power known simply as The Beast appeared on Ullanor, making it the center of his empire. The world became heavily urbanized by the Orks, covering nearly the entire planet in surprisingly well-organised settlements. The Beast made his home in the capital city of Gorkogrod, building a massive temple-Gargant at the exact spot where the Emperor and Primarchs gathered during the Ullanor Triumph centuries earlier. The Beast used Ullanor as a template to perfect his Attack Moon concept, converting the entire world into a battlestation that would eventually be used to destroy Terra.
1500年后，一个拥有无与伦比力量的庞大的欧克战争头目，简称为野兽，出现在乌兰诺，使其成为他的帝国的中心。欧克使世界变得高度城市化，组织良好的定居点几乎覆盖了整个行星。野兽在首都戈尔科格罗德建立了自己的家，在几个世纪前乌兰诺大捷期间帝皇和原体聚集的地方建造了一座巨大的神殿加冈特。野兽以乌兰诺为模板，完善了他的攻击月亮概念，将整个世界变成了一个最终用于摧毁泰拉的战斗站。

Eventually, the Imperium under the returned Vulkan led a second invasion of Ullanor to slay The Beast. This battle was far different than the first Imperial crusade, seeing the Imperials fight bitter urban warfare against an enemy that refused to fight out in the open. Vulkan eventually was able to lead an Astartes strikeforce into Gorkogrod's temple-gargant, where he dueled The Beast directly. After seemingly sacrificing himself to slay The Beast, Ork resistance on Ullanor crumbled.
最终，在回归的沃坎领导下的帝国再次入侵乌兰诺，杀死了野兽。这场战斗与第一次帝国远征大不相同，帝国与拒绝公开作战的敌人进行了激烈的城市战。沃坎最终能够带领一支阿斯塔特打击部队进入戈尔科格罗德的神殿加冈特，在那里他直接与野兽决斗。在似乎为了杀死野兽而牺牲了自己之后，乌兰诺上的欧克抵抗崩溃了。

The Greenskin presence on Ullanor once again endured however, and in the third invasion of Ullanor (though it was the second during the War of the Beast) it was revealed that there were in fact six "Beasts", each a Prime-Ork commanding a "Legion" of Greenskins. Imperial forces were forced to flee the planet after Lord Commander Koorland was killed.
然而，绿皮再次出现在乌兰诺，在第三次乌兰诺入侵时（尽管这是野兽战争期间的第二次入侵），据透露，实际上有六名“野兽”，每个都是一名首领欧克，指挥着一支绿皮“军团”。在指挥官库兰德被杀后，帝国部队被迫逃离这个行星。

Shortly after the death of Koorland, Maximus Thane led a third and final Imperial invasion of Ullanor. During this attack, the Imperials used redirected asteroids to devastate the planet. Using the Sisters of Silence in conjunction with a captured Ork Psyker, The Beast was slain. After the war Thane, now Lord Commander, ordered that the Adeptus Mechanicus enact Exterminatus on Ullanor to erase it from history and prevent a new Beast from ever arising. However Fabricator-General Kubik coveted the Greenskin artifacts on the world, and instead used his reverse-engineered Ork teleportation technology to teleport Ullanor to a secret location in Segmentum Solar, which later became Armageddon.

库兰德死后不久，马克西姆斯·塞恩率领帝国第三次也是最后一次乌兰诺入侵。在这次袭击中，帝国利用重定向的小行星摧毁了行星。利用寂静修女和一名被俘的欧克灵能者，野兽被杀死了。战争结束后，现任领主指挥官的塞恩命令机械教在乌兰诺上实施灭绝令，以将其从历史中抹去，并防止新的野兽出现。然而，铸造将军库比克垂涎世界上的绿皮造物，使用他的逆向工程欧克传送技术将乌兰诺传送到太阳星域的一个秘密地点，后来成为阿玛吉多顿。

title: 朦胧星域 Segmentum Obscurus
parts: The Segmentum Obscurus is one of the five Segmentums, divisions of the Galaxy, of the Imperium. It is located to the north of Holy Terra, and its Segmentum Fortress is located at Cypra Mundi. One of its most notable features is the Eye of Terror, home of the Chaos Space Marines.

Following the conclusion of the Thirteenth Black Crusade and the resurrection of Roboute Guilliman, much of Segmentum Obscurus has become stranded within Imperium Nihilus.

title: 炼狱之门 Inferni Gates
parts: The Inferni Gates is a region of the Galaxy, located in the part of Segmentum Obscurus that lies within the Imperium Nihilus, close to the Warp Storm known as the Bleak Coil. The region is a current Imperial warzone.
炼狱之门是银河系的一个区域，位于帝国暗面内的朦胧星域部分，靠近被称为荒凉缠绕的亚空间风暴。该地区是目前的帝国战区。
Overview 概述

The region consists of twin singularities which orbit one another in a vortex of gravitic energy. Chaos Space Marines under the Sorcerer Kazik Gyle have repeatedly raided Imperial worlds and shipping from this refuge, seeding rebellions across dozens or more worlds. Gyle has made use of these conflicts to enrich himself, gaining more followers and drawing the favour of the Gods of Chaos. How Gyle is able to navigate the singularities without falling victim to its gravity remains a mystery.
该地区由两个奇点组成，它们在重力能量的漩涡中相互环绕。巫师卡齐克·盖尔领导的混沌星际战士多次突袭帝国世界，并从这个避难所运送物资，在数十个或更多世界引发叛乱。盖尔利用这些冲突来充实自己，获得了更多的追随者，并赢得了混沌诸神的青睐。盖尔如何能够在不受重力影响的情况下导航奇点仍然是一个谜。
The Inquisition has classified all information pertaining to it and only those with the proper clearance can learn anything about Inferni Gates.
审判庭已将所有相关信息保密，只有获得适当许可的人才能了解有关炼狱之门的任何信息。

title: 纳克蒙德走廊 Nachmund Gauntlet
parts: The Nachmund Gauntlet is a region of space in Segmentum Obscurus focused around the Nachmund Sub-Sector.
纳克蒙德走廊是朦胧星域中围绕纳克蒙德分区的一个空间区域。
Nachmund Sub-Sector 纳克蒙德分区
Overview 概述

Located near the remains of Cadia and the Eye of Terror, the Nachmund Gauntlet was for a time the only stable route through the dreaded Cicatrix Maledictum, making it strategically vital and a source for huge amounts of Imperial refugees. Later in the Indomitus Crusade, a second passage dubbed the Attilan Gate was also discovered.
纳克蒙德走廊位于卡迪亚残骸和恐惧之眼附近，曾一度是穿过可怕的诅咒瘢痕的唯一稳定路线，使其具有战略重要性，也是大量帝国难民的来源。在不屈远征的后期，还发现了第二条被称为阿提兰之门的通道。

Currently, the both the northern and some of the southern end of the Nachmund Gauntlet is under siege by the Forces of Chaos though the Imperial succeeded in holding most of the region. During the Nachmund Rift War almost the entire northern region of the Gauntlet was lost to the Imperium, who now seeks to erect a defensive network known as the Sanctus Wall to block the invasion of the Black Legion under Haarken Worldclaimer. While many worlds north of the Sanctus Wall remain under Imperial control, they are essentially on their own to weather the coming storm. The situation for the Imperials worsened with the fall of most of Sangua Terra to the Chaos forces.
目前，尽管帝国成功控制了该地区的大部分地区，但纳克蒙德走廊的北端和南端部分地区都被混沌部队围困。在纳克蒙德裂隙战争期间，几乎整个走廊北部地区对帝国来说都失落了，帝国现在试图建立一个名为圣墙的防御网络，以阻止夺世者哈肯领导的黑色军团的入侵。虽然圣墙以北的许多世界仍处于帝国的控制之下，但它们基本上只能靠自己来度过即将到来的风暴。随着赤地星大部分地区落入混沌部队之手，帝国的局势进一步恶化。

title: 光环群星 Halo Stars
parts: The Halo Stars are the stars bordering the outer reaches of Segmentum Obscurus.
光环群星是与朦胧星域外部区域接壤的群星。
Halo Stars 光环群星
Overview 概述

The stars comprising the halo are very old and dispersed very thinly across the approximately two hundred thousand light years of the halo's diameter. Some are grouped together in clusters. The halo is almost entirely unexplored and probably contains few habitable systems. The region has an ominous reputation within the Imperium, with many considering it haunted and full of unknown horrors. Many expeditions into the Halo Stars have never returned.
构成光环的群星非常古老，在光环直径约20万光年的范围内分散得非常稀疏。有些被聚集为星群。光环几乎完全未被探索，可能包含很少的可居住星系。该地区在帝国内部有着不祥的名声，许多人认为它闹鬼，充满了未知的恐怖。许多前往光环群星的探索者再也没有回来。
The Halo Stars include a Warp disturbance known as the Halo Scar, which makes travel through it nearly impossible.
光环群星包括一种被称为光环疤痕的亚空间干扰，这使得穿越它几乎是不可能的。
Known Worlds of the Halo Stars 光环群星的著名世界
Cethlen 赛瑟伦
Exniliho - Held the ancient artifact known as the Breath of the Gods
埃克尼利霍 - 持有被称为“众神之息”的古代造物

parts: Map 地图
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Lucius
名称：卢修斯
Segmentum:Segmentum Obscurus
星域：朦胧星域
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Forge World
类别：铸造世界
Production Grade:III-Prima
生产等级：三级-上等
Tithe Grade:Aptus Non
什一税等级：特级免税
Lucius is a Forge World and is home to the Legio Astorum Titan Legion (AKA the "Warp Runners"). It also is the place of origin of the Macharius-class super-heavy battle tank.
卢修斯是一个铸造世界，也是星象军团泰坦军团（又名“次元跑者”）的所在地。它也是马卡里乌斯级超重型战斗坦克的起源地。
Lucius' icon 卢修斯标志
Overview 概述

The name of this world originates from Luciun, a unique alloy renowned for its durability. The war-plate and weapon of the armies of Lucius is made of Luciun, so the warriors of Lucius's forces have improved resilience against small-arms fire.
这个世界的名字来源于光金，一种以耐用性而闻名的独特合金。卢修斯军队的战甲和武器是由光金制成的，因此卢修斯部队的战士们提高了对小型武器火力的抵抗力。
Lucius Skitarii 卢修斯护教军

A hollow world (one of the Supernatura Majoris of the Imperium), Lucius has been part of a grand experiment that should have destroyed it a dozen times over. The centre of its once-barren core is an artificial sun, a titanic fusion reactor that powers the industry sprawling above. No one truly knows how this energy source came to be, though many Tech-Priests take credit. Lucius' boundless power supply has made it a forefront of military production, producing many types of guns and vehicles. Their Ironstriders and Onager Dunecrawlers are the most bellicose of all the Skitarii legions. Their Titan Legion are the infamous Legio Astorum, whose Princeps are trained at the Clone Academy located in Lucius' Overcity.

卢修斯是一个空洞世界（帝国的主要超自然之一），它参与了一场本应摧毁它十几次的伟大实验。其曾经荒芜的核心中心是一个人造太阳，一个巨大的聚变反应堆，为上方庞大的工业提供动力。没有人真正知道这种能源是如何产生的，尽管许多技术深度对此表示邀功。卢修斯的无限能源供应使其成为军事生产的前沿，生产多种类型的枪炮和载具。他们的铁骑和野驴沙丘爬行者是所有护教军军团中最好战的。他们的泰坦军团是著名的星象军团，其首席在卢修斯的城市上空的克隆学院接受训练。
The illuminated letter that forms Lucius' icon is burnt into the surface of the planet, each detail a dozen miles from top to bottom.
形成卢修斯的标志的发光字母被烧到行星表面，每个细节从上到下都有十几英里。
Lucius's forge is well-known for producing the Lucius Pattern Warhound Scout Titan and Lucius Pattern Drop Pod. It is also produces large quantities of Macharius Tanks of different patterns.
卢修斯的铸造厂以生产卢修斯型战犬侦察泰坦和卢修斯型空投舱而闻名。它还生产大量不同型号的马卡里乌斯坦克。
History 历史
At some point the planet suffered the disastrous Inculcata Schism, which nearly saw the Forge World implode with enough force to rip a hole in reality. Today this event is only spoken of in whispers.
在某个时刻，行星遭受了灾难性的教化分裂，几乎导致铸造世界内爆，其力量足以在现实中撕开一个洞。如今，这一事件只在私下里被提及。

In M41, Lucius was invaded by Hive Fleet Leviathan. Fortunately, the Mechanicus forces were victorious in driving away the Tyranids after months of bloody fighting winning the war of attrition when xenos could not keep pace with the refurbished robots and the recycled machinery parts of the Lucians.
在M41，卢修斯被虫巢舰队利维坦入侵。幸运的是，经过数月的血腥战斗，机械教部队在驱逐泰伦方面取得了胜利 — 赢得了消耗战，异型无法跟上卢修斯人重装的机兵和回收的机械部件的步伐。
Lucius patterns 卢修斯型号

众所周知，卢修斯会产生自己的型号：

title: 迪马玛尔 Dimmamar
parts: Map 地图
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Dimmamar
名称：迪马玛尔
Segmentum:Segmentum Obscurus
星域：朦胧星域
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Cardinal World
类别：枢机世界
Dimmamar is an Imperial world in the Segmentum Obscurus.
迪马玛尔是朦胧星域中的帝国世界。
Overview 概述

Dimmamar is most famous for two things: being the location where the Confederation of Light was founded, and being the birthplace of Sebastian Thor, who overthrew Goge Vandire and later became Ecclesiarch. It was also the first planet to defy the will of Vandire and declare him a heretic.
迪马玛尔最出名的有两件事：一是光明同盟成立的地方，二是推翻高戈·范迪尔、后来成为教宗的塞巴斯蒂安·托尔的出生地。这也是第一个无视范迪尔意愿并宣布他为异端的行星。
The people of Dimmamar have had past dealings with Fabius Bile, who is known on that planet as "the Chem-master."
迪马玛尔的人们过去曾与法比乌斯·拜尔打过交道，他在那个行星上被称为“化学大师”
History 历史

In 858.M41, Dimmamar would come under sudden attack from the Eldar of Craftworld Ulthwé without any warning or apparent reason. Seraphim led by Seraphim Superior Amelda of the Order of the Bloody Rose from the Sisters of Battle retaliated in a daring attack, slaying the Eldar Farseer.
858.M41，迪马玛尔突然遭到方舟世界乌斯维的灵族的攻击，没有任何警告或明显的原因。由战斗修女鲜血玫瑰修会的高阶炽天使阿梅尔达领导的炽天使进行了大胆的反击，杀死了灵族先知。

Cypra Mundi is a Forge World as well as the administrative and fleet capital of Segmentum Obscurus. Orbiting Cypra Mundi is a Segmentum Fortress, the base for fleet operations throughout Segmentum Obscurus. The Segmentum Fortress is controlled directly by an Administratum Master.
凯普拉·蒙迪是一个铸造世界，也是朦胧星域的行政和舰队首都。环绕凯普拉·蒙迪的是星域堡垒，是整个朦胧星域舰队行动的基地。星域堡垒由内务部长直接控制。
Overview 概述
Cypra Mundi is home to the Collegium Analytica.
凯普拉·蒙迪是分析学院的所在地。
History 历史
The world was assimilated into the Imperium during the Great Crusade, when the early Ultramarines saved the planet from Orks. Its first unique Battleship design was the Annihilator Class.
在大远征期间，世界被帝国吸收，当时早期的极限战士从欧克手中拯救了行星。它的第一艘独特的战舰设计是歼灭者级。
In 865.M41, the planet was assaulted by the forces of Chaos.
865.M41，这颗行星遭到了混沌部队的袭击。
Following the resurrection of Roboute Guilliman and the formation of the Great Rift, Cypra Mundi was one of the worlds which became stranded in the Dark Imperium.
随着罗伯特·基里曼的复活和大裂隙的形成，凯普拉·蒙迪是陷入黑暗帝国的世界之一。

title: 沃斯托尼亚 Vostroya
parts: Map 地图
Basic Data 基础数据
Name:Vostroya
名称：沃斯托尼亚
Segmentum:Segmentum Obscurus
星域：朦胧星域
System:Vostroya
星系：沃斯托尼亚星系
Population:~9.3 billion
人口：约93亿
Affiliation:Imperium
隶属：帝国
Class:Industrial World
类别：工业世界
